Globus Pallidus — באוונצ'ר חיוור עגול ביציאת מערכת הגלגלי שיניים. מטרת DBS לפרקינסון.

Glutamate receptor — ligand-gated + voltage-gated (Mg²⁺ block). Ca²⁺ influx. 1

NMDA_receptor

סמלHeavy iron door labeled 'NMDA' with horseshoe magnet wedged in lock
למהDoor = channel. Mr. Asparagus (NMDA = N-methyl-D-Aspartate) is the agonist. Magnet = Mg²⁺ block. Glycine pebble at his feet = required co-agonist. Chalk-white '2+' guests = Ca²⁺ entry.
בפעולהThree conditions for opening: 1) Asparagus present (glutamate/NMDA), 2) Glycine pebble present, 3) Neon sign flickers (depolarization) → magnet falls out. NMDA hypothesis of schizophrenia = rusty magnet, door never opens properly → negative symptoms.
סצנהASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR

קולטן NMDA — גלוטמט יונוטרופי. דלת ברזל עם מגנט-מנעול (Mg²⁺). פתיחה דורשת 3 תנאים: גלוטמט/NMDA + Glycine + דה-פולריזציה. כשפתוח → Ca²⁺ נכנס → פלסטיות, learning.

Heinz Kohut — Self Psychology 1

kohut_self_psychology

סמלThree child-parent dyads: (1) Mirror — parent reflects grandiosity; (2) Idealizing — child looks up to powerful parent; (3) Twinship — child and like-other engage as same-kind
למהThree selfobject needs.
בפעולהEmpathic failure to narcissistic vulnerability. Therapy = reparative selfobject experience.
סצנה(standalone)

Kohut — 3 דיאדות. Mirroring, Idealizing, Twinship. כישלון אמפתיה → פגיעות נרציסטית. טיפול = חוויה selfobject מתקנת.

Hippocampus — declarative memory + spatial navigation 1

hippocampus

סמלA literal SEAHORSE (hippocampus = Greek for 'seahorse') with a TINY MAP
למהHippocampus = seahorse (etymological).
בפעולהShrinks in chronic stress (cortisol toxic), depression, PTSD. SSRI/exercise = neurogenesis (seahorse grows). Memory loss with BZDs (especially α5 block, Midazolam). Hippocampal sclerosis = temporal-lobe epilepsy + depression.

היפוקמפוס — סוסון ים עם מפת מסלולים (hippocampus = סוסון ים). זיכרון דקלרטיבי + ניווט מרחבי. מצטמק בלחץ כרוני. נוירוגנזה מ-SSRI/ספורט.

Histamine H1 — Gq (sedation, allergy, weight gain) 1

H1_receptor

סמלFloor 1 living room — snoozing resident on a giant couch, allergy tissues nearby
למהFloor 1 = ground level = where you collapse = sedation.

קולטן H1 — היסטמין (Gq). קומה 1 בית-H (סלון נמנום). חסימה (Diphenhydramine, Mirtazapine, Quetiapine, Olanzapine) = סדציה + עליה במשקל.

Histamine H2 — Gs (gastric parietal cells → stomach acid) 1

H2_receptor

סמלFloor 2 kitchen with pots labeled 'H2O' leaking stomach acid
למהH2O = water = liquid stomach acid. '2' = H2.

Histamine H3 — Gi (CNS autoreceptor for histamine; also modulates other NTs) 1

H3_receptor

קולטן H3 — היסטמין (Gi, אוטו-רצפטור CNS). פרופסור נרדם על השולחן בקומה 3. Pitolisant = inverse agonist → ערות → טיפול בנרקולפסיה.

H4_receptor

Hyperprolactinemia — D2 blockade of tuberoinfundibular pathway 1

hyperprolactinemia

סמלThe MILK PUMP at the pituitary section LEAKS UNCONTROLLED — milk everywhere

Hypothalamus — body's thermostat + neuroendocrine 1

hypothalamus

סמלA THERMOSTAT/control panel UNDER the thalamus station
למהHypo-thalamus = under the relay station.

היפותלמוס — תרמוסטט מתחת לתלמוס. שינה (SCN), תיאבון (arcuate), חום, ציר HPA.

Insula — interoception + emotional awareness 1

insula

סמלA small ISLAND tucked between the temporal and frontal lobes
למהInsula = island (Latin).
בפעולהBodily awareness (interoception). Hyperactive in panic disorder (over-noticing heart). Addiction craving signal. Disgust + empathy.

אינסולה — אי קטן בין האונה הטמפורלית לפרונטלית (insula = אי בלטינית). מודעות גופנית (interoception). היפראקטיבית בפניקה.

Intellectual Developmental Disorder (IDD) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental 1

idd

סמלIDD's SUPPORT ROOM — a school-age child sits at a low table working slowly and carefully on a 5-piece large-piece beginner PUZZLE. A patient adult assistant's hand is visible from behind, gently guiding (collaborative support — adaptive scaffolding). The walls are covered with a VISUAL SCHEDULE — photographs (not just text) showing each daily task in order: brush teeth → eat breakfast → put on shoes → school. Adaptive aids are everywhere: a spoon with a chunky grip handle, picture-menu for choosing food, large-button toys, simple labels. A growth chart on the wall shows the child IS growing physically, but a mental-age curve runs lower. The room is warm and supportive — a family tree poster shows multiple family members involved in raising the child. The child smiles proudly when completing each puzzle piece. A doctor's note pinned to the wall: 'Adaptive functioning is the focus — not IQ alone'. Severity badges (Mild / Moderate / Severe / Profound) hang above the child but pinned at 'Mild' for this scene.
למהIDD = INTELLECTUAL + DEVELOPMENTAL + DEFICIT. Severity by ADAPTIVE function (not just IQ). 5-piece puzzle + visual schedule + adaptive aids + assistant's helping hand = pathognomonic. Previous name 'Mental Retardation' is outdated.
בפעולהDSM-5-TR Criteria (ALL 3 required): A. Deficits in INTELLECTUAL functions (reasoning, problem-solving, planning, abstract thinking, judgment, academic learning, learning from experience), confirmed by clinical assessment AND individualized standardized intelligence testing (IQ ~<70). B. Deficits in ADAPTIVE FUNCTIONING resulting in failure to meet developmental and sociocultural standards for personal independence and social responsibility (across conceptual, social, practical domains). C. Onset during the developmental period (before age 22). SEVERITY by ADAPTIVE FUNCTIONING: Mild (~85%) / Moderate (~10%) / Severe (~3-4%) / Profound (~1-2%). Etiology: genetic (Down syndrome, Fragile X), prenatal (alcohol, infection), perinatal (hypoxia), postnatal (TBI, infection). Global Developmental Delay (GDD) = pre-age-5 provisional diagnosis when severity not yet established.
סצנהSpecial-Ed Classroom — IDD corner (standalone scene possible)

IDD (לשעבר 'פיגור שכלי') — ילד בחדר תמיכה עובד על פאזל 5 חלקים גדולים, יד-מבוגר עוזרת מלמעלה. לוח-שנה ויזואלי עם תמונות לכל מטלה (לא רק טקסט). אביזרי הסתגלות: כפית-עם-אחיזה, תפריט-תמונות, צעצועים פשוטים. גרף-גדילה: צומח פיזית אבל פיגור שכלי. תרשים-משפחה: רבים מעורבים. רושמים: 'תפקוד אדפטיבי הוא המוקד, לא רק IQ'. קריטריונים (כל 3): A) ליקויים בתפקוד שכלי (IQ~<70); B) ליקויים בתפקוד אדפטיבי (קונספטואלי/חברתי/פרקטי); C) הופעה לפני גיל 22. רמות לפי תפקוד אדפטיבי: קל ~85% / בינוני ~10% / חמור ~3-4% / עמוק ~1-2%. אטיולוגיה: גנטיקה (Down, Fragile X), טרום-לידתי (אלכוהול, זיהום), פרי-נטלי (היפוקסיה), פוסט-נטלי (TBI, זיהום). GDD = אבחנה זמנית לפני גיל 5.

Jean Piaget — 4 stages of cognitive development 1

piaget_4_stages

סמלPIAGET'S PRE-OP HOSPITAL — a children's hospital with 4 wards each labeled with a stage; all four are 'OP' (operation) wards, unifying the theory. 'Dr. Pia-zhay' (white coat, big round glasses, French beret) tours visitors through. WARD 1 — 'SENSORY-MOTOR ER' (Sensorimotor 0-2y): a newborn in a crib reaches for their toes and kicks a peekaboo mobile; Dr. Pia-zhay demonstrates 'object permanence' by hiding a stuffed bear under a blanket and revealing it. Sign reads 'Senses + Motor only — no symbols yet'. WARD 2 — 'PRE-OP HOLDING ROOM' (Preoperational 2-7y): toddlers in colorful operating gowns play with imaginary friends and dragons painted on the walls; one toddler insists 'I'm taller than you!' though clearly shorter (egocentric, no conservation). Sign: 'PRE-OP = before logical operation'. WARD 3 — 'CONCRETE-OP SURGERY' (Concrete-Operational 7-11y): school-age children in hardhats pour water between a tall-thin glass and a short-wide glass, correctly declaring 'same volume' (conservation experiment); they sort blocks by size and color. Sign: 'CONCRETE-OP = operation on concrete objects'. WARD 4 — 'FORMAL-OP CONFERENCE' (Formal-Operational 11+y): teenagers in suits at a conference table solve abstract algebra on a chalkboard, debating hypothetical 'what-if' scenarios. Sign: 'FORMAL-OP = abstract operation'. Glowing rooftop sign: 'PIAGET HOSPITAL'.
למהAll 4 stages are 'OP' (operation) wards in the same hospital, in chronological order: SENSORY-MOTOR ER → PRE-OP → CONCRETE-OP → FORMAL-OP. Dr. 'Pia-zhay' rhymes the theorist's name into the tour.
בפעולהSensorimotor (0-2y) — object permanence emerges. Preoperational (2-7y) — symbolic play, egocentrism, no conservation, magical thinking. Concrete Operational (7-11y) — conservation, reversibility, hierarchical classification (concrete objects only). Formal Operational (11+y) — abstract reasoning, hypothetico-deductive thinking, metacognition.
סצנה(standalone — PIAGET'S PRE-OP HOSPITAL)

בית-החולים של פיאז'ה — 4 מחלקות 'OP' (operation): SENSORY-MOTOR ER (0-2, object permanence) → PRE-OP (2-7, אגוצנטריות, אין שימור, חשיבה מאגית) → CONCRETE-OP (7-11, שימור, הפיכות) → FORMAL-OP (11+, חשיבה מופשטת, hypothetico-deductive). דר' פיא-ז'אי (לבוש לבן + בארט צרפתי) מסייר במחלקות ומדגים.

John Bowlby + Mary Ainsworth — 4 attachment styles (Strange Situation paradigm) 1

attachment_4_styles

סמלAINSWORTH'S STRANGE SITUATION ROOM — a research observation playroom. On one wall is a large ONE-WAY MIRROR behind which Mary Ainsworth herself stands with a clipboard and a stopwatch, taking notes. The room is divided into four corners, each enacting one attachment style during the REUNION moment (the diagnostic point — after mother has briefly left and returned). CORNER 1 — SECURE attachment (~60%): toddler runs joyfully toward the returning mother, gets a quick hug, calms within seconds, then returns to exploring toys. Sign: 'SECURE = uses mother as base'. CORNER 2 — ANXIOUS-AMBIVALENT (~10%): toddler simultaneously CLINGS to mother's leg AND pushes her away with the other hand, sobbing inconsolably for many minutes — 'I want you, but I'm angry'. Sign: 'AMBIVALENT'. CORNER 3 — AVOIDANT (~20%): toddler IGNORES the returning mother, turns away pointedly, continues playing as if she were invisible. Sign: 'AVOIDANT'. CORNER 4 — DISORGANIZED (~10%, trauma-linked): toddler shows CONTRADICTORY behavior — approaches mother with head turned away, freezes mid-step, then collapses to the floor. Sign: 'DISORGANIZED'. Above each corner: a small video monitor replaying the separation moment for context. Banner: 'STRANGE SITUATION — Reunion reveals all'. In a separate panel: John Bowlby (the theorist) sketches the theory in a notebook.
למהSTRANGE SITUATION = the actual research paradigm name. 4 corners in one room = 4 styles. The REUNION moment is the diagnostic. Ainsworth observes behind the mirror; Bowlby (separate panel) is the theorist.
בפעולהSecure (~60%) = best outcome — caregiver is reliable safe base for exploration. Anxious-Ambivalent (~10%) — inconsistent caregiver, child uncertain. Avoidant (~20%) — rejecting caregiver, child suppresses attachment needs. Disorganized (~10%) — frightening or frightened caregiver (often trauma/abuse) — strongest predictor of later BPD, dissociation, and complex trauma symptoms. Bowlby = theoretical framework; Ainsworth = empirical paradigm.
סצנה(standalone — AINSWORTH'S STRANGE SITUATION ROOM)

חדר 'המצב הזר' של Ainsworth — חדר מחקר עם מראה חד-כיוונית; Mary Ainsworth מתעדת בלוח. 4 פינות לסצנת איחוד. Secure (~60%): רץ לאמא, מתחבק, נרגע, חוזר לשחק. Anxious-Ambivalent (~10%): דבק + מתנגד, בוכה בלי הפסקה. Avoidant (~20%): מתעלם, פונה הצד. Disorganized (~10%, קשור לטראומה): מתנהג סותר, קופא, מתמוטט — predictor חזק של BPD ו-dissociation. בפאנל-צד: John Bowlby רושם את התיאוריה.

Lev Vygotsky — Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) and scaffolding 1

vygotsky_zpd

סמלVYGOTSKY'S ZPD BRIDGE — a wide canyon between two cliffs. LEFT CLIFF labeled 'CAN DO ALONE' has a child confidently riding a tricycle on solid ground, surrounded by mastered objects. RIGHT CLIFF labeled 'CANNOT YET DO' is across the chasm, with desired goals visible (algebra textbook, advanced puzzle, violin). Between the cliffs stretches a ROPE-BRIDGE labeled in big letters 'ZPD = Zone of Proximal Development'. On the bridge a child crosses carefully, while a SCAFFOLDING-PERSON walks beside them — literally a kind teacher / older peer wearing a construction-scaffolding outfit (metal frame around their body). The scaffolding-person holds the bridge ropes for safety and offers verbal hints in speech-bubbles ('try this hand-hold!', 'almost there!'). As the child reaches the right cliff, the scaffolding falls away in pieces (= scaffolding fades as the skill is internalized). At the canyon edge stands Vygotsky himself (round glasses, Russian-style coat, holding a chalkboard) pointing to the bridge. A sub-sign reads: 'Learning is social and language-mediated'.
למהZPD BRIDGE = literal bridge between 'can-do' and 'cannot-yet'. SCAFFOLDING-PERSON wearing construction-scaffolding outfit = the literal metaphor for teacher support. Speech-bubbles from the helper = social mediation of learning. Vygotsky at the cliff = the theorist.
בפעולהZPD = the gap between what a child can do INDEPENDENTLY and what they can do with GUIDED ASSISTANCE from a more competent peer or adult. Scaffolding = temporary support that fades as competence grows. Learning is fundamentally SOCIAL and language-mediated — internal speech develops out of dialogue with others. Contrasts with Piaget's individual-discovery model.
סצנה(standalone — VYGOTSKY'S ZPD BRIDGE)

גשר ה-ZPD של ויגוצקי — קניון בין 2 צוקים. שמאל: 'CAN DO ALONE' (ילד על תלת-אופן). ימין: 'CANNOT YET DO' (ספר אלגברה, פאזל מתקדם, כינור). באמצע: גשר-חבלים 'ZPD = אזור התפתחות פרוקסימלי'. מורה-פיגום (לבוש כפיגום-בניין מתכתי) מלווה את הילד עם רמזים-קוליים בבועות. הפיגום נופל כשהילד מגיע ליעד = הפנמה. ויגוצקי על הצוק עם לוח-גיר. למידה היא חברתית ומתווכת-שפה. בניגוד לפיאז'ה (גילוי עצמי).

Lithium toxicity — narrow therapeutic window 1

lithium_toxicity

סמלThe Li-ion battery OVER-CHARGED, smoking, swelling — tremor → ataxia → confusion → seizures → coma
למהBattery explosion = toxicity.
בפעולהMild (1.5-2.0): tremor coarse, N/V, diarrhea. Moderate (2.0-2.5): ataxia, confusion. Severe (>2.5): seizures, dialysis indicated. Triggers: dehydration, NSAIDs, ACE-I/ARB, diuretics (thiazides), renal disease. Annual TSH + Cr.
סצנה(Li-ion battery exploding)

רעלת ליתיום — חלון טיפולי צר. קל (1.5-2.0): רעד, GI; בינוני (2.0-2.5): אטקסיה, בלבול; קשה (>2.5): פרכוסים, dialysis נדרש. טריגרים: התייבשות, NSAID, ACE-I/ARB, thiazides, מחלת כליה. ניטור: רמה, TSH, Cr שנתיים.

Lithium → hypothyroidism + nephrogenic diabetes insipidus 1

lithium_hypothyroid_DI

סמלBattery cables wrapped around a SLOW THYROID (goiter) and a DRY/THIRSTY KIDNEY
למהChronic Lithium effects.
בפעולהHypothyroidism (10-20% over years) — TSH q6-12mo, supplement with levothyroxine. Nephrogenic DI (polyuria, polydipsia) — Amiloride blocks Li uptake into collecting duct.
סצנה(Li-ion battery affects body systems)

ליתיום → היפותירואידיזם + סוכרת תפלה נפרוגנית. היפותירואידיזם: 10-20% במשך שנים → TSH q6-12mo + Levothyroxine. נפרוגנית DI (פוליאוריה): Amiloride חוסם כניסת Li לאיסוף.

Main inhibitory neurotransmitter 1

GABA_neurotransmitter

סמלAa Hotel manager holding the master key
למהGABA = manager who opens the Cl⁻ doors.
בפעולהOpens the receptor channel → green chlorine soldiers (Cl⁻) rush in → hyperpolarization (inhibition).
סצנהAA_HOTEL

GABA — המעכב הראשי. מנהל מלון Aa עם המפתח הראשי. פותח את התעלה → חיילי כלוריד ירוקים נכנסים → היפרפולריזציה.

Margaret Mahler — separation-individuation theory (3 main phases + 4 sub-stages) 1

mahler_phases

סמלGUSTAV MAHLER SYMPHONY HALL — a grand concert hall (a pun on the composer Gustav Mahler) where Maestro 'Margaret Mahler' conducts a 3-movement symphony of early development. She wears a tuxedo over a pediatrician's white coat. MOVEMENT 1 — 'AUTISTIC overture' (0-2 months): a single muffled musician sits inside a soundproof glass booth playing softly to themselves, unaware of the audience (normal autistic phase — infant unaware of others). MOVEMENT 2 — 'SYMBIOTIC duet' (2-6 months): two musicians (mother + baby) play with their bow-arms physically tied together by a ribbon, perfectly synchronized; sheet music above reads 'M+I = ONE' (dual-unity / fusion). MOVEMENT 3 — 'SEPARATION-INDIVIDUATION suite' (4-36 months) is performed by 4 instrumentalists who progressively separate from the conductor: (a) DIFFERENTIATION / Hatching (4-10mo) — a string player peeks out curiously from BEHIND A CURTAIN, looking around for the first time. Subtitle: 'hatching'. (b) PRACTICING (10-15mo) — a brass-section player marches confidently toward the front of the stage, trumpet raised high, exuberant smile. Subtitle: 'love affair with the world'. (c) RAPPROCHEMENT (15-24mo) — a woodwind player RUNS BACK AND FORTH between the conductor's podium and the stage edge, alternately playing solo then rushing back for reassurance. Subtitle: 'ambivalent shadowing'. (d) OBJECT CONSTANCY (24-36mo) — a percussionist keeps a steady beat calmly even when the conductor walks OFFSTAGE; the musician holds the conductor's mental image and plays on independently. Subtitle: 'internalized mother'. Banner above the stage: 'MAHLER SYMPHONY — From One to Self'.
למהComposer Gustav Mahler's SYMPHONY pun = Margaret Mahler's DEVELOPMENTAL THEORY. 3 movements = 3 main phases (Autistic / Symbiotic / Separation-Individuation). 4 instrumentalists separating in movement 3 = 4 sub-stages: Differentiation (peek from curtain / hatching) → Practicing (march forward) → Rapprochement (run back-and-forth) → Object Constancy (play while conductor offstage).
בפעולהNormal Autistic (0-2mo) — infant unaware of others. Symbiotic (2-6mo) — fused dual-unity with caregiver. Separation-Individuation (4-36mo): Differentiation/hatching (4-10mo) — physical separation begins. Practicing (10-15mo) — exuberant exploration ('love affair with the world'). Rapprochement (15-24mo) — increased awareness of separateness; ambivalence about independence (the rapprochement crisis). Object Constancy (24-36mo) — internalized mother allows tolerance of separation. Failure of object constancy → Borderline PD organization (per Kernberg's developmental model).
סצנה(standalone — GUSTAV MAHLER SYMPHONY HALL)

אולם-קונצרטים של גוסטב Mahler (פאן על מרגרט Mahler). 3 פרקים. פרק 1 — שלב אוטיסטי (0-2 חוד): סולן בתא-זכוכית. פרק 2 — סימביוזה (2-6 חוד): 2 נגנים מאוחים בסרט, שלט 'M+I = ONE'. פרק 3 — Separation-Individuation (4-36 חוד) עם 4 תת-שלבים: (א) Differentiation/hatching (4-10): נגן מציץ מאחורי וילון. (ב) Practicing (10-15): נגן צועד גאה לקדמת הבמה. (ג) Rapprochement (15-24): נגן רץ קדימה-אחורה למנצח. (ד) Object Constancy (24-36): נגן ממשיך לנגן גם כשהמנצח עזב. כישלון object constancy → אישיות גבולית (Kernberg).

בפעולהAll the side-effect symbols above belong here. Recognize + treat + prevent.

Melanie Klein — paranoid-schizoid + depressive positions 1

klein_positions

סמלTwo paintings side-by-side. Left: a baby with a SPLIT good-vs-bad breast (paranoid-schizoid, ~0-6 months). Right: an older baby reconciling whole-object ambivalence (depressive position, 6+ months).

Klein — שתי ציורים. שמאל: שד split (good/bad) = paranoid-schizoid (~0-6 חודשים). ימין: אובייקט שלם עם ambivalence = depressive (6+ חודשים). כישלון אינטגרציה = splitting BPD.

Metabolic syndrome — antipsychotic-induced weight gain + dyslipidemia + T2DM 1

metabolic_syndrome

סמלThe Olympic athlete (Olanzapine character) gorging on pizza + sleeping under the Quiet Pine — surrounded by olives (oil) and a glucose meter showing 250
למהCombined H1 (↑appetite) + 5-HT2C (↑appetite) + ? (insulin resistance) block.

תסמונת מטבולית — עליה במשקל + דיסליפידמיה + T2DM. חסימת H1 + 5-HT2C משולבת. סיכון: Olanzapine > Clozapine > Quetiapine > Risperidone > ...> Lurasidone. ניטור שנתי: גלוקוז, ליפידים, מותן.

NMS — antipsychotic-induced hyperthermia + rigidity emergency 1

neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome

סמלThe mesolimbic D2 barrier is SLAMMED SHUT — all workers turn into RIGID PYRAMID STATUES, the mine catches FIRE (hyperthermia), and a heart monitor shows wild swings
למהNMS = Neuroleptic Massive Shutdown of DA system.
בפעולהCaused by: any antipsychotic (esp. high-potency 1st-gen). 4-Symptom rule: Fever + Encephalopathy (altered mental status) + Vital instability + Elevated enzymes (↑CK >1000). Treatment: STOP antipsychotic, supportive cooling, dantrolene/bromocriptine, ICU. DDx: serotonin syndrome (clonus vs. rigidity).
סצנה(DOPA_MINE in catastrophic mode)

NMS — תסמונת ממאירה ניורולפטית. מצב חירום: היפרתרמיה + נוקשות שרירים + אי-יציבות אוטונומית + ↑CK. גורם: אנטיפסיכוטיים (במיוחד דור 1 פוטנטיים). טיפול: הפסקת תרופה + Dantrolene/Bromocriptine + טיפול תומך. DDx: serotonin syndrome (clonus vs rigidity).

סמל(Skipped — geriatric scope)

Neurodevelopmental Disorders — establishing scene (Special-Ed Classroom) — 6 ND families 1

DSM_neurodevelopmental

סמלSPECIAL-ED CLASSROOM — a brightly-colored kindergarten room with 6 distinct corners, each showing a child characteristic of one ND disorder family. ASD CORNER: child sits cross-legged silently lining up toy trains in a perfectly straight row, wears large noise-cancelling headphones, eyes averted. ADHD CORNER: child bouncing on a chair surrounded by scattered toys, motion-lines and 'POW!' 'WHIZ!' speech bubbles, multiple half-finished activities. INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY (IDD) CORNER: child works slowly on a 5-piece beginner puzzle with a patient teacher's helping hand visible behind. SPECIFIC LEARNING DISORDER (SLD) CORNER: child looks confused at letters that visually swap and float ('b/d/p/q' rotating chaotically), placards mixing up reading order. COMMUNICATION DISORDER CORNER: child with sealed lips and an empty speech bubble OR with the speech bubble shown broken into stuttering fragments. TIC DISORDERS CORNER: child surrounded by comic-style action bubbles popping around their head — 'BLINK!' 'SHRUG!' 'AH!' 'TWITCH!'. At the center of the classroom: a teacher pointing at a tree-branch chart titled 'Neurodevelopmental Disorders' with 6 branches.
למהEach corner = a specific ND disorder family with its hallmark visual. Same children reappear individually as the symbol of their disorder in per-disorder scenes.
בפעולהDSM Chapter 1 Neurodevelopmental Disorders all begin in early childhood and impair daily functioning. The 6 families: Intellectual Developmental Disorder (IDD) including Global Developmental Delay, Communication Disorders (language, speech-sound, childhood-onset fluency/stuttering, social-pragmatic), Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), Specific Learning Disorder (SLD — reading/written-expression/math), Motor Disorders (Developmental Coordination, Stereotypic Movement, Tic incl. Tourette's).

כיתת-גן-מיוחדת — 6 פינות מובחנות לפי הפרעות נוירו-התפתחותיות. פינת ASD: ילד מסדר רכבות בקו ישר, אוזניות. פינת ADHD: ילד קופץ על כיסא, פיזור-דעת ובועות 'POW!'. פינת ID: ילד עם פאזל של 5 חלקים, סיוע מורה. פינת SLD: ילד מבולבל באותיות שמתחלפות ('b/d/p/q'). פינת Communication: ילד עם בועה ריקה / בועה מקוטעת (גמגום). פינת Tic: ילד מוקף בועות 'BLINK!' 'SHRUG!' 'AH!'. במרכז: מורה עם תרשים-עץ ND.

למה'Lucky 7' = α7. Wise grandpa = cognition.

Personality Disorders — establishing scene (Personality Inn) — 10 specific PDs + General Criteria 1

DSM_personality_disorders

סמלPERSONALITY INN — a theatrical 3-room tavern at night. Cluster A room (dimly-lit, weird-eccentric, blue-purple shadows): PARANOID guest peers from behind a menu with dark sunglasses, suspicious of everyone; SCHIZOID guest sits alone in a cold corner, no expression, eats by himself; SCHIZOTYPAL guest wears a wizard hat reading tarot cards over dinner, talks to invisible spirits. Cluster B room (red-gold, dramatic, candlelit): ANTISOCIAL in a leather coat steals from the register without remorse; BORDERLINE has two opposing faces (loving the waiter from the left side, hating the same waiter from the right side); NARCISSISTIC stares only into a hand-mirror admiring himself, ignoring others; HISTRIONIC stands ON the table performing a dramatic monologue with arms spread wide. Cluster C room (blue-gray, anxious, fluorescent): AVOIDANT hides behind a giant menu fearing rejection; DEPENDENT clings tightly to another guest, unable to choose food alone; OCPD lines up cutlery in perfect parallel rows so obsessively that they miss the meal itself. At the inn's entrance hall: a faceless MANNEQUIN statue with a sign 'GENERAL PD CRITERIA A-F' (see general_PD_criteria entry).
למהEach character carries a primary visual hook for their PD pattern. Same characters reappear individually in per-PD scenes. 3 rooms = 3 clusters with thematic lighting (weird/dramatic/anxious).
בפעולהCluster A (odd/eccentric): paranoid distrust, schizoid detachment, schizotypal magical thinking. Cluster B (dramatic/erratic): antisocial criminal disregard, borderline unstable relationships and self-image, narcissistic grandiosity, histrionic attention-seeking. Cluster C (anxious/fearful): avoidant social inhibition, dependent submission, OCPD rigid perfectionism. All require General PD Criteria A-F to diagnose.

פונדק-המסכות — תפאורה תיאטרלית עם 3 חדרים תמטיים ו-10 אורחים. Cluster A (מוזר, אפלולי כחול-סגול): פראנואיד עם משקפי-שמש מציץ; שיזואיד בודד וקר; שיזוטיפלי עם כובע-קוסם וקלפי-טארוט. Cluster B (דרמטי, אדום-זהב): אנטיסוציאלי גונב מהקופה; בורדרליין דו-פנים (אוהב+שונא); נרציסיסטי מסתכל במראה; היסטריוני עומד על השולחן. Cluster C (חרד, כחול-אפור): מתחמק חבוי בתפריט; תלותי נצמד; OCPD מסדר סכו"ם בקווים מושלמים. בכניסה: פסל-מנקין 'GENERAL PD CRITERIA A-F'.

QT prolongation — drug-induced arrhythmia risk 1

QT_prolongation

סמלAn EKG strip with the QT interval STRETCHED LONG — like a rubber band about to snap (into torsades de pointes)
למהQ-T interval visibly stretched.

QT הארכה — סיכון לסוג של arrhythmia (torsades de pointes). גרועים: Methadone, Ziprasidone, IV Haloperidol, TCAs, Citalopram (תלוי מינון). גורמי סיכון: היפו-K, היפו-Mg, ברדיקרדיה. ניטור: EKG בסיס + מעקב.

SIADH — drug-induced hyponatremia 1

SIADH_hyponatremia

סמלThe bread-maze (Carbamazepine) FLOODED with water — patient drowning in low sodium
למהCarb-A-Maze drowning in water = SIADH.
בפעולהOffenders: Carbamazepine, Oxcarbazepine (more than Carba!), SSRIs (esp. in elderly), Antipsychotics (rare). Sx: confusion, headache, seizures if severe. Check Na in elderly within 2 weeks of starting.

Serotonin syndrome — excess 5-HT emergency 1

Sigmund Freud — 5 psychosexual stages of development 1

freud_5_psychosexual

סמלFREUD'S DREAM COUCH — Sigmund Freud (white beard, round wire-rim glasses, cigar in mouth) reclines on his iconic Persian-rug-covered psychoanalytic couch. Above his head float FIVE thought-bubbles in chronological sequence, each containing a vignette of one psychosexual stage. BUBBLE 1 — ORAL (0-18mo): a happy baby sucking on a pacifier with extra pacifiers floating nearby; a small inset shows an adult chain-smoker with a pen between lips (oral fixation). BUBBLE 2 — ANAL (18mo-3y): a toddler on a potty surrounded by neatly folded toilet-paper rolls; insets show an obsessively tidy adult (anal-retentive, OCPD-like) and a sloppy disorganized adult (anal-expulsive). BUBBLE 3 — PHALLIC (3-6y): a small child notices gender differences between parents; an Oedipal vignette — a little boy hands his mother flowers while dad watches uneasily, and an Electra vignette — a little girl sits in dad's lap while mom looks on. BUBBLE 4 — LATENCY (6-12y): same-sex children play baseball/soccer together, no romantic interest, focus on skills and same-sex friendships. BUBBLE 5 — GENITAL (12+y): two adolescents at a candlelit cafe table holding hands, mature romantic interest. On Freud's side table: a CIGAR BOX with the famous quote 'Sometimes a cigar is just a cigar?'. A small sign by the couch: 'TELL ME ABOUT YOUR MOTHER'.
למהFreud's iconic couch holds him while he dreams the 5 stages above his head. Each bubble shows the body-zone focus of that stage. Memory aid: 'Old Age Pensioners Love Grapes' (OAPLG) = Oral / Anal / Phallic / Latency / Genital.
בפעולהOral (0-18mo) — pleasure via mouth (sucking, biting). Fixation: smoking, overeating, oral aggression. Anal (18mo-3y) — control via bowel movements (potty training). Fixation: anal-retentive (rigid, perfectionist, OCPD-like) or anal-expulsive (messy, disorganized). Phallic (3-6y) — gender awareness; Oedipus complex (boy → mother) and Electra complex (girl → father). Fixation: identity / relationship issues. Latency (6-12y) — sexual drives latent; same-sex friendships, skill mastery. Genital (12+y) — mature sexuality, capacity for adult love. Freud's stages are historically central but largely superseded; lasting contributions: the unconscious, defense mechanisms, transference, dream interpretation.
סצנה(standalone — FREUD'S DREAM COUCH)

ספת-החלום של פרויד — סיגמונד פרויד שכוב על ספתו המפורסמת, מעל ראשו 5 בועות-מחשבה: Oral (0-18m, פטמה + עישון כ-fixation), Anal (18m-3y, סיר ונייר טואלט; fixation = OCPD מסודר או מבולגן), Phallic (3-6y, הבדלי-מגדר, Oedipus/Electra), Latency (6-12y, חברויות חד-מיניות, מיומנויות), Genital (12+y, אהבה בוגרת). מנמוניק לסדר: 'Old Age Pensioners Love Grapes' = OAPLG. תרומות-מפתח: לא-מודע, מנגנוני הגנה, transference, פירוש חלומות.

Specific Learning Disorder (SLD) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental 1

sld

סמלSLD's MOVING LETTERS — a school-age child sits at a classroom desk with a textbook open. The letters and numbers on the page are LITERALLY moving and rotating in front of their eyes: 'b' rotates into 'd', 'p' flips into 'q', '6' inverts into '9', words appear scrambled ('REID' instead of 'RIDE'). The child stares with deep confusion, brow furrowed. Their pencil hovers over the page, frozen. A math problem on the blackboard reads '7 × 6 = ?' — the child's notebook shows random number attempts crossed out. CRITICAL DETAIL — on the same desk: a beautifully built MODEL ROCKET (the child's own work) with detailed accurate diagrams, showing intelligence is normal in OTHER domains. A clock shows they've been stuck on this page for 30 minutes while classmates have moved on. The teacher with a learning-specialist badge offers structured-literacy support. A specifier sign hangs: 'with impairment in reading' (dyslexia) — alternatives 'in math' (dyscalculia), 'in writing' (dysgraphia).
למהSLD = SPECIFIC Learning Disorder — academic skill below age expectation despite NORMAL intelligence elsewhere. Moving letters + scrambled words + beautifully built rocket on the same desk = pathognomonic. Differs from IDD: SLD has NORMAL IQ except in one domain.
בפעולהDSM-5-TR Criteria: A. Difficulties learning and using academic skills, ≥1 of 6 symptoms persisting ≥6 months despite intervention: (1) inaccurate or slow word reading (DYSLEXIA), (2) difficulty understanding meaning of what is read, (3) difficulties with spelling, (4) difficulties with written expression, (5) difficulties mastering number sense, facts, calculations (DYSCALCULIA), (6) difficulties with mathematical reasoning. B. Affected academic skills SUBSTANTIALLY and QUANTIFIABLY below age expectations, causing significant impairment (best confirmed by individually administered standardized achievement measures). C. Onset during school years (may not fully manifest until demands exceed limited capacity). D. NOT better explained by IDD, sensory impairments, mental/neurological disorders, language disorder, psychosocial adversity, lack of education. SPECIFIERS: with impairment in reading / written expression / mathematics. Severity: Mild / Moderate / Severe.
סצנהSpecial-Ed Classroom — SLD corner (standalone scene possible)

SLD — ילד בכיתה, האותיות זזות ומסתובבות: 'b'→'d', 'p'→'q', '6'→'9'. מילים מבולגנות (REID במקום RIDE). תקוע 30 דקות בעוד הכיתה התקדמה. **קריטי**: על אותו שולחן — דגם רקטה יפהפה שבנה לבד = אינטליגנציה תקינה בתחומים אחרים. הבדל מ-IDD: SLD = IQ תקין רק בתחום אחד פגוע. קריטריונים: A) קושי באקדמיה ≥6 חודשים למרות התערבות, ≥1 מ-6 — קריאה (דיסלקסיה), הבנת הנקרא, איות, כתיבה, חשבון (דיסקלקוליה), חשיבה מתמטית; B) הישגים מתחת לציפיות לפי גיל באופן מדיד; C) הופעה בשנות בית-ספר; D) לא מוסבר ע"י IDD/חושים/הפרעה אחרת/חוסר חינוך. ספציפיירס: קריאה / כתיבה / מתמטיקה. חומרה: קל / בינוני / חמור.

Tic Disorders (incl. Tourette's) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental Motor Disorders 1

tic_disorders

סמלTIC-LAND — a school-age child stands in the middle of their bedroom surrounded by sudden POP-UP comic-style action bubbles that burst around them involuntarily: 'BLINK!' (eye tic), 'SHRUG!' (shoulder tic), 'AH!' (vocal tic), 'TWITCH!' (neck tic), 'PFFT!' (lip pucker), 'WOOP!' (vocal). The child's body is mid-motion in multiple ways simultaneously — eye blink, shoulder shrug, neck jerk. A thermometer labeled 'PREMONITORY URGE' is positioned beside the child at a HIGH level just BEFORE each tic erupts (premonitory urge is hallmark). On a wall calendar: red marks showing the tics have been present for >1 YEAR (Tourette criterion). A timeline shows onset BEFORE age 18. The child's face shows mild embarrassment — aware of the tics but unable to fully suppress them. A speech therapist note: 'tics WAX AND WANE — better some weeks, worse others'. Pinned to wall: a chart 'Tourette = motor + vocal tics, both, for >1 year' vs 'Persistent motor OR vocal (one type only)' vs 'Provisional (<1 year)'.
למהTIC = sudden, recurrent, NONRHYTHMIC motor or vocal pop-up. POP-UP bubbles 'BLINK! SHRUG! AH!' + premonitory urge thermometer + 1-year calendar = pathognomonic. Tourette REQUIRES both motor AND vocal tics.
בפעולהDSM-5-TR Tic Disorders: (1) TOURETTE'S DISORDER — MULTIPLE motor tics AND ≥1 vocal tic, present for >1 year, onset before age 18, not due to substance/medical. (2) PERSISTENT (CHRONIC) MOTOR OR VOCAL TIC DISORDER — single OR multiple motor OR vocal tics (NOT both), >1 year. (3) PROVISIONAL TIC DISORDER — tics present <1 year. Tics defined as: sudden, rapid, recurrent, nonrhythmic motor movements or vocalizations. PREMONITORY URGE often present (relievable by performing tic). Tics WAX AND WANE. Often comorbid with ADHD (~50%) and OCD (~30%). Treatment: behavioral (CBIT — Comprehensive Behavioral Intervention for Tics is first-line), α2-agonists (Clonidine, Guanfacine), antipsychotics (Haloperidol/Aripiprazole/Risperidone for severe), VMAT2 inhibitors (Tetrabenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Valbenazine). Coprolalia (involuntary obscenities) is RARE — only ~10% of Tourette's despite media portrayal.
סצנהSpecial-Ed Classroom — Tic corner (standalone scene possible)

TIC-LAND — ילד מוקף בועות-קומיקס פתאומיות: BLINK! SHRUG! AH! TWITCH! PFFT! WOOP!. גוף בתנועה מרובה. מד-חום 'דחף-מקדים' (premonitory urge) גבוה לפני כל טיק. לוח-שנה: >שנה. ציר-זמן: לפני גיל 18. הילד מעט נבוך — מודע אבל לא יכול לדכא לחלוטין. טיקים WAX AND WANE. אבחנות: Tourette = motor + vocal tics, שניהם, >שנה; Persistent (Chronic) = motor או vocal בלבד, >שנה; Provisional = <שנה. קומורבידיות גבוהה עם ADHD (~50%) ו-OCD (~30%). טיפול: CBIT (התנהגותי, קו-1), α2-agonists (Clonidine, Guanfacine), אנטיפסיכוטיים (Haloperidol, Aripiprazole, Risperidone), VMAT2 inhibitors. Coprolalia נדיר (~10% מ-Tourette, למרות הסטיגמה התקשורתית).

Trauma- and Stressor-Related Disorders 1

DSM_trauma_stressor

סמלA BROKEN PHOTO frame with a shattered timeline behind it — flashback arrows pointing backward in time
למהTrauma = broken timeline.
בפעולהPTSD, Acute Stress, Adjustment, RAD, DSED. Prazosin's praise-soldier helps with nightmares. SSRIs first-line. Trauma-focused CBT, EMDR.

DSM פרק טראומה. סמל: מסגרת תמונה שבורה עם זמן מתופרר, חצי flashback אחורה. PTSD, Acute Stress, Adjustment, RAD, DSED. Prazosin לסיוטים. SSRI קו ראשון. TF-CBT, EMDR.

Ventral Tegmental Area — midbrain dopamine source (mesolimbic + mesocortical) 1

VTA

סמלThe mine SUPERVISOR'S OFFICE — VTA chairman dispatches carts to two destinations
למהVTA = the management hub of DOPA-MINE Co.
בפעולהDispatches mesolimbic carts (to limbic 'casino') and mesocortical carts (to cortical 'café'). Hyperactivity → too much to limbic (psychosis). Hypoactivity → too little to cortex (negative symptoms).
סצנהDOPA_MINE (supervisor's office)

Ventral Tegmental Area — משרד יו"ר ב-DOPA-MINE. מקור מסולימבי + מסוקורטיקלי. היפראקטיביות = פסיכוזה; היפו = תסמינים שליליים.

Vesicular monoamine transporter 2 — packages monoamines (DA, NE, 5-HT) into vesicles 1

VMAT2

סמלYoga mat labeled 'V-MAT 2' — monoamines rest on it before vesicular release
למהVMAT = literal mat. 2 = subtype.
בפעולהInhibition (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine) = mat is stolen → monoamines never packaged → presynaptic depletion. Treats Tardive Dyskinesia + Huntington's chorea.
סצנהDOPA_MINE (rest hall)

מובל ווסיקולרי 2 — מזרון יוגה 'V-MAT 2' באולם מנוחה. מונואמינים שוכבים עליו לפני שחרור. גנבים (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine) = TD treatment.

Winnicott — holding + transitional object + good-enough mother 1

winnicott_holding

סמלMother holding infant in her arms with a TEDDY BEAR nearby. A glowing AURA around them = 'holding environment'. Label: 'good-enough mother'.
למהTeddy = transitional object. Aura = holding. Imperfect mother = good-enough.
בפעולהTransitional object bridges symbiosis-to-separateness. Good-enough = optimally frustrating, necessary for developing self.
סצנה(standalone)

Winnicott — אם מחזיקה תינוק, דובון לידם, הילה זוהרת = 'holding environment'. הדובון = אובייקט מעבר. 'good-enough mother' = לא מושלם, מתסכל-באופן-אופטימלי.

dlPFC — working memory + cognitive control 1

dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex

סמלA LIBRARIAN organizing books at the side of the CEO office
למהDorsoLateral = top-side of PFC. Books = working memory.
בפעולהrTMS depression target (left dlPFC stimulation, right dlPFC inhibition). Hypoactive in schizophrenia (negative symptoms).
סצנה(brain map)

dlPFC — ספרן בצד המשרד. זיכרון עבודה, בקרה קוגניטיבית. מטרת rTMS לדיכאון (גירוי שמאל). היפואקטיבי בסכיזופרניה.

vmPFC — emotional regulation + self-reference 1

ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex

סמלA meditation cushion at the BOTTOM-CENTER of the PFC office
למהVentroMedial = bottom-middle. Cushion = emotional self-care.
בפעולהDefault Mode Network hub. Hyperactive rumination in depression. Mindfulness/CBT modulate vmPFC.
סצנה(brain map)

vmPFC — כרית מדיטציה בתחתית המשרד. ויסות רגשי, הפנמה. רכזת ב-Default Mode Network. רומינציה דיכאונית.

תרופות

58 תרופות עם סמל משלהן

Lithium

סמלGiant Li-ion battery labeled 'Li' with charge indicator
למהLi = chemical symbol on the battery.
בפעולהNarrow voltage band on the indicator = narrow therapeutic window (0.6–1.2 mEq/L). Overcharged battery EXPLODES = toxicity at >1.5 (tremor → ataxia → seizures → death). Rechargeable = mood stabilization between mania and depression.
מופיע בBipolar polar-bear scene, Acute mania ward, Tox-emergency scene

ליתיום — סוללת Li-ion ענקית עם מד-טעינה. רוחב חלון מתח צר = חלון טיפולי 0.6-1.2 mEq/L. סוללה במתח-יתר מתפוצצת = רעלת >1.5 (רעד → אטקסיה → פרכוסים → קומה). ניטור TSH + Cr שנתיים.

Valproate

סמלBald PRO athlete in a valley, holding a giant cake (weight gain) and stroking his bald head
למהVAL-PRO = Valley + Pro. Bald + cake = hair loss + weight gain.
בפעולהBroad mood stabilizer + anticonvulsant. Hepatotoxic warning = liver dangling. Teratogen = pregnant woman shooed away.

Valproate — אתלט מקצוען קירח בעמק עם עוגה גדולה. נושר שיער + עליה במשקל. רחב-spectrum (מצב רוח + נוגד פרכוסים). Hepatotoxic warning + טרטוגן (טרידה - black box פדיאטרי <2).

Lamotrigine

סמלLamb standing on a hair-trigger, with red rash on its wool
למהLamb-O-Trij → 'Lamb-on-Trigger'. Red rash = SJS / TEN warning.
בפעולהSlow titration = lamb slowly stepping onto trigger. Carbamazepine ↓ levels (induces metabolism). Valproate ↑ levels (inhibits) → must halve dose.

Lamotrigine — כבש על trigger עם פריחה אדומה על הצמר. טיטרציה איטית! Carbamazepine ↓ רמות (induces); Valproate ↑ רמות (חצי המינון). מצב רוח. סיכון SJS.

Carbamazepine

סמלA bread maze that redraws itself overnight
למהCarb-A-Maze = CARB (bread) + Maze. Self-redrawing = auto-induction.
בפעולהCYP-induces own metabolism (auto-induction). HLA-B*1502 in Asians = SJS risk. SIADH (low sodium) = the maze fills with water.

Carbamazepine — מבוך לחם שמשרטט את עצמו מחדש מדי לילה. Carb + Maze. אוטו-אינדוקציה (CYP). HLA-B*1502 אסיינים = SJS. SIADH (היפונתרמיה).

Diazepam

סמלBackpacker in a green valley by a slow stream (DIA)
למהDiaz → Day-az → Day in a calm valley.
בפעולהLong t½ + active metabolites = pitches a tent (stays awhile). Used in alcohol withdrawal (taper agent).

Diazepam — מטייל בעמק ירוק רגוע ליד נחל איטי. Dia = day-az = יום בעמק רגוע. t½ ארוך + מטבוליטים פעילים. ב-EtOH withdrawal taper.

Alprazolam

סמלShort, fluffy alpaca with a 'high-potency' boxing glove
למהALP-acalpaca. Short fluffy = short t½, high potency.
בפעולהPanic attacks = alpaca punches the attack. Inter-dose rebound = alpaca tantrum mid-day. Avoid in adolescents = no kids around alpaca.

Alprazolam — אלפקה קטנה רכה עם כפפת אגרוף 'high-potency'. t½ קצר, potency גבוהה. פאניקה. רבאונד inter-dose. הימנע בנער/ה.

Lorazepam

סמלGrandma by the fireplace telling ancient LORE
למהLor → Lore.
בפעולהHepatic conjugation only (no oxidation) = grandma doesn't need her liver oven. Catatonia challenge = grandma jolts patient awake with a story. IV/IM/PO available.

Lorazepam — סבתא ליד האח מספרת LORE. מטבוליזם conjugation בלבד = בטוח בכבד + קשישים. Catatonia challenge. IV/IM/PO.

Clonazepam

סמלTwo identical CLONES walking together with long canes
למהClone → identical pair.
בפעולהLong t½ = canes = stable, far walking. Less rebound than Alprazolam.

Clonazepam — שני clones זהים הולכים עם מקלות ארוכים. t½ ארוך = פחות רבאונד מ-Alprazolam.

Midazolam

סמלKing MIDAS with a stopwatch — anything he touches turns rapid
למהMidaz → Midas-touch.
בפעולהRapid IM/IV/IN onset. Intranasal in pediatrics for seizures. Surgical sedation + amnesia (hits α5 vault on Floor 5).

Midazolam — מלך MIDAS עם שעון עצר. כל מה שנוגע הופך מהיר. IM/IV/IN פעולה מהירה. פדיאטרי intranasal לפרכוסים.

Phenobarbital

סמלBarbed-wire fence (BARB) encircling the Aa Hotel
למהBARB = barbed wire = barbiturate.
בפעולהKeeps the hotel doors open LONGER (↑duration). At high doses, the wire opens the hotel WITHOUT GABA → lethal.

Phenobarbital — גדר תיל ברביר סביב מלון Aa. שומר על דלתות פתוחות זמן רב יותר. מינון גבוה פותח את המלון בלי GABA → קטלני.

Flumazenil

סמלSecurity guard with the FLU — sneezing, throwing BZD partygoers out
למהFlu-mazenil → FLU. (Inspired by user.)
בפעולהCompetitive BZD antagonist. Can precipitate seizures in chronic BZD users.

Flumazenil — מאבטח עם FLU (מצונן), זורק BZD החוצה. אנטגוניסט תחרותי. עלול לעורר פרכוסים ב-BZD כרוני.

Fluoxetine

סמלGlowing fluorescent OX that walks for weeks without resting
למהFLUO-OX → fluorescent ox. Glow = long t½ (the ox is 'lit up' for weeks).
בפעולהLong t½ = ox needs slow taper or no taper. Best-tolerated in pediatric depression.

Fluoxetine — שור פלורסנטי שזוהר במשך שבועות. FLUO+OX. t½ ארוך = self-taper. הכי נסבל בילדים.

Sertraline

סמלKnight (SIR) riding on rails — straight, steady, dependable
למהSert → Sir + Train (on rails).
בפעולהBroad-spectrum SSRI. Decent first-line for PTSD.

Sertraline — אביר על מסילה (SIR-on-RAIL). רחב, יציב. SSRI ראשון ל-PTSD.

Paroxetine

סמלOx jumping out of plane with a PARAchute
למהParo → Parachute. Ox = like Fluoxetine.
בפעולהShort t½ + strong anticholinergic = parachute may fail → severe discontinuation syndrome. Most sedating SSRI. Teratogen warning (cardiac defects).

Paroxetine — שור בצניחת מצנח (PARA-chute). t½ קצר + אנטיכולינרגי חזק = discontinuation syndrome חמור. הכי מרדים. טרטוגן.

Bupropion

סמלBumper-car arena — cars colliding with high energy
למהBup → Bumper.
בפעולהNDRI = energizing (no sedation, no sexual dysfunction). Smoking cessation. ↓Seizure threshold = sparks flying when bumpers crash too hard. Avoid in eating disorders.

Bupropion — בומפר-קר באולם — מכוניות מתנגשות באנרגיה. NDRI מעורר. בלי dysfunction מיני, בלי סדציה. ↓סף פרכוסים. הימנע באכילה.

Mirtazapine

סמלPerson sitting in front of a MIRROR holding a slice of cake under a PINE tree
למהMir + tas + pine → Mirror + cake + pine. Mirror = self-reflection at night (sedation). Cake = appetite/weight gain (5-HT2C + H1 block).
בפעולהStrong H1 sedation, 5-HT2C → weight gain, 5-HT3 → antiemetic. Used in elderly with poor appetite + insomnia + nausea.

Mirtazapine — אדם עם MIRror, עוגה ועץ אורן. ראי = self-reflection (סדציה). עוגה = תיאבון (5-HT2C + H1). 5-HT3 antiemetic. קשישים עם תיאבון נמוך + נדודי שינה.

Vortioxetine

סמלWise tortoise wearing glasses, slow but multi-tasking
למהVortio → Tortoise.
בפעולהMultimodal: SERT block + 5-HT1A agonist + 5-HT3/7 antagonist + 5-HT6 antagonist (procognitive). Tortoise = slow + smart.

Vortioxetine — צב חכם עם משקפיים. רב-מודאלי: SERT + 5-HT1A agonist + 5-HT3/7 antagonist + 5-HT6 antagonist (procognitive). איטי + חכם.

Methylphenidate

סמלA love-struck teenager glued to a PHONE on a romantic DATE: hearts and hearts-eyes float around them, cheeks blushing, utterly absorbed in the phone-call/text — a self-evident 'PHONE-DATE' (no text needed; the hearts + phone read instantly)
למהPHEN→PHONE, -i-DATE→DATE: a love-struck 'phone date'. The hearts + dreamy total absorption make the pun readable WITHOUT any label. (Methylphenidate = the classic first-line ADHD stimulant.)
בפעולהDAT/NET inhibitor (blocks reuptake) → boosts focus/attention. First-line ADHD stimulant. Side effects: appetite suppression, insomnia, growth delay, ↑HR/BP; overdose → tics/EPS.

Methylphenidate — נער/ה מאוהב/ת דבוק/ה לטלפון בדייט רומנטי: לבבות וברק-עיניים מסביב, לחיים סמוקות, שקוע/ה לגמרי בשיחה — 'PHONE-DATE' ברור מעצמו (PHEN=phone, -i-date=דייט), בלי צורך בטקסט. סטימולנט קו-ראשון ב-ADHD; חוסם DAT/NET.

Amphetamine

סמלGuitar AMPlifier turned to 11 on stage
למהAMP → amplifier.
בפעולהDAT/NET inhibitor + RELEASER (extra mechanism). Stronger than Methylphenidate. Higher dependence.

Amphetamine — מגבר גיטרה מוגבר ל-11 על הבמה. AMP = amplifier. חוסם DAT/NET + RELEASER. חזק יותר מ-Methylphenidate. תלות גבוהה.

Lisdexamfetamine

סמלA LARGE BROWN PARCEL wrapped in WHITE paper printed with 'LYS' arrives at the doorstep of a friendly building marked 'LIVER SPA'. A gentle spa attendant carefully UNWRAPS the LYS paper layer by layer and folds it aside (no violence — calm unwrapping). Beneath the paper is revealed a glowing electric AMPLIFIER (AMP). The attendant plugs the amp into the wall socket and music begins to broadcast loudly across the spa. A small 'D' badge for d-amphetamine glows on the front face of the amp. A queue of other 'LYS-wrapped' parcels waits patiently outside — only the LIVER spa can unwrap them.
למהLYS = lysine wrapping paper that hides the active drug. AMP = amplifier (the active d-amphetamine). LIVER SPA = liver / red blood cell aminopeptidases that cleave the lysine. Gentle UNWRAPPING (not violent) = enzymatic pro-drug activation. The 'D' badge = d-amphetamine isomer.
בפעולהLisdexamfetamine is a PRO-DRUG: orally inactive. After absorption, red blood cell aminopeptidases (and to a lesser extent the liver) cleave the L-lysine, releasing active d-amphetamine into circulation. Slow controlled conversion gives smoother onset, ~13 hour duration, and LOWER ABUSE POTENTIAL (cannot be snorted/injected effectively — the LYS wrapping must be enzymatically cleaved). Indications: ADHD (age 6+), Binge Eating Disorder (BED) in adults. Brand: Vyvanse.

Lisdexamfetamine = פרו-תרופה. סמל: חבילה גדולה עטופה בנייר 'LYS' מגיעה ל-'LIVER SPA'. מטפלת ספא נעימה מסירה בעדינות את העטיפה (לא אלים) וחושפת אמפליפייר (AMP) עם תווית 'D'. האמפליפייר מתחבר לחשמל ומתחיל לנגן רוק. אמינו-פפטידאזות של RBC + כבד חותכים את הליסין → שחרור הדרגתי של d-amphetamine פעיל. משך פעולה ~13 שעות; פוטנציאל ניצול לרעה נמוך משחרור-מיידי. אינדיקציות: ADHD (גיל 6+), BED (מבוגרים). שם מסחרי: Vyvanse.

Atomoxetine

סמלTiny ATOMIC ox riding the fishing NET (tearing holes)
למהAtom + Ox = atomic ox. NET-specific (no DAT).
בפעולהPure NRI. No abuse potential. Slow onset (weeks). Suicidality warning.

Atomoxetine — שור-אטומי קטנטן רוכב על רשת NET וקורע בה חורים. ATOM+OX. NRI טהור (לא DAT). אין פוטנציאל התמכרות. אזהרת אובדנות.

Clonidine

סמלTwo identical CLONE handlers feeding the #2 wolf
למהClone + identical handlers = matches α2 'two wolves' scene.
בפעולהα2 agonist = lowers central NE. ADHD, tic disorders, opioid withdrawal, hypertension. Rebound hypertension if stopped abruptly.

Clonidine — שני מטפלים זהים (clones) מאכילים את הזאב #2. α2 agonist = ↓NE מרכזי. ADHD, טיקים, גמילת אופיואידים, יל"ד. רבאונד hypertension בהפסקה חדה.

Guanfacine

סמלStoic GUARD with a stone face standing over the wolf pack
למהGuan-face → Guard-face.
בפעולהα2A-selective = more PFC-specific (less sedation than Clonidine). ADHD adjunct.

Guanfacine — שומר עם פני אבן עומד מעל העדר. Guan-face = Guard-face. α2A-סלקטיבי = יותר PFC-ספציפי (פחות סדציה מ-Clonidine).

Propranolol

סמלPROfessional musician on stage — calm hands, no tremor
למהPRO + performer → performance anxiety.
בפעולהNon-selective β-block = mutes both heart drums (β1) AND wind section (β2 → bronchospasm warning). Akathisia treatment. PTSD prevention (debated). Lipophilic = crosses BBB.

Propranolol — נגן מקצועי על הבמה — ידיים יציבות, בלי רעד. PRO+performer = חרדת ביצוע. β-block לא-סלקטיבי = משתיק תופי לב (β1) וגם נשיפה (β2 — ברונכוספסם!). אקתיזיה. PTSD prevention.

Prazosin

סמלSoldier receiving PRAISE for a nightmare-free night watch
למהPraz → Praise + son.
בפעולהα1 antagonist. Tranquilizer dart to the alpha wolf #1 = it sits → orthostasis (first-dose). PTSD nightmare relief. BPH.

Prazosin — חייל מקבל praise על שמירת לילה ללא סיוטים. α1 antagonist. דארט מרגיע לזאב #1 = orthostasis (מנת-ראשון). PTSD nightmares. BPH.

Haloperidol

סמלAngel with a HALO holding a stiff DOLL (rigid as EPS)
למהHalo + doll. Rigid doll = EPS!
בפעולהHigh-potency 1st-gen = aggressive D2 barrier slam → lots of EPS pyramids around. Acute agitation IM. LAI form available (Halo-decanoate).

Haloperidol — מלאך עם הילה (HALO) מחזיק בובה קשיחה (EPS!). דור 1 פוטנטיק = חסימה אגרסיבית של D2 → המון פירמידות. Acute agitation IM. LAI זמין.

Clozapine

סמלMaster Z-key opening D4's four-bolt lock
למהclo-Z-apine = Z key. D4 affinity is unique.
בפעולהTreatment-resistant schizophrenia + reduces suicidality. Agranulocytosis = white blood cells dying → mandatory ANC monitoring. Seizures + myocarditis + drooling + weight gain + metabolic syndrome. The Z key opens many other locks too (broad receptor profile).

Clozapine — מפתח-Z מאסטר פותח את 4 הברגים של D4. סכיזופרניה עמידה + ↓אובדנות. אגרנולוציטוזה = WBC מתים → ניטור ANC חובה. פרכוסים + myocarditis + drooling + עליה במשקל + מטבולי.

Aripiprazole

סמלPizza pie with one slice RIPPED OUT (only partial)
למהA-RIP-piprazole = a rip in pizza. Partial slice = partial agonist.
בפעולהD2 partial agonist + 5-HT1A partial agonist + 5-HT2A antagonist. Less metabolic. Akathisia common. LAI available.

Aripiprazole — פיצה עם רק חצי פרוסה חתוכה (A-RIP). Partial agonist של D2 + 5-HT1A; antagonist של 5-HT2A. פחות מטבולי. אקתיזיה שכיחה. LAI זמין.

Cariprazine

סמלPerson CARRYING a 'Praise' trophy to the limbic heart
למהCarry + Praise. Trophy goes to heart-shaped (limbic) chamber = D3 selectivity.
בפעולהD3 > D2 partial agonist. Schizophrenia + bipolar depression + mixed states. Akathisia.

Cariprazine — דמות נושאת גביע 'Praise' אל הלב-לימבי. Carry+Praise. D3>D2 partial agonist. סכיזופרניה + דיכאון בביפולר + מצבים מעורבים. אקתיזיה.

Lurasidone

סמלFisherman with a LURE off the side of a boat — best taken WITH 350+ kcal meal
למהLure → fisherman. 'On the side' = food requirement.
בפעולהBipolar depression + schizophrenia. Low metabolic burden. 5-HT7 antagonist (turning off 7-Eleven at night).

Lurasidone — דייג עם פיתיון בצד הסירה — לקחת עם ארוחה של 350+ kcal. Lure + side. דיכאון בביפולר + סכיזופרניה. נטל מטבולי נמוך. 5-HT7 antagonist (מכבה 7-Eleven בלילה).

Quetiapine

סמלQUIET pine tree under which everyone naps
למהQuiet + pine. Quiet = sedation.
בפעולהMost sedating 2nd-gen (H1 + α1 block). Off-label for insomnia (low dose). Weight gain. Metabolic. Bipolar depression.

Quetiapine — אורן שקט (QUIET-pine) שכולם נמנמים תחתיו. הכי מרדים בדור 2 (H1 + α1 block). off-label לאינסומניה (מינון נמוך). עליה במשקל. מטבולי. דיכאון בביפולר.

Olanzapine

סמלOLYMPIAN athlete sleeping under a pine, surrounded by OLIVES
למהOl-Lan-Z-A-Pine = Olympic-Land-Z-Pine. Olive = oil = metabolic.
בפעולהMaximum metabolic burden (weight gain, dyslipidemia, T2DM). Strong sedation. Acute agitation IM (avoid IM with BZDs = respiratory depression!). LAI = post-injection syndrome warning.

Olanzapine — אתלט אולימפי ישן תחת אורן, סביבו זיתים שמנים. OL+LAN+Z+PINE. הנטל המטבולי המקסימלי (משקל, דיסליפידמיה, T2DM). סדציה חזקה. Acute agitation IM (לא משולב עם BZD!). LAI = post-injection syndrome.

Ketamine

סמלVeterinary HORSE-tranquilizer dart wedged into NMDA door
למהKetamine is famous as 'horse tranquilizer' in vet medicine.
בפעולהOpen-channel NMDA antagonist. Rapid-acting antidepressant (hours), treatment-resistant MDD, acute suicidality. Dissociation, BP↑, K-hole. IV/IM/IN.

Ketamine — דארט וטרינרי 'horse tranquilizer' תקוע בדלת NMDA. Open-channel NMDA antagonist. אנטי-דיכאוני מהיר (שעות), TRD, אובדנות חריפה. דיסוסיאציה, BP↑, K-hole. IV/IM/IN.

Esketamine

סמלSame horse-dart, but labeled 'S' on the forehead
למהS-enantiomer of ketamine.
בפעולהIntranasal, on-label for TRD. REMS program required.

Esketamine — אותו דארט-סוס עם תווית 'S' על המצח. S-enantiomer של ketamine. Intranasal, on-label ל-TRD. REMS program נדרש.

Memantine

סמלOld grandmother (Mama-tine) with a cane — only blocks the rudest guests
למהMama-tine → Mama. Patient/lenient.
בפעולהUse-dependent low-affinity NMDA antagonist. Off-label pediatric: autism aggression, OCD.

Memantine — סבתא זקנה (Mama-tine) עם מקל — חוסמת רק את האורחים הכי גסים. Use-dependent low-affinity NMDA antagonist. ילדים off-label: תוקפנות באוטיזם, OCD.

Naloxone

סמלA NAIL knocking out a bull (OX-Knock-Out-Zone)
למהNal-Ox-One → Nail + Ox + KO. Knocks out opioid effect.
בפעולהμ-opioid antagonist. Intranasal/IM/IV for overdose reversal. Short t½ — may need re-dosing. Precipitates withdrawal.

Naloxone — מסמר נוקאאוט-OX (NAIL+OX+KO). אנטגוניסט μ. אינטרא-נזלי/IM/IV ל-overdose. t½ קצר — ייתכן צורך במנה חוזרת. מעורר withdrawal.

Methadone

סמלMafia DON in a controlled clinic dispensing milk to his cows
למהMethadone → Meth + a + Don.
בפעולהLong-acting full μ-agonist. Once-daily OUD maintenance (clinic-controlled, federally regulated). QTc prolongation.

Methadone — Don של מאפיה ב-clinic מבוקרת, מחלק חלב לפרות שלו. אגוניסט μ ארוך-טווח. פעם ביום ל-OUD maintenance. QTc.

Buprenorphine

סמלCar BUMPER that only partially crashes into the door
למהBup → Bumper. Partial.
בפעולהPartial μ-agonist + κ-antagonist. Ceiling effect on respiratory depression. OUD maintenance. Combined with naloxone (Suboxone) = oral safety.

Buprenorphine — בומפר שרק חצי מתנגש בדלת. אגוניסט μ חלקי + κ-antagonist. Ceiling effect לדיכוי נשימה. OUD maintenance. עם Naloxone (Suboxone).

Disulfiram

סמלSulfur-smelly RAM that follows you to the bar — you drink, you stink
למהDisulf + Ram → sulfur ram.
בפעולהALDH inhibitor. Drinking alcohol = acetaldehyde build-up = severe nausea, flushing, vomiting. CYP-2E1/3A4 inhibitor (DDI risk). Hepatotoxic.

Disulfiram — תיש סולפר ('disulf+RAM') שמדיף ביצים מקולקלות. ALDH inhibitor. שתיית EtOH = הצטברות אצטאלדהיד = בחילה חמורה. CYP2E1/3A4 inhibitor. Hepatotoxic.

Varenicline

סמלSmoker holding a HALF-smoked cigarette — can't get the full hit
למהHalf cigarette = partial agonist of α4β2. (No brand reference.)
בפעולהα4β2 nAChR partial agonist. Enough activation to ease craving, BLOCKS full nicotine reward → smoking cessation. Inserts onto the '42' cigarette in CIGARETTE_THEATER.

Varenicline — מעשן מחזיק חצי-סיגריה — לא מקבל hit מלא. α4β2 nAChR partial agonist. ↓craving + ↓nicotine reward. נצמד לסיגריית '42' ב-CIGARETTE_THEATER.

Morphine

סמלGreek statue with a face that MORPHS into serene calm — labeled 'FINE'
למהMorph + fine.
בפעולהFull μ-agonist gold standard. Analgesia + euphoria + respiratory depression + constipation + miosis. The original opioid milker at the DAIRY_FARM cow.

Morphine — פסל יווני שמשנה צורה לפנים רגועות (MORPH+fine). אגוניסט μ זהב סטנדרט. אנלגזיה + אופוריה + דיכוי נשימה + עצירות + מיוזה.

Fentanyl

סמלSkyscraper PENTHOUSE on the top floor — extremely high-up view
למהFent → 'Penthouse' (high-rise potency).
בפעולה100× more potent than morphine. Surgical anesthesia, chronic-pain patches. Illicit fentanyl drives the overdose epidemic — tiny dose lethal.

Fentanyl — פנטהאוז בקומה העליונה (Fent → Penthouse). פוטנטיות 100x מורפין. אנסטזיה, מדבקות לכאב כרוני. הוגנב לצח רחוב = מגיפת אובר-דוז.

Oxycodone

סמלPatient wearing an OXYGEN mask, beeper showing 'CODE-RED' (respiratory code)
למהOxy + Code → oxygen-code (respiratory failure).
בפעולהSemi-synthetic μ-agonist. Oral. High abuse potential. Part of the OxyContin abuse epidemic.

Oxycodone — מטופל במסכת חמצן + בייפר 'CODE-RED' (קוד נשימתי). Oxy+Code = oxygen-code. אגוניסט μ סינתטי-חצי. פוטנציאל התמכרות גבוה.

Codeine

סמלCoded message scroll being deciphered
למהCode-ine = code.
בפעולהProdrug → activated to morphine by CYP2D6. Cough suppressant + mild analgesic. CYP2D6 ultra-rapid metabolizers (5-10% of population, higher in some ethnicities) → high morphine levels = pediatric deaths reported (FDA contraindicated <12y for cough).

Codeine — מגילה מקודדת מתפענחת. Prodrug → morphine דרך CYP2D6. נוגד שיעול + אנלגזיה מתונה. CYP2D6 Ultra-Rapid = רמות מורפין גבוהות = מוות פדיאטרי (FDA contraindicated <12).

Tramadol

סמלTRAM pulling a small DOLL down the street
למהTram + a + doll.
בפעולהWeak μ-agonist + SNRI (serotonin syndrome risk when combined with SSRIs/MAOIs!). Lowers seizure threshold. Prodrug via CYP2D6 (like Codeine).

Tramadol — חשמלית-tram מובילה בובה קטנה. אגוניסט μ חלש + SNRI (סיכון serotonin syndrome!). ↓סף פרכוסים. Prodrug דרך CYP2D6.

Heroin

סמלFake HERO costume with a syringe sticking out of the cape (HERO-IN)
למהHero-in.
בפעולהDiacetylmorphine — lipophilic, crosses BBB rapidly → intense euphoric rush. Illicit. Major source of overdose deaths.

Heroin — תחפושת hero מזויפת עם מזרק תקוע בקייפ (HERO-IN). דיאצטילמורפין. ליפופילי, חוצה BBB מהר → rush. מקור עיקרי למוות מ-OD.

Atropine

סמלTROPICAL tourist in shorts, sun-hat, holding a piña colada (A-tropic vacation)
למהA-tropine → tropic. Vacation = far from cholinergic norms.
בפעולהNon-selective muscarinic antagonist. Wonderland goes wild → antichol syndrome. Clinical uses: symptomatic bradycardia, organophosphate poisoning, pre-op secretion drying, mydriasis (ophthalmology).

Atropine — תייר טרופי עם מכנסיים קצרים, כובע שמש, פיניה קולדה. A-tropine = tropic vacation. אנטגוניסט מוסקריני לא-סלקטיבי. Wonderland יוצא משליטה. שימושים: ברדיקרדיה, OP poisoning, מידריאזה.

Scopolamine

סמלPirate with a teleSCOPE scanning the horizon for ships
למהScope → telescope.
בפעולהCrosses BBB → motion sickness patch + amnesia (historical 'truth serum'). Anti-emetic for post-op nausea.

Scopolamine — פיראט עם טלסקופ (Scope). מדבקה למחלת תנועה + אמנזיה (truth serum היסטורי). Anti-emetic פוסט-ניתוחי.

Benztropine

סמלPatient with a BENT-over back and SPRAINED wrist (Bent-Sprain) — relieved when given anticholinergic
למהBent + Sprain.
בפעולהM1 + H1 antagonist. FIRST-LINE for acute dystonia (IM 1-2mg = the iconic emergency-psych intervention). Drug-induced parkinsonism. Long t½ — once-daily.

Benztropine — מטופל עם גב כפוף ויד פרוקה (Bent+Sprain) — קובל אחרי אנטיכולינרגי. M1+H1 antagonist. קו ראשון לדיסטוניה אקוטית IM 1-2mg. פרקינסוניזם תרופתי.

Trihexyphenidyl

סמלSpinning idol made of a TRIangle + HEXagon + PHENyl ring
למהTri + Hex + Phenyl + Idyl.
בפעולהOral anticholinergic for drug-induced parkinsonism + dystonia. Less sedating than Benztropine.

Trihexyphenidyl — אליל מסתובב משולש+משושה+phenyl ring. Tri+Hex+Phenyl+Idyl. אנטיכולינרגי PO לפרקינסוניזם תרופתי.

Diphenhydramine

סמלMulti-headed HYDRA biting both Wonderland (M1) AND the Histamine House Floor 1 (H1)
למהHydra = multi-receptor (H1 + M1).
בפעולהOTC sleep aid + anti-allergy. IM 25-50mg for acute dystonia (alternative to Benztropine). Anticholinergic side effects in elderly → cognitive impairment.

Diphenhydramine — היידרה רב-ראשית שנושכת גם ב-Wonderland (M1) וגם בבית-H קומה 1 (H1). OTC sleep aid + anti-allergy. IM 25-50 מ"ג לדיסטוניה אקוטית. אנטיכולינרגי בקשישים → cognitive impairment.

Hydroxyzine

סמלSleepy guest in the H-House Floor 1 living room with a 'Zzz' bubble — no IV bag (not addictive)
למהHydroxy-zine → ends in 'zine' = sleep.
בפעולהH1 antagonist anxiolytic. Pediatric anxiety, pre-op anxiety, pruritus. NON-ADDICTIVE alternative to BZDs (no GABA action).

Hydroxyzine — אורח ישנוני בקומה 1 של בית-H עם בועת 'Zzz'. H1 antagonist anxiolytic. חרדת ילדים, פרה-מד. NON-ADDICTIVE (אין פעולה ב-GABA).

Pitolisant

סמלAlarm clock RINGING in Floor 3 study — wakes the H3 professor
למהPit-Olisant → wakes the H3 professor.
בפעולהH3 inverse agonist. FDA-approved for narcolepsy + excessive daytime sleepiness. Non-stimulant alternative to modafinil.

Pitolisant — שעון מעורר שצועק בקומה 3 (חדר עבודה) — מעיר את הפרופסור H3. Inverse agonist. אישור ל-narcolepsy + EDS. אלטרנטיבה לא-ממריצה ל-modafinil.

Dextromethorphan

סמלOld cough-syrup bottle labeled 'D' — sometimes drunk recreationally by teens
למהDex → D-shape bottle.
בפעולהNMDA antagonist + σ1 agonist + cough suppressant. Recreational dissociative ('robotripping') at high doses. With quinidine (CYP2D6 inhibitor → ↑DXM levels) used for pseudobulbar affect.

Dextromethorphan — בקבוק סירופ שיעול עתיק עם תווית 'D' — נשתה רקריאציונלית. NMDA antagonist + σ1 agonist + נוגד שיעול. 'Robotripping' במינון גבוה. עם quinidine = pseudobulbar affect.

Valbenazine

סמלThief stealing the V-MAT yoga mat — once a day
למהVal → mat-grabber.
בפעולהVMAT2 inhibitor. FDA-approved for tardive dyskinesia. Once-daily dosing.

Valbenazine — גנב שגונב את מזרון V-MAT — שוד פעם ביום. VMAT2 inhibitor. אישור ל-TD. פעם ביום.

Deutetrabenazine

סמלSame V-MAT thief, but with DEUTERIUM-armor (doubled hydrogens = slower clearance)
למהDeute → deuterium.
בפעולהDeuterated → longer t½ than tetrabenazine. BID. TD + Huntington's chorea + Tourette's. Better tolerated than original tetrabenazine.

Deutetrabenazine — אותו גנב V-MAT אבל בשריון דאוטריום (כפל-מימן = פינוי איטי יותר). t½ ארוך יותר מ-tetrabenazine. BID. TD + Huntington + Tourette.

Tetrabenazine

סמלOld-school V-MAT thief — works, but his victims become depressed afterward
למהTetra → older generation.
בפעולהOriginal VMAT2 inhibitor. Huntington's chorea. BLACK BOX: depression + suicidality. CYP2D6-dosed.

Tetrabenazine — גנב V-MAT הישן — עובד, אבל קורבנותיו הופכים מדוכאים. VMAT2 inhibitor הראשון. Huntington chorea. Black box: דיכאון/אובדנות. CYP2D6-dosed.

Fluvoxamine

סמלSinger with a FLU-affected VOice at the S-1 guard post, intrusive OCD lyrics
למהFlu + Vox + amine. Voice problems = OCD intrusive thoughts.
בפעולהSSRI + strong σ1 agonist (UNIQUE among SSRIs — explains OCD/anxiety efficacy). FIRST-LINE pediatric OCD. CYP1A2 inhibitor → ↑clozapine, theophylline, caffeine levels.

Fluvoxamine — זמרת עם FLU-voice (קול מצונן) בעמדת ה-S-1, שירים אובססיביים. SSRI + σ1 agonist חזק (ייחודי בקרב SSRI — מסביר את עוצמתה ב-OCD/חרדה). קו ראשון פדיאטרי ב-OCD. מעכב CYP1A2 → ↑clozapine, theophylline, caffeine.

יונים ואביזרים קבועים

30 אביזרים שחוזרים בכל סצנה

Mg2+

סמלHorseshoe magnet labeled 'Mg'
למהMg = Magnet (both start with M). Magnetic block of NMDA = literal magnet on the door.
מופיע בNMDA channel (block), Many enzyme co-factors

מגנט פרסה. Mg = Magnesium = מגנט (אותה אות M). חוסם NMDA במנוחה.

Ca2+

סמלChalk-white VIP guest with '2+' lapel pin
למהCa = Calcium = chalk (calcareous). 2+ = the divalent charge as a name-badge.
מופיע בNMDA (afflux), Voltage-gated Ca channels, Vesicle release

אורחים מסויידים-לבנים עם תגית '2+'. Ca = סידן = chalk (גיר). 2+ = המטען החיובי.

Cl-

סמלGreen-skinned soldier carrying a '−' minus-shield
למהCl = Chlorine (green gas in WWI). Minus shield = the negative charge.
מופיע בGABA-A (influx → hyperpolarization), Glycine receptor, Some Cl-channels

חיילים ירוקים עם מגן '−'. Cl = chlorine = הגז הירוק במלחמת העולם הראשונה. נכנס לתעלת GABA-A → היפרפולריזציה.

Na+

סמלSoldier wearing white SALT crystals with '+' epaulets
למהNa = Sodium = salt. + epaulets = positive charge.
מופיע בAMPA/Kainate (excitatory influx), Voltage-gated Na channels, Nicotinic AChR

חיילים עם גבישי מלח לבנים ו-'+'. Na = sodium = מלח. עיקרי בתעלות AMPA, nAChR.

K+

סמלYellow banana with '+' sticker
למהK = Potassium = banana (high-potassium food). + = positive charge.
מופיע בRepolarization (K+ efflux), GABA-B (K-channel opens), Resting potential

בננות צהובות עם '+' . K = potassium = banana (עשירה בקליום). זרימה החוצה → ריפולריזציה.

D2_blockadeמקורפוס Sketchy

אביזרa two-strand rope snapping apart
למהtwo strands = D2; snapping = blockade

H1_blockadeמקורפוס Sketchy

למהthe bee is histamine; swatting it is the block

agranulocytosisמקורפוס Sketchy

למהcounts running down — the weekly blood count

למהone candle = alpha-1; blown out = antagonist

epsמקורפוס Sketchy

למהthe tail that takes forever to end

maoi_classמקורפוס Sketchy

למהMAO ~ mouse; the trap is the irreversible inhibition

neuropathic_painמקורפוס Sketchy

norepinephrineמקורפוס Sketchy

למהliteral depiction, never an invented symbol

panic_disorderמקורפוס Sketchy

למהan artwork that already depicts the fact

parkinsonismמקורפוס Sketchy

למהcogwheel rigidity, drawn as the word says

ptsdמקורפוס Sketchy

למהthe acronym split across two tags

serotoninמקורפוס Sketchy

siadhמקורפוס Sketchy

למהthe acronym lettered on the jug

social_anxietyמקורפוס Sketchy

למהliteral depiction

מקום לכל פרק

144 שלטים ומשחקי מילים, אחד לכל פרק

1. C.A.P. VEHICLE TESTINGראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקPsychiatric examination of child and adolescent
משחק המילים'C.A.P.' directly embeds the medical acronym for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the specialty governing pediatric mental health examinations.
המקוםA vast municipal vehicle testing hall smelling of diesel exhaust and brake dust, lit by suspended high-bay mercury vapor lamps. Heavy commercial lorries stand parked in sequential bays over sunken inspection pits, while pneumatic airline hoses drop from overhead steel trusses. Yellow pedestrian walkway stripes border the reinforced concrete floor.
מה כולם עושיםEvery vehicle examiner is guiding lorry axles onto hydraulic shaker plates using illuminated orange marshalling wands.
מבנה מרכזיA sixty-foot steel roller-brake testing bed with diagonal yellow guide rails cutting across the inspection hall floor from bottom-left to top-right.

2. INSULA FERRIESמבנה מרחבי

פרקNeuroanatomy basics for psychiatry
משחק המיליםInsula is the ordinary Latin for island and a wholly plausible name for a small ferry company, so the fascia spends its lettering on a word whose real job in this building is naming the destination, while the terminal's ordinary plan does the anatomy: two mirror-image wings joined by a single enclosed bridge, one glazed tower every vehicle and vessel must be routed through, and a ramp trimmed continuously to hold the deck level with the quay.
המקוםA small car-ferry terminal on the mainland side at midday: two identical passenger wings either side of the vehicle marshalling lanes, one enclosed footbridge crossing above them, a glazed signal tower on the quay, and the counterweighted linkspan ramp running down onto the ship. The island lies out across the water and is named on every board in the building.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is boarding the midday sailing - queueing at the ticket window, waiting to be waved forward one lane at a time, walking the footbridge with a case, driving up the ramp onto the deck.
מבנה מרכזיThe linkspan: the long counterweighted steel ramp bridging quay to ship, cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right and splitting it into concourse, marshalling lanes, ramp and open water.

3. MESSENGER ROWתמונה מילולית

פרקNeurotransmitters overview
משחק המיליםA neurotransmitter is a chemical messenger and MESSENGER ROW is an ordinary hand-lettered street nameplate that carries one morpheme of the plain-English referent without printing the medical word — the p272 device, inside the Lithium Lift precedent — and the parade is the only mundane container that holds a pit, a hotel, a dairy, a club door, a weaving workshop, a newsagent and a police box at one light source; the delivery round then supplies the mechanism free, because release is a crate carried in off the lorry and reuptake is the same hand carrying the empties back out to be loaded, and each premises signs for its own crate so every messenger stays addressable at its own doorway.
המקוםA colliery village's sea parade on delivery morning: one unbroken terrace of small businesses down the near side, the pit gates and winding gear closing the landward head of the road, the five-storey hotel closing the seaward end with the beach and railing beyond it, delivery lorries nosed into the kerb with their tailgates down and crates stacked out on the flags at every doorway.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is taking in the morning delivery — lifting crates down off the lorries at the kerb, wheeling sack-trucks in through the doorways, signing the docket on the driver's board, and carrying the empties back out to be loaded up again.
מבנה מרכזיThe unbroken run of shopfront fascias with the kerb and gutter line beneath them, running from the lower left of the frame up to the pit gates at the top right, splitting the picture into pavement, roadway, shopfronts and the upper windows above them.

4. DOPA MINE No.4משחק צליל

פרקDopamine pathways
משחק המיליםDOPAMINE splits as DOPA + MINE, and collieries genuinely carry numbered pithead boards ('Pit No. 4'), so the sign is a real place name that also counts the four pathways. Four hand-boarded gallery mouths off one shaft = four tracts from one cell-body region; the winding ropes everywhere honour the fixed corpus lexicon rope = dopamine at no extra cost
המקוםThe pithead of a working deep coal mine at shift change: a steel headframe over the shaft, a lamp room, and four hand-boarded gallery mouths opening off the inclined haulage way below
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working a mining shift — collecting a lamp check, riding the cage down, pushing tubs of coal out along the galleries
מבנה מרכזיThe inclined haulage way with its rails and standing tubs, running lower-left to upper-right, with the headframe and winding wheel rising over its head

5. SIR TONY'S COLD STORAGEמשחק צליל

פרקSerotonin system
משחק המילים'Sir Tony's' is a direct phonetic pun on 'serotonin', the monoamine neurotransmitter system governing mood, sleep, and appetite.
המקוםA cavernous, sub-zero distribution warehouse where dense vapor mist hangs in the freezing air under high-bay sodium floodlights. Massive rows of galvanized pallet racking stretch to the insulated ceiling, loaded with shrink-wrapped frozen stock. Heavy automated air curtains hiss above the industrial rapid-roll freezer doors along the concrete walls.
מה כולם עושיםEvery warehouse operative in a thermal freezer suit is scanning frozen carton barcodes using handheld laser terminals.
מבנה מרכזיA thirty-foot insulated glycol cooling evaporator unit with diagonal coolant feed pipes cutting across the ceiling from bottom-left to top-right.

6. NOR'EAST PINES BANDSTANDמשחק צליל

פרקNorepinephrine system
משחק המיליםNor'east is how a compass NE is said aloud and a perfectly ordinary name for a plantation and the bandstand in it, so the largest lettering slot hooks straight onto the N-E glyph the course already fixes for this transmitter without printing a syllable of the drug word.
המקוםA forestry-estate bandstand on a snowy afternoon an hour before the winter concert: a timber acoustic shell open onto a fan of numbered folding chairs, the pine plantation standing close on three sides, a gravel track running back to the estate gate, and a stage door in the boarded rear wall of the shell with the instrument cases stacked beside it. A brazier is going at the edge of the seating and the snow is being swept off the chair backs.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is setting the concert up - carrying chairs out in stacks and squaring them into rows, clipping the row numbers on, tuning, sweeping the seats, and carrying the empty cases back in through the stage door.
מבנה מרכזיThe band shell: the shingled timber acoustic hood over the platform, running from the lower left of the frame up to the treeline at the upper right and splitting it into seating fan, platform, backstage yard and pines.

7. GABBAY & GLUCK REPAIRSמשחק צליל

פרקGABA / Glutamate balance
משחק המיליםGABBAY and GLUCK are two ordinary surnames lettered on one family repair-shop fascia the way such shops really are signed, GABBAY carrying GABA and GLUCK carrying glu-tamate, so the chapter's two halves stand named in balance in the largest lettering slot without either word being printed - and the trade's own price list calls the standard job a SOLE & HEEL BALANCE.
המקוםA shoe-repair and key bar in the ground-floor unit of an old five-storey hotel, late afternoon: a counter across the front, the long finishing bench behind it, a floor-to-ceiling rack of ticketed shoes standing in pairs, and the key board hung by the till. The hotel's fascia and its five ranks of windows stand above the shop sign, and the club's heavy iron doorway is hard against the shop window in the next unit along.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is handing in or collecting a repair - a ticket torn in half across the counter, a pair lifted down off the rack by its number, a heel held up to be priced, a blank held against a key to be matched.
מבנה מרכזיThe finishing machine: the long belt-driven bench of buffing wheels, brushes and the stitcher, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting it into counter, bench, shoe rack and the doorway onto the street.

8. CRAWL & CRUISEתמונה מילולית

פרקNormative development 0-2 (infancy)
משחק המיליםCRAWLING and CRUISING are the two motor milestones of the first two years and both are ordinary English words, so a group banner hand-painted CRAWL & CRUISE reads as the perfectly normal name toddler groups genuinely trade under while printing no part of the topic — the p272 device — and the weighing session was chosen over a play barn because it puts every figure in the frame at the same ordinary task with a baby in front of them, gives the numbers a carrier whose real job is bearing digits (pan scale, brass weights, centile crosses, ages in months), and keeps the hall free of climbing frames and steps so that the chapter's one required ladder is the only ladder in the picture.
המקוםThe weekly baby-and-toddler session in a hired drill hall on a wet weekday morning: crash mats unrolled end to end down the middle of the floor, gym benches pushed back to the walls, the health visitor's trestle and pan scale set across the top end, and the buggy park jammed into the porch. The hall runs up to the roof trusses, and the far end is boarded off where the high windows are being repainted.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is getting a baby weighed and the figure written in the book — undressing one on the mat, holding one over the pan scale, waiting on the mats with the red book open, queueing at the trestle.
מבנה מרכזיThe run of crash mats and low gym benches laid end to end down the hall, with the stack of folded spare mats standing at its head, carrying from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the room into porch and buggy park, mat floor, weighing trestle and the boarded-off end under the high windows.

9. LITTLE SPROUTS NURSERYמשחק צליל

פרקNormative development 2-5 (preschool)
משחק המיליםNURSERY is a straight homonym — preschool and plant nursery are the same word, which is the strongest kind of hook and needs no distortion to read as a real business name. The trade then supplies the content free: graded trays are the milestone bands, rows of identical pots standing side by side but never touching are parallel play, pruning shears are fine-motor cutting, pencilled plant labels are naming/vocabulary, and the HARDENING OFF cold frame outside the door is separation
המקוםA plant nursery's polytunnel on a warm spring morning: a long potting bench down the middle, graded seed trays in four sizes, staff and customers potting seedlings on, a cold frame propped open outside the door
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is potting on seedlings — knocking plants out of small pots into bigger ones, writing pencil labels, watering in
מבנה מרכזיThe long timber potting bench running the length of the polytunnel on a diagonal, with the tunnel's hooped ribs arching over it

10. OLD SCHOOL AQUARIUMמשחק צליל

פרקNormative development 6-12 (school age)
משחק המיליםSCHOOL age is drawn as a school of fish — a plain homonym, and 'Old School Aquarium' reads as a real attraction name. The peer facts then need no metaphor: the big shoal tank of hundreds of identical fish all turning together IS peer conformity, one fish kept apart in its own tank is the rejected child, the screwed-on NO TAPPING THE GLASS plate is rule-based moral development, and the visiting class's clipboards are the academic-skills band
המקוםThe shoal gallery of a municipal aquarium during a class visit: a curved acrylic viewing tunnel, a run of lit tanks along one wall, wet floor, a keeper up a step-ladder with a feed bucket
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is touring the gallery and filling in the worksheet — pressing up to the glass, ticking clipboards, being counted at the tunnel mouth
מבנה מרכזיThe curved acrylic viewing tunnel driving from the lower-left of the frame to the upper-right, with the run of lit tanks banked along its wall

11. TANNER'S LEATHER WORKSמשחק צליל

פרקNormative development 13-18 (adolescence)
משחק המילים'Tanner's' directly puns on the Tanner Stages (1 to 5) that categorize pubertal physical development during adolescence.
המקוםA heavy industrial tanning shed smelling of pungent vegetable tannins and wet hide, lit by daylight through open-sided timber clerestory louvers. Rows of deep sunken concrete tanning pits are arranged in sequential stages across the flagstone floor. Stacks of salted raw cattle hides on heavy oak skids sit beneath the overhead gantry rails.
מה כולם עושיםEvery tanner on the floor is plunging and hauling wet cowhides through the tannin vats using long ash-wood poles.
מבנה מרכזיA seventy-foot diagonal overhead timber drying beam hung with heavy russet hides that spans the upper yard from bottom-left to top-right.

12. BOWLBY & SONS ATTACHMENTSמשחק צליל

פרקAttachment theory and mentalization
משחק המיליםATTACHMENT is a homonym — the shop literally sells attachments — and 'Bowlby & Sons' is both the theorist's name and the most ordinary ironmonger form there is. Four fittings carded on the pegboard give the four patterns their own prop family (SECURE FIT / AVOIDS DUST / CLINGS ON / TANGLES), the dog lead clipped to the rail outside the open door is the secure base, and mentalization is the shop's real service: a repairman with his ear against a machine working out what is going on inside it, under a card reading WE FIND WHAT'S INSIDE
המקוםA cramped old ironmonger that sells vacuum, hose and power-tool attachments: a floor-to-ceiling pegboard wall of fittings, a long wooden repair counter with a bell, a bank of small labelled drawers, a dog tied to the rail outside the open door
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is matching an attachment to a machine — holding a fitting up against a hose, queuing at the repair counter, rummaging the drawers
מבנה מרכזיThe long wooden repair counter running lower-left to upper-right, backed the whole way by the pegboard wall of hanging attachments

13. THOS. & CHESS COTS & PRAMSמשחק צליל

פרקTemperament
משחק המיליםThos. is the standard trade abbreviation of Thomas and THOS. & CHESS letters up as a two-partner family firm exactly the way half a high street does — the Château Tyramine device, where the proprietors' names ARE the chapter's two authors — and the diagnosis word is never spent.
