The trade was moved off the pet shop because the fixed token is three babies in cribs and a pet shop cannot hold them, whereas this shop's whole floor is cribs with babies being tried in them; and goodness of fit is literally what the shop sells, matching a cot, a pram and a household to each other with a mock car boot and a door-width frame standing on the floor to prove the fit. Temperament to adult personality is the convertible cot-bed shown half made up as a cot and half as a bed, the same article grown, and the nine dimensions are the nine numbered lines on every spec card.
המקוםA nursery goods shop on a Saturday morning: a double-tier run of display cots and cot-beds down the middle of the floor with spec cards tied to every rail, a rank of prams and pushchairs along the window, a mock car boot and a door-width test frame at the back of the shop, and a counter with the order pad and the delivery diary open on it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is trying the goods out — laying a baby down in a display cot and standing back to watch, rocking a moses basket with one foot, folding and unfolding a pushchair, wheeling one into the mock boot to see whether it goes in, and reading the spec card tied to the rail.
מבנה מרכזיThe double-tier run of display cots and cot-beds down the centre of the shop, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, dividing the floor into the pram rank at the window, the cot run, the fitting-out corner with the mock boot and test frame, and the counter.

14. PERSONAL INKמשחק צליל

פרקGeneral Personality Disorder criteria
משחק המיליםPERSONAL is the first morpheme of personality on a shop name that is completely real ('Personal Ink' is a plausible tattoo studio), and INK carries the DSM general criteria without a word of clinical text: a tattoo is enduring, inflexible, pervasive across every situation the wearer walks into, and it begins in late adolescence. The three lettered flash cabinets 'A', 'B', 'C' are the three clusters and each holds its own house style — odd and eccentric designs in A, loud dramatic designs in B, timid apologetic designs in C. Criterion 'not better explained by a transient state' is the CONTRAST_PAIR built into the shop's own furniture: the wash-off henna and transfer counter by the window versus the permanent chairs at the back. 'NO REFUNDS ON PERSONALISED WORK' by the till is the tagline slot and carries stability/duration plus ego-syntonicity; the long laser-removal price list carries how slow and partial change is.
המקוםA small high-street tattoo parlour mid-afternoon: three curtained booths, reclining vinyl chairs, flash sheets papering every wall, a glass counter with a till and a portfolio chained to it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is getting or giving a tattoo — sitting for outlines, holding stencils against skin, wiping, wrapping in cling film, waiting on the bench with a numbered ticket.
מבנה מרכזיThe wall of framed flash sheets with the steel instrument-trolley rail beneath it, running lower-left to upper-right, the row of reclined chairs ranged along its base.

15. EUTHYMIC FALLS WEATHERתמונה מילולית

פרקMood, affect, and temperament — clinical assessment
משחק המיליםThe teaching definition already is the picture: affect is the weather, mood is the climate. The venue therefore ships the whole chapter off its own instruments with nothing invented. Cross-sectional versus longitudinal is the barograph — one instantaneous needle reading against the week-long ink trace on the rotating drum, side by side on the same bench. Range of affect is the max/min thermometer, an instrument whose only job is to record a range. Lability is the aneroid barometer faceplate lettered 'STORMY · CHANGE · FAIR' with the needle swinging. Congruence is the observer whose logged figure does not match the instrument he is standing at. Cultural considerations are the wall map with pin flags over other regions, where 'fair' means a different reading. 'Euthymic Falls' is the place-name device — a real-sounding small-town station name that happens to be the baseline mood term, the Chateau Tyramine move.
המקוםA municipal weather field office at the hourly observation round: a mown instrument enclosure behind a low picket fence, a white louvered screen on legs, a brick hut with the door propped open, bright flat noon light.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is taking the observation round — reading instruments, calling figures across, writing on clipboard log sheets, changing the recorder drum, walking the balloon out.
מבנה מרכזיThe white louvered Stevenson screen on its splayed legs with the anemometer mast and its guy-wires slicing the frame from lower-left to upper-right.

16. PHARM LANE KARTSמשחק צליל

פרקPrinciples of pediatric psychopharmacology
משחק המיליםPHARM is the bare morpheme of pharmacology on a name that reads as an ordinary rural address ('Pharm Lane'), and the venue supplies the doctrine off stock furniture. The gantry banner 'START LOW · GO SLOW' takes the largest lettering slot, so the biggest string on the page is a principle rather than the venue name. Titration is the throttle restrictor plate a marshal is fitting. Weight-based mg/kg dosing is the paddock weigh-in scale with brass weights, and the height gauge at the gate is the size limit. The black-box warning is the marshal's BLACK FLAG in the flag rack beside the yellow and the chequered — a track's flags already are a graded safety language. Off-label use is the kart whose sponsor decal has been peeled off with a hand-lettered 'NO LABEL' card taped over the bare panel. Monitoring is the pit board 'PIT EVERY 3 LAPS', the growth chart in the first-aid hut and the blood-pressure cuff on its hook.
המקוםAn outdoor children's go-kart track on a bright weekday: a tarmac circuit hemmed by stacked tyre walls, a steel start gantry, a paddock of small karts, a pit lane and a marshal's post.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is running a kids' karting session — strapping in, driving the circuit, marshalling flags at the posts, weighing in at the paddock, working the pit lane.
מבנה מרכזיThe stacked tyre-wall barrier curving from lower-left to upper-right, with the steel start/finish gantry straddling it overhead.

17. ADDIE'S AUTO ELECTRICALמשחק צליל

פרקADHD — core
משחק המילים'ADDie's' phonetically puns on ADD (Attention Deficit Disorder), the core foundational acronym of ADHD.
המקוםA busy commercial auto-electrical workshop smelling of rosin solder and ozone, lit by fluorescent battens suspended over steel-topped workbenches. Component test benches with spinning alternator rigs line the perimeter walls alongside battery charging racks. Vehicle wiring looms in corrugated conduit hang from overhead cable supports above the concrete floor.
מה כולם עושיםEvery auto-electrician is soldering copper eyelet terminals onto vehicle wiring harnesses using electric soldering irons.
מבנה מרכזיA forty-five-foot heavy overhead wiring gantry and extraction duct beam cutting diagonally across the workshop ceiling from bottom-left to top-right.

18. AMPHI BOWLמשחק צליל

פרקADHD treatment: stimulants
משחק המיליםAMPHI- of amphitheatre carries amphetamine, and the venue's stock furniture is a wall of AMPs — the class morpheme repeated as ordinary equipment. The marquee, which takes the biggest lettering slot, reads 'CONCERTA — 12 HOUR SHOW' and so spends the largest string on the extended-release duration rather than on the venue name. The individual agents come free off the same block: a rubber adder lying in the coiled snake cables (Adderall), the tour van lettered 'VYV' at the loading bay (Vyvanse), the follow-spot's FOCUS ring (Focalin), the twin decks under a canvas (Dexedrine). Adverse effects are all native gig furniture: the food truck with no queue (appetite suppression), the door card 'DOORS 8PM — 4AM' (insomnia), the 'YOU MUST BE THIS TALL' board at the barrier (growth suppression), the bass VU meter pinned in the red on the desk (raised heart rate and blood pressure), the 'ENCORE' chalkboard by the exit (rebound). Abuse potential and diversion is the ticket scalper working the fence outside the gate — diversion is the pharmacological term and the touting is the picture.
המקוםAn outdoor amphitheatre at doors-open on a summer afternoon: raked grass bowl, scaffold towers, speaker stacks flanking the stage, crowd barrier along the front, loading bay and food trucks behind the fence.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working or attending the load-in and doors-open of the show — humping flight cases, taping cables, checking wristbands at the barrier, filing down the bowl to a spot.
מבנה מרכזיThe scaffold speaker-stack tower and the steel crowd barrier running together from lower-left to upper-right, splitting the frame into stage, pit, bowl and gate.

19. CLONMEL HILL FARMמשחק צליל

פרקADHD treatment: non-stimulants
משחק המיליםClonmel is an ordinary hill-farm name that carries the class's most-used drug in its first syllable without printing anything clinical, and the farm's whole day is the class's mechanism performed as work. What an alpha-two agonist does is call the outflow back to base, and calling the dog off the flock is the only job on this hill; the second collie, tagged and hanging back on the skyline while the first runs on, is the pack token standing where it belongs. The netting and the hurdle pens are the transporter drawn as the thing it is named after, so the reuptake blocker costs nothing. The trade also supplies the class's awkward facts on native carriers: nothing here is quick, the gather takes the whole day, the notice board carries the standing hazard warning, and letting a batch off the pressure all at once is precisely how a flock bolts back up the hill.
המקוםA hill sheep farm on gathering day: a stone-walled fank of pens and races on the slope below the yard, hurdles and netting run out across the grass to funnel the flock in, a quad and a trailer parked at the gate, and a pine plantation edge on the skyline above the top pen.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is gathering the flock in — walking the hill behind the sheep, whistling the dogs out and calling them back off, closing hurdles behind each batch and pushing the sheep down the race into the pens.
מבנה מרכזיThe stone-walled race and its run of hurdles and netting cutting from the bottom left of the frame up to the plantation gate at the top right, dividing the ground into open hill, the funnel, the fank of pens and the yard.

20. THE AUTO-MATמשחק צליל

פרקAutism Spectrum Disorder
משחק המיליםAUTO- is the morpheme of autos/autism on a name that is a genuine, wholly mundane historical eating hall, and the automat's actual business model is the criterion A picture: you obtain your meal from a wall of machines, nobody speaks to anybody, there is no server to reciprocate with. Criterion B falls out of the same furniture — the rigid grid of identical windows for insistence on sameness, a diner aligning cutlery in perfect parallel, a coin spun over and over under one finger for stereotypy, a fan of automat tokens laid out in strict order for restricted interests, and the 'PLEASE — QUIET' notice under a buzzing fluorescent tube with a diner covering his ears for sensory sensitivity. Severity levels use the shop's own rolling three-step stool, treads lettered 1, 2, 3: the higher the row you cannot reach, the taller the ladder the staff must bring — support level as physical height, no digits needed. Screening ages ride the changer booth's coin slots stamped 18 and 24. The out-of-order coin telephone with a card over the dial is the absent chat.
המקוםA coin-operated automat cafeteria at lunchtime: a chrome-and-glass wall of little compartment windows, a nickel-changer booth, dolphin-head coffee spouts, marble-topped single tables under a tiled ceiling.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is getting their own meal from the wall — feeding coins, turning knobs, lifting a hatch, carrying a tray to a single marble table and eating alone.
מבנה מרכזיThe chrome-and-glass wall of coin-operated compartment windows, its grid receding from lower-left to upper-right, with the marble serving rail along its base.

21. KIDD LADDER WORKSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקIntellectual Developmental Disorder (Intellectual Disability)
משחק המיליםThe letters I, D and D stand in order inside an utterly ordinary family trade name, which is the expreSS tRIps device, and the surname reads as an English family firm rather than as a joke. The trade was chosen because the diagnosis is graded by how much support a person needs, and a ladder yard is the one mundane workplace whose entire business is graded support: four heights of ladder against the same wall, and a second person with a hand on the stile at the foot of every one. Nobody in the frame is the ladder, so no metaphor is being minted for a state — the picture shows how high each climber gets and how much of the weight the person footing it is taking, which is the criterion itself. The stock also supplies the rest without invention: the rungs are a native counted ladder, a three-section extension ladder is a native before, during and after, and the three racked bays give the three domains their own addresses.
המקוםA ladder works on a busy weekday: a rack wall of finished ladders sorted by length down one side of the yard, a brick test wall opposite with four ladders of different heights standing against it, a bench of stiles and rungs under the canopy, and the loading bay open to the street.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the test wall — footing the bottom of a ladder for the next person, climbing it rung by rung, calling down how far up they got, and tying a pass tag on the stile before carrying it to the rack.
מבנה מרכזיThe brick test wall with its four ladders of different heights leaning against it, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, dividing the yard into the loading bay, the working floor, the test wall and the rack wall behind it.

22. LEXI PRESSמשחק צליל

פרקSpecific Learning Disorder (SLD)
משחק המיליםLEXI is the live morpheme of dyslexia on a name any print shop could really carry, and letterpress is the one ordinary trade in which letters are genuinely mirror-reversed and in which b, d, p and q genuinely get put back in the wrong compartment — the enamel sign over the case, 'MIND YOUR P's AND Q's', is a real typesetter's idiom that exists for precisely that reason. The three specifiers are three benches in one shop with no invention: the type cases for reading, the hand-lettering bench with its cramped blotted practice sheet for written expression, and the spilled numeral drawer with the figures face-up and out of order for mathematics. The hand-lettered window banner 'SPELING GUARANTED' takes the largest lettering slot and spends it on the specifier rather than the name. 'Despite intervention for at least six months' is the job ticket rack labelled '6 MONTHS OF PROOFS', with a stack of red-marked proofs of the same job beneath it. Accommodations are the bench magnifier on its arm and the type-height gauge.
המקוםA jobbing letterpress print shop and stationer's with a public counter at the front: ranked type cases, a cast-iron platen press, a proofing bench, wall-mounted wooden type, ink on everything.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is setting type and pulling proofs — picking sorts from the case into composing sticks, locking up formes, inking, pulling sheets, marking proofs at the counter.
מבנה מרכזיThe cast-iron platen press with its flywheel and the long composing bench of ranked type cases running together from lower-left to upper-right.

23. TONGUE & GROOVE FLOORINGמשחק צליל

פרקCommunication Disorders (Language, Speech, Stuttering, Social-Pragmatic)
משחק המילים'Tongue' in 'Tongue & Groove' puns on the tongue as the primary anatomical organ and metaphor for speech, language, and communication disorders.
המקוםAn industrial timber machining mill smelling of freshly profiled white oak and sawdust, lit by high industrial halogen pendants. Long conveyor rollers feed raw planed timber into high-speed four-sided moulding machines along the central aisle. Bound bundles of finished tongue-and-groove hardwood boards are stacked on wooden bearers beside the extraction ducts.
מה כולם עושיםEvery machinist on the mill floor is feeding rough-sawn oak boards onto the motorized profiling bed against guide fences.
מבנה מרכזיA fifty-foot heavy steel roller conveyor line cutting diagonally across the mill floor from bottom-left to top-right, carrying oak planks into the profiling cutter heads.

24. TURRET CLOCK WORKSמשחק צליל

פרקTic disorders + Tourette's
משחק המיליםTIC is TICK and TOURETTE is TURRET — a turret clock is the real horological name for a tower clock, so one three-word shop sign carries both halves of the chapter title in ordinary trade language. The venue then supplies the diagnosis unaided: a turret clock both TICKS and STRIKES, so motor tics are the escapement and vocal tics are the bell and hammer, and Tourette's requirement of both is the one movement that does both against the wall clocks that only tick and the chime-only case that only strikes. Waxing and waning is the moon-phase dial half-filled on a longcase face. The premonitory urge is the warning wheel — the horological term for the run that engages just before the strike — with a hand hovering over it. Suppressibility is the pendulum held still by a gloved hand beside a note reading 'CANNOT HOLD'. The one-year threshold rides the repair-ticket rack stamped '12 MONTHS'; peak age is the face whose hands stand between 10 and 12. Comorbid OCD is the apprentice re-counting a tray of screws laid in perfect rows, and the two amber pilot lamps on the beat amplifier are the same alpha-2 pair as in the music shop.
המקוםA turret-clock repair works in the bottom chamber of a town-hall clock tower: the great movement up on trestles, weight cables running to a ceiling pulley, a baize bench along the wall, ticking clocks hung everywhere.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is servicing clocks — winding, oiling, setting the beat, holding pendulums, hanging repaired movements back on the wall, listening with a hand cupped to an ear.
מבנה מרכזיThe cast-iron turret-clock movement standing on its trestles, its weight cables running diagonally up to the ceiling pulley from lower-left to upper-right.

25. STEREO TYPE RECORDSמשחק צליל

פרקStereotypic movement + Developmental coordination disorder
משחק המיליםSTEREO TYPE = stereotypic. The shop's own furniture then carries both halves of the chapter for free: the stylus stuck in a locked groove repeating the same bar is the stereotypy itself (rhythmic, non-functional, self-soothing, stops when interrupted), and the tangled patch-cable loom at the repair bench — where nobody can get the signal path right — is dyspraxia (motor planning, not motor strength). Bonus stock pun: a crate divider labelled PRAXIS (a real record label) for dys-PRAXIA. The venue name never prints the diagnosis; 'stereotype' is the root word only, the p272 MINIMUM device.
המקוםA cramped second-hand vinyl and hi-fi shop on a high street, mid-afternoon: wooden browsing bins packed with sleeves, a listening booth with a curtain, a repair bench at the back strewn with patch cables, a turntable on the counter with the stylus stuck in a locked groove.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is flipping through the record crates — the same repetitive two-handed flick, over and over, down the whole run of bins.
מבנה מרכזיThe long run of waist-high wooden browsing bins crossing the frame lower-left to upper-right, with the tangled patch-cable loom draped along its top rail and running back to the repair bench.

26. DOWNS FARM EGGSמשחק צליל

פרקID review: Down syndrome + Fragile X
משחק המיליםDowns is an entirely ordinary English landscape name for a farm, so the eponym rides on a fascia that reads as a real business and never prints a diagnosis. The trade was chosen because two of the chapter's hardest strings are already pre-printed on its own stock in the real world — fragile is stamped on every box, and the largest size lane is stamped XL — which is the Chateau Tyramine move, and stronger than a punned shopfront because the words are there before the illustrator arrives. The shed's own routine carries the rest on native carriers with no competing meaning: the candling lamp is the trade's radiograph, so a three-yolk egg held up to it is a legal counted set and two bubbles on the same screen is the classic paired sign, while the lot stamp and the numbered size lane are carriers whose real job is to bear digits. Day shift with the roller door open keeps the light bright and the register flat.
המקוםAn egg packing station in the middle of the day shift: a grading line running the length of the shed with a candling lamp booth over it, filled trays coming off the belt, a stack of printed boxes at the packing end, and the roller door open onto a bright yard where the van is loading.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is running the eggs through — lifting trays onto the belt, holding each egg up to the candling lamp, sorting it into the right size lane, stamping the box and carrying the packed cases out to the van.
מבנה מרכזיThe grading line and its roller belt running from the lower left of the frame up to the packing bench at the top right, dividing the shed into the intake end, the candling booth, the sorted size lanes and the loading bay.

27. RETT-A-TOOL HIREמשחק צליל

פרקOther neurodevelopmental: Rett, Prader-Willi, 22q11
משחק המיליםRETT-A-TOOL is the rent-a-X wrap said aloud - one eponym morpheme inside an entirely ordinary hire-trade fascia, the licence Lithium Lift already has, and the diagnosis is never printed. The trade was chosen because this is a hand chapter and a hire depot is a hand business. Staff wring and wipe their hands on rags at the hand-cleaner drum all shift, so the hallmark hand movement is the depot's own paid work rather than a symbol of it. The returns bench holds tools that have come back with their grips and handles stripped off, so purposeful hand use is the thing the depot has lost. The board of hole saws hung in ascending diameters with the largest three pegs empty is a native size chart, which carries head-circumference deceleration with no painted numeral competing against anything. Prader-Willi comes off the staffroom end of the counter: the padlocked consumables cabinet and the chained vending machine are the real management fact, and the slack drive belt on its hook is hypotonia. 22q11 rides the small print, because the excess and damage-waiver catch in the framed hire agreement is the cliche of the trade and CATCH-22 is its own name for itself, while the lime pallet by the mixer bay with its stock card chalked LOW carries the calcium in the trade's own material. The Saturday training room is let by the hour, which is how the classroom stands in this frame as itself. No bay numbers are painted anywhere, so the chromosome number lives on a docket and cannot collide with the sorting depot.
המקוםA tool and plant hire depot on a Saturday morning: a counter with a docket pad and a spike at the front, double-height racking of breakers, mixers and generators down one side, a wash-off bay with a hose reel and a mud grate, a service bench under the window, and the roller shutter half up onto the loading yard. The training room off the counter has its door hooked open, let by the hour as it is every Saturday.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is taking a tool out or bringing one back - carrying a breaker to the counter, filling in a docket, hosing mud off a mixer in the wash-off bay, wringing and wiping their hands on a rag at the hand-cleaner drum.
מבנה מרכזיThe double-height steel racking run of breakers, mixers and generators, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the depot into the hire counter, the racking run, the wash-off bay and the open shutter onto the yard.

28. MADDER DYE HOUSEראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקMajor Depressive Disorder
משחק המיליםMaDDer holds M-D-D as an ordered subsequence inside a real dyestuff — madder root is the oldest red in the trade — so the index is a genuine business name that never prints the diagnosis, the expreSS tRIps device rather than a label. The house then supplies the chapter's two hardest requirements at once. First, numbers: a dye recipe is quoted in percent on weight of goods, so a chalked recipe board is the trade's own percent carrier and heritability, adolescent prevalence and recurrence can all be painted as recipe lines with their tag in the same hand, with no native unit competing (the quarry's depth plates could not do this — a plate reading 4 reads as metres). Second, hosting: the raphe weaving workshop is not imported into this venue, it is downstream of it — the yarn is dyed in these pits and carried straight through to the loom, which is exactly what the token means. Depression stays a literal hollow: the pits are holes in the floor, hanks go down into them and are lifted back out, and re-dipping a hank a second time to deepen the shade is the trade's own name for what recurrence is. The vertical axis (pit floor to drying loft) is free for age band and severity.
המקוםA cloth dye house on an ordinary working day: a run of square dye pits sunk into the floor behind a raised masonry kerb, a weighing bench of dyestuff sacks at the goods-in door, a drying loft of pole racks over the far end, the wringing rollers at the tail of the run, and a weaving room open off the back wall.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the dye floor — weighing out dyestuff at the bench, lowering hanks into the pits on long poles, lifting them out dripping, feeding them through the rollers, carrying them up to the drying loft.
מבנה מרכזיThe sunken run of dye pits with its raised kerb and the steam main above it, cutting the floor from the lower left corner to the upper right and splitting the house into the weighing bench, the pit floor, the drying loft and the weaving room at the back.

29. expreSS tRIpsראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSSRIs deep dive
משחק המיליםThe corpus venue, reused verbatim (SketchyPharm p204): S-S-R-I appear as an ordered subsequence inside an entirely ordinary business name, expre**SS** t**RI**ps, with the acronym letters picked out in a lighter colour on the reception counter end-panel. The agency's native furniture supplies the mechanism at no cost: the smiley post-it is the fixed lexicon token for serotonin, the pigeonhole wall is the synapse, and a clerk physically barring a colleague from the post-it drawer is reuptake inhibition. Individual agents come off the brochure rack — PARROT AIR (paroxetine), a fluorescent ox mascot (fluoxetine), THE CITY (citalopram/escitalopram), a framed CERT on the wall (sertraline).
המקוםAn open-plan high-street travel agency at 10am: a run of consultant desks with monitors and desk phones, a wall of pigeonholes papered in yellow smiley post-its, brochure racks by the door, a big laminated world map, a photocopier and a water cooler against the back wall.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the office shift — taking bookings at the desks, queueing at the counter, filing and photocopying.
מבנה מרכזיThe run of consultant desks crossing the frame lower-left to centre-right, backed by the full-height pigeonhole wall covered in smiley post-its.

30. SuNRIse LAUNDRYראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSNRIs + atypical antidepressants
משחק המיליםS-N-R-I sit as an ordered subsequence inside SuNRIse — an entirely ordinary launderette name — with NRI landing contiguously, so the acronym letters can be picked out in the fascia lettering exactly as expreSS tRIps does. The venue then cashes itself four more times from stock: the whirling drum window is the vortex (vortioxetine), the twin-drum machine wears a DUAL LOAD plate (duloxetine, dual reuptake), FAX YOUR ORDER is genuine small-business counter signage (venlafaxine), the wall mirror over the folding counter is mirtazapine, stacked laundry trays are trazodone, and the ceiling propeller fan plus the NO SMOKING notice is bupropion. Best of all, the dry-cleaner's steam press has a real pressure gauge — the dose-dependent blood-pressure rise gets a carrier whose native job is showing pressure.
המקוםA strip-mall launderette and dry-cleaner at midday: a long wall of coin-operated front-loading washers and dryers, a folding counter with a wall mirror above it, a steam press in the back room behind a glass partition, a lost-property box and a noticeboard by the door.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is doing their laundry — loading drums, feeding coins, waiting on the bench, folding at the counter.
מבנה מרכזיThe long run of front-loading washers and stacked dryers along the wall, with the folding counter shelf running lower-left to upper-right in front of them.

31. MAYO'S AGED DELIמשחק צליל

פרקTCAs + MAOIs
משחק המיליםMAYO ≈ MAO, wrapped in an ordinary family-surname deli name, with AGED doing the real work: the entire MAOI dietary restriction list is a delicatessen's own stock inventory — aged cheese, cured salami, pickled herring, sauerkraut, soy sauce, fava beans, Chianti, draught beer, Marmite — so the tyramine interaction is free furniture rather than invented props, the Chateau Tyramine device moved indoors. The espresso machine's pressure gauge in the red is a stock carrier for hypertensive crisis, and the mousetrap by the flour sacks is the fixed lexicon token for MAOI. TCAs arrive as the corpus's own red tricycle, three of them chained at the kerb with TRI-CYCLE DELIVERIES painted on the box fronts, and delivery boys picking dropped parcels back up off the pavement is reuptake.
המקוםAn old-town corner delicatessen at lunchtime: a long glass counter of cheeses and cured meats, a rail of hanging salamis above it, a pickle barrel and sauerkraut crock at the end, a Chianti rack against the back wall, an espresso machine on the till counter, and three box-front delivery tricycles chained at the kerb outside the window.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is queueing for the counter — taking a ticket, waiting, pointing at the case, being handed wrapped parcels.
מבנה מרכזיThe long glass deli counter running lower-left to upper-right, with the hanging salami rail above it and the cheese wall behind, dividing the frame into shop floor, counter, back wall and the kerb outside the window.

32. THYME & AGAINמשחק צליל

פרקPersistent Depressive + DMDD + PMDD
משחק המיליםDysthymia gives THYME, thyme is said time, and Thyme & Again is a name a herb loft would really trade under. It also says time and again, which is the one thing the chapter's three disorders share: the same low mood, sorted only by its temporal shape. Persistent depressive disorder sits on the stock dates, because whole leaf keeps two years and rubbed leaf keeps one, and the trade stamps both on the lid - the adult threshold and the child threshold printed by a trade that has to print them anyway. DMDD is the children. They work the low tiers alongside the adults, one tray has gone over and the leaf is scattered down the boards, and the spoilage board ruled into a year of weekly columns is chalked 3 against this week. Between times they are sour at the trays, which is the criterion the outburst count is usually taught without. PMDD is the year planner on the post: a column a day, the last four days of every month ruled off and hatched, month after month, kept prospectively for the loft's own reasons. The mimic check is the thermometer and hygrometer, read and chalked daily like everything else in here.
המקוםA herb drying loft over the shop on a warm afternoon: tiers of slatted trays on their runners down the length of the floor, bunches hanging from the tie-beam above them, a sorting board and the stove with its damper at the far end, and the packing bench with jars, tins and paper sacks under the window. The family's school-age children work the low tiers after school alongside the adults, satchels dumped on the hooks by the loft stair.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is turning the drying leaf - pulling a tray out on its runners, turning the leaf over by the handful, tapping the stalk off into the bin, sliding the tray back and chalking the date on its end.
מבנה מרכזיThe tiered drying rack - the run of slatted trays on their runners with the hanging bunches on the tie-beam above it - crossing the loft from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and dividing it into the tipping floor, the rack run, the sorting board and the packing bench at the window.

33. B. POLAR PLAY APPARATUS - UNIT 1משחק צליל

פרקBipolar I Disorder
משחק המילים'B. POLAR' is a direct phonetic homophone for 'bipolar', while 'UNIT 1' designates Bipolar I.
המקוםA spacious timber and steel play equipment assembly workshop with concrete floors, open rear loading bays, and overhead lifting tackle. Sunlight falls across rows of partially assembled swings, spring rockers, and climbing frames undergoing mechanical safety checks. Racks of hardware bins, painted timber stanchions, and safety certification clipboards line the side walls.
מה כולם עושיםBolting galvanised steel brackets onto timber uprights with pneumatic torque wrenches.
מבנה מרכזיA heavy overhead steel lifting gantry and monorail beam spanning diagonally from the high rear-left ceiling to the lower-right assembly bay.

34. CYCLO PARKמשחק צליל

פרקBipolar II + Cyclothymia + pediatric bipolar controversy
משחק המיליםCyclothymia → CYCLO, and Cyclopark is a real cycling-venue name, so the chapter's chronic-fluctuation half owns the sign outright. The banking is then a spatial isomorphism for the whole chapter: riders climb it constantly but a rail keeps them from going over the top — hypomania that never reaches mania — and the infield grass, where most riders are sitting out, is where Bipolar II patients actually spend their time. The ordinal 'II' never becomes a digit: it is carried by which race is chalked on the board, the MADISON, the two-rider relay (the p212 device — ordinals are carried by which venue you are standing in). The paediatric controversy is the children's class on the infield with two coaches holding different rulebooks under a posted UNDER-12s rule board.
המקוםA council cycle track: an outdoor velodrome with steeply banked timber boards, a pale blue Cote d'Azur band at the bottom of the banking, a black measurement line, a timing hut with a lap board and bell, a grass infield where a children's proficiency class is being run, and a pit area of spare wheels and track pumps.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is riding the club session — circling the track, sitting out on the infield grass, pumping tyres and watching the lap board.
מבנה מרכזיThe banked timber track itself, its curve sweeping across the frame from lower-left to upper-right, separating the high banking, the flat straight, the grass infield and the pit.

35. Lithium Liftתמונה מילולית

פרקLithium
משחק המיליםThe corpus venue, reused verbatim (SketchyPharm p208): the drug name printed literally on a salmon enamel oval but wrapped inside a real place-noun, Lithium Lift, so the sign reads as a lift station and not as a label. The lift's own vertical run is the serum-level axis, and the resort's stock safety signage is the whole narrow-therapeutic-index story without a single invented prop: a green pictogram NARROW WINDOW sign in the queue maze, a LOW CLEARANCE bar, INSIPIDUS lettered on the stone fountain rim for nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, an undone bowtie on the ticket clerk for hypothyroidism, and a diving-board warning for the thiazide interaction.
המקוםA small beginner ski resort on a blue-sky family morning: a chairlift station with a pylon and enamel nameplate, the cable running up a gentle groomed slope, a lift queue maze with pictogram safety signs, a stone fountain by the ticket window, bunting over the terrace of the warming hut.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having an ordinary day on the beginner slope — queueing for the lift, riding the chairs, skiing down, building a snowman.
מבנה מרכזיThe chairlift cable and its pylon line, banding the frame lower-left to upper-right along the slope's ridge, splitting it into the base station, the mid-slope, the top station and the terrace.

36. VALE, CARBERY & LAMBמשחק צליל

פרקMood stabilizers: Valproate, Lamotrigine, Carbamazepine
משחק המיליםThe partnership surname 'Vale' encodes Valproate, 'Carbery' encodes Carbamazepine (Carb-), and 'Lamb' encodes Lamotrigine (Lam-).
המקוםA heavy engineering workshop where large industrial flow valves, bypass manifolds, and pressure regulators are assembled and hydrostatic-pressure tested. Machined bronze and cast-iron valve housings sit on sturdy wooden pallets between high-pressure test rigs. Overhead chain hoists and water drainage troughs run parallel to the test bays.
מה כולם עושיםChecking valve seating faces for leaks with bluing paste.
מבנה מרכזיA 12-inch cast-iron flanged manifold pipe run mounted on heavy floor trestles, cutting diagonally from the hydrostatic test tank at the lower left up to the overhead chain hoist at the upper right.

37. DIAMOND DISPLAYSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקPediatric mood: DMDD vs pediatric bipolar; teen suicidality
משחק המיליםDiaMonD Displays holds D-M-D-D as an ordered subsequence inside a genuine firework-company name, and display is the trade's own word for what it sells, so the acronym is carried by an ordinary fascia rather than by a label; the last version proved the letters work, it was the premises that duplicated the bowling alley next door. The trade is chosen because this chapter is the one that has to teach means restriction and it must not repeat the pharmacy chapter's medicine cabinet. An explosives licence requires a locked steel store, a posted permitted quantity and an age check at the point of sale, so the cage, the counter notice and the ID check are the real regulations of a real shop and they are exactly safety planning, restriction of access and the age band, hand-lettered by law rather than by us. The risk assessment on its clipboard by the shutter is literally what the trade calls its own paperwork, which gives the chapter a native carrier for structured risk assessment. The differential is carried on paper, not by anything the fireworks do: the order pad shows a repeat rate several times a week against a wall planner ringed for a handful of discrete dated displays a year, which is chronic irritability against episodic illness stated in the shop's own scheduling units, while the children at the counter carry temper and mood by literal depiction.
המקוםA firework shop on the Thursday before a holiday: a service counter with a stock sheet and an order pad, a floor-to-ceiling steel mesh cage with a padlocked gate behind it, shelves of boxed display sets along the public side, a wall planner by the shutter, and sealed delivery cages waiting in the back doorway.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is buying and serving over the counter — asking for a box off the shelf, being checked for ID, waiting while a set is fetched out of the cage, ticking the stock sheet, signing the order pad.
מבנה מרכזיThe floor-to-ceiling steel mesh cage with its padlocked gate, running across the shop from the lower left to the upper right, splitting it into the public shelves, the service counter, the caged store and the back doorway onto the delivery bay.

38. GADD & SONS SAFETY TESTINGראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקGeneralized Anxiety Disorder
משחק המיליםGADD carries the acronym inside an ordinary family surname on an ordinary trade fascia, the Ben's Diner device, and nothing on the sign names the disorder. The premises are an inspection and issue depot rather than a kit shop: things arrive on their due date, go through a test and go back out with a dated tag on them, so the visual mass is instruments and paperwork, not racks of wearable stock. That trade is the chapter's core feature made literal. Worry spread across unrelated domains is one hazard to a line on the depot's own wall list - gas, height, fire, noise, eyes - so every domain hands over a separate prop with nothing invented. The paperwork is the numbers layer: the accident-free tally board is a chalked count of days and is the only carrier in the syllabus whose native unit is more days than not, every tag in the trade bears a due date and a six-month interval, and the inspection card is ruled into seven numbered check lines. The gantry and the detector bench give restlessness, muscle tension and startle as people literally under load and literally jumping when an alarm goes off. The almond-shaped personal panic alarms are ordinary stock in this trade, not a substitute for the token. And because the depot fronts onto a street, the bus stop stands where a bus stop stands, in view of the issue hatch.
המקוםA safety equipment inspection depot on a weekday morning: a receiving bench at the front where kit comes in on its due date, a proof-load gantry with a load cell and a big figured dial, a detector test bench with a gas manifold and alarms sounding along it, a tagging bench with a roll of dated service tags, a back wall of dated boxes, and the shop window onto the kerb.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is putting a piece of kit through its due test and tagging it - hanging a harness on the gantry and watching the dial, gassing a detector until it screams, weighing an extinguisher, writing a date on a tag and wiring it on.
מבנה מרכזיThe instrumented test run - the proof-load gantry with its load cell and figured dial carried on into the detector bench with its manifold and sounding alarms - crossing the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing the depot into the receiving bench, the test run, the tagging bench and the back wall of dated boxes.

39. AGORA SQUARE PARKINGתמונה מילולית

פרקPanic Disorder + Agoraphobia
משחק המיליםAgoraphobia is named for the agora, the public square, so the venue is not a terminal that happens to have stalls on its forecourt but the square itself, and the only lettering it carries is the square's own name on the parking board - which also settles the Israeli reading, because AGORA as the coin is recruited rather than suppressed here, agorot being exactly what the machine on the island takes; the square then ships all five DSM situations as ordinary municipal stock in one frame - the wide open paving, the queue at the machine, the enclosed lower level down the ramp, the park-and-ride minibus at the far kerb, and the single figure crossing the empty far end alone - while the peak is carried by a ticket printed with a time in and a time out minutes apart rather than by a departure board reading 10 MIN, and the month of anticipatory worry sits on the season permit board, whose native unit is already the month.
המקוםThe town's open square on a weekday, in use as the municipal pay-and-display car park: white-painted bays across the whole paving, the pay machine on a raised island with a queue at it, and the attendant's hut and barrier at the entry. The ramp down to the covered lower level goes off the far corner under its height bar, and the square's edges are kerb, chained bollards and a war memorial, with the far side almost empty.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is parking and paying - edging into a marked bay, walking over to queue at the machine, feeding coins in, and carrying the printed ticket back to lay it face up on the dashboard.
מבנה מרכזיThe concrete ramp parapet running down off the square's paving into the covered lower level, cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right with the height-restriction bar hung across its mouth, dividing the square into the open paving, the pay island, the ramp and the far kerb.

40. SELECT-A-BAND RADIOתמונה מילולית

פרקSocial Anxiety + Selective Mutism
משחק המיליםThe stock complaint of the repair trade is a set that plays perfectly at home and will not make a sound on the bench with the engineer watching, and that is selective mutism drawn as an ordinary Tuesday rather than as a symbol of one; the fascia takes one morpheme, SELECT, off the front of the diagnosis and lands it on selectivity, which is a real printed specification on radio sets, so the sign reads as a genuine shop name and never states the disorder. Social anxiety comes off the same bench as literal depiction: the whole business is being watched while your set is made to perform under a bright lamp, and a customer must state their name and their fault out loud to a stranger across a counter, which is the trigger the chapter is about. The public-address amplifier on soak test with its microphone carries the performance-only subtype in the manufacturer's own lettering, and a mute control on a faceplate is a redundant label on an object that already is that thing, which the corpus welcomes. The duration criteria have a native and non-competing carrier: repair dockets and guarantee slips are printed in months and spiked side by side, so the six-month and the one-month thresholds sit on two ordinary pieces of shop paper in the same hand. Deliberately not a studio and not a hi-fi showroom: this is a bench, a counter and a wall of dud valves.
המקוםA radio repair shop on a quiet afternoon: a service counter with a docket spike at the front, a workbench under a swan-neck lamp with a chassis out of its cabinet, a shelf of sets awaiting collection with job tickets tied on, a valve index cabinet against the wall, and a public-address amplifier on soak test with a microphone on a stand.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having a set looked at — carrying it in and setting it on the counter, saying out loud what it does wrong, standing back while it is switched on at the bench under the lamp, waiting for it to make a sound, collecting one off the shelf.
מבנה מרכזיThe long service bench with the shelf run above it — counter at one end, chassis and test gear along it, sets awaiting collection stacked overhead — cutting from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the shop into the public counter, the test bench, the parts wall and the soak-test corner.

41. PACIFIC ELEMENTARYמשחק צליל

פרקSeparation Anxiety + Specific Phobia
משחק המיליםPACIFIC is a stress-matched phonetic pun on SPECIFIC - pa-CIF-ic against spe-CIF-ic - sitting on one of the most ordinary fascias in America, so the largest lettering never says phobia; the second disorder is then indexed with no invention at all by the genuine, ubiquitous KISS & RIDE plate over the drop-off lane, real school signage that literally instructs the separation and gives it a three-minute limit. The venue supplies all five phobia types out of stock - animal at the wasp trap over the cafeteria bins, natural environment on the classroom weather chart with today's thunderstorm card pinned to it, situational at the elevator with the out-of-order notice taped across its doors, the mascot for 'other', and, above all, blood-injection-injury as a real needle in the frame on immunization day, the vials, sharps box and consent rack standing in the nurse's window with a cup of juice and a pair of feet up on a chair on the bench outside it, which is the vasovagal faint no other phobia type shows.
המקוםAn elementary school gate at ten to nine on an ordinary Tuesday: the drop-off lane running along the chain-link fence with its painted arrows and its KISS & RIDE plate, a covered walkway carrying from the kerb to the school doors, and the yellow bus stopped ahead of the lane with its stop-arm out. The office and nurse's windows face the yard, the attendance chart and the immunization table showing through them, and the assembly-point letters are painted across the blacktop behind the fence.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is doing the morning hand-over at the kerb - pulling up in the lane, unbuckling a belt, passing a backpack across, walking a child as far as the fence and no further, signing the late book at the office door, and going back to the car alone.
מבנה מרכזיThe covered walkway from the drop-off kerb to the school doors - a long steel canopy on posts with the chain-link fence running alongside it - cutting from the lower left of the frame up to the entrance at the upper right and splitting the picture into the road and the stopped bus, the drop-off lane, the yard, and the school frontage with the nurse's window in it.

42. BEN'S DECKCHAIR HIREמשחק צליל

פרקBenzodiazepines + Buspirone + sleep aids overview
משחק המיליםBen's is the corpus's own benzodiazepine morpheme, carried over from Ben's Diner and kept deliberately so the class name is rehearsed rather than reissued. The venue type is chosen because the hire trade's whole business is the two variables the chapter compares: how far the back notches down, and how long the ticket lasts. The chalked rate board sells by the hour, so short, intermediate and long-acting agents land on a single ordinary numbered carrier, and the notched recline settings carry sedation depth against anxiolysis without a metaphor. It is also outdoors, which is what the diner could not do: the five-floor hotel the chapter must host stands in the frame at full height with all its floors legible at once.
המקוםA seaside deckchair and beach-hut concession on the first warm Saturday of the season: a shingle beach below the promenade railing, a timber hire hut with its chalked rate board out on the step, striped chairs going up in rows down the slope, and a five-storey seafront hotel standing along the top behind the huts
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is hiring a deckchair and settling into it — taking a punched ticket at the hut, carrying a folded chair down the shingle, wrestling it open, notching the back to a chosen setting and sitting down in it
מבנה מרכזיThe row of numbered beach huts along the top of the shingle, running lower-left to upper-right, with the promenade railing above them and the incline of the beach falling away below

43. OCEAN DAILY CATCHראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקOCD core
משחק המיליםO, C and D fall in order inside an entirely ordinary fishmonger's name: OCean Daily catch, the same ordered-subsequence device as expreSS tRIps. The trade was chosen because a wet fish shop performs the chapter's two compulsion families as its own legitimate work: it hoses and scrubs the slab down on a timed cycle all morning, and it lays the stock in perfect ruled rows and re-straightens them continuously. It also hands over the chapter's three fixed anatomical symbols for nothing — the fishmonger's blue-and-white striped apron is the striatum, a tail curled on ice is the caudate's C, and an oyster on the counter is the putamen's shell. The insight specifier is the trade's own freshness grading by the clarity of the eye, clear through to clouded, and the tic specifier is the one fish still twitching on the slab.
המקוםA wet fish shop at half past eight on market morning: a marble slab banked with crushed ice under the window, whole fish laid nose-to-tail in ruled rows and straightened again every time somebody leans on them, a hose on a reel by the drain, and a numbered ticket queue along the tiled wall
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is buying and preparing fish over the slab — pulling a numbered ticket, pointing at the row, weighing on the hanging dial, gutting and filleting, wrapping in paper, and hosing and squeegeeing the slab down between one customer and the next
מבנה מרכזיThe long ice-banked marble slab running lower-left to upper-right, with the steel rail of hanging scales and hooks slung above it the whole length of the shop

44. EXPOSURE PRINTSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקOCD treatment: ERP + high-dose SSRI
משחק המיליםE, R and P fall in order in an ordinary photo-shop name: ExposuRe Prints. The trade then performs the therapy rather than illustrating it — you deliberately expose the film, and then the whole discipline is that you must not open the tank, must not turn the darkroom door, and must not look until the time is up. Exposure plus response prevention is the shop's working rule, posted on its own door, not a metaphor bolted on. The high-dose rule has a real trade word too: push processing, developing at a deliberately higher rating than the standard one, which goes straight onto the price board as an ordinary priced service. The eight-to-twelve-week wait is the development time chart, and the mail-order film service brings the fixed transporter symbol in on legitimate business.
המקוםA one-hour photo developing lab two doors along the same parade of shops: a drop-off counter with a pad of envelopes and a pen on a chain, a minilab machine chugging along the back wall, a rack of prints drying in rows, and a revolving darkroom door with a red bulb burning over it
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is getting film developed — filling in the envelope at the counter, feeding cassettes into the machine, waiting on the bench, and holding prints up against the light at the collection end
מבנה מרכזיThe minilab's long roller conveyor and print-drying rack running lower-left to upper-right down the shop, with the revolving darkroom door standing at its far end

45. B. D. DREW & CO. - HOARD'S END SEED MILLראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקBody Dysmorphic + Hoarding
משחק המיליםThe proprietor initials 'B. D. D.' embed the acronym for Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD), while the hamlet name 'HOARD'S END' embeds Hoarding Disorder without printing the diagnosis.
המקוםA rural agricultural grain mill where harvested crop seed is cleaned, screened, and bagged for seasonal sowing. Dust motes float in the air around vibrating grading sieves and seed-dressing treaters on the ground floor. Stacks of sewn burlap sacks sit neatly arranged on pallets beside gravity chutes.
מה כולם עושיםStitching closed burlap sacks of dressed seed with handheld bag-closing machines.
מבנה מרכזיA heavy timber bucket-elevator tower and galvanized grain chute running diagonally from the intake pit at the lower left to the roof-hung rotary cleaner at the upper right.

46. TILLMAN'S PICK-YOUR-OWNמשחק צליל

פרקTrichotillomania + Excoriation
משחק המיליםTILLMAN'S carries TILL out of trichoTILLomania, and 'till' is simultaneously the ordinary farming verb, so the name reads as a real family farm rather than a joke. 'PICK-YOUR-OWN' is the single most standard piece of farm signage in existence and it is exactly the second diagnosis: picking. The field then does the dermatology: a bed pulled to irregular bare patches with ragged borders sits beside a bed with one perfect smooth circle of bare earth — trichotillomania versus alopecia areata, the mimic, as a contrast pair of ordinary beds. The matted ball of straw and hair in the barn corner is the trichobezoar, and the 'SNACK SHACK' board hands over N-A-C for free.
המקוםA pick-your-own berry and vegetable farm on a Sunday — planted rows on a gentle slope, a farm-stand shed, a tractor and trailer, punnets everywhere
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is picking and pulling their own produce: working down the rows on their knees, filling punnets, carrying crates to the weighing station
מבנה מרכזיThe long planted rows with their string lines and numbered row posts running corner to corner on the diagonal, with the farm-stand shed and weighing station at the top end — splitting the frame into pulled beds / intact beds / the path / the stand and barn

47. POST TOWN SORTING DEPOTראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקPTSD core
משחק המיליםP-T-S-D as the initials of an entirely real postal facility name — Post Town Sorting Depot ('post town' is genuine postal terminology) — with the four initials picked out. The first word is simultaneously the literal morpheme POST, meaning after. The sorting hall is then the DSM structure itself: four labelled bays are the four criterion clusters, and each symptom lands on stock with no invention — intrusion is mail shooting through the slot unbidden into a sorter's face, avoidance is the RETURN TO SENDER stamp, negative cognitions are the dead-letter bin, arousal is the sorter mid-flinch at the fire-alarm bell. A rubber date stamp is a native number carrier for the one-month minimum, and a parcel franked DELAYED 6 MO on the late shelf is the delayed-expression specifier.
המקוםA suburban postal sorting depot on the night shift — a long hall of roller conveyors and wheeled cages, a loading dock with the roller door up, vans backed in
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is sorting and loading mail: pulling sacks off the conveyor, throwing letters into the pigeonhole bays, stamping, wheeling cages to the dock
מבנה מרכזיThe roller conveyor running the length of the hall with the run of numbered sorting cages and pigeonhole frames alongside it, cutting the frame lower-left to upper-right — splitting it into the loading dock / the conveyor / the sorting bays / the dead-letter corner

48. PRAISE & SONS FIREWOODמשחק צליל

פרקPTSD treatment: Prazosin, SSRIs, trauma-focused therapies
משחק המיליםPRAISE & SONS said aloud is the drug in the ordinary shape of a family firm's gate board, so the largest lettering slot spends itself on the pun and never on the condition; the yard is then the one mundane workplace whose own back fence is the snowy pine forest the course's wolf pack already stands in, with the estate keeper at the deer fence and his dart rifle serving as both an ordinary forestry job and the corpus's fixed alpha-1 blockade glyph, and the trade owns the chapter's therapies as plant — wood is SEASONED, the word chalked on the price board, by being stacked in the open in graded stages until the moisture meter reading falls week by week down the row, while the kiln-dried stack forced too fast has split; the swing saw sweeps left, right, left across the log on its pivot with every eye in the yard tracking it; and a log's whole history is read off the end grain, fire scar, wound wood and a strand of old fence wire grown into it.
המקוםA firewood merchant's yard at the edge of a pine wood on a working morning in deep snow: an open-fronted seasoning lean-to of stacked rows, a swing saw hung on its pivot over the cutting trestle, a loading bank with a tipper lorry backed onto it, and the deer fence and the pine ride closing the top of the yard. The gate board is chalked with this week's prices and the lorry is half loaded.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is making up loads of logs — running rings through the swing saw, splitting at the block, forking the split wood into the seasoning stacks, and filling nets and weighing them on the platform scale.
מבנה מרכזיThe long open-fronted seasoning lean-to with its stacked rows of logs, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right with the cutting trestle at its near end, splitting the yard into loading bank, saw trestle, seasoning stacks and the fenced ride beyond.

49. SEAM STRESS ALTERATIONSמשחק צליל

פרקAcute Stress + Adjustment Disorder
משחק המיליםseamSTRESS splits into SEAM + STRESS — the word for the tradeswoman literally contains 'stress', and a seam under stress is what acute stress is. ALTERATIONS is the plain-English picture of adjustment: something that fitted before no longer fits the new circumstances and has to be taken in. The shop cashes again on its own stock: every garment carries a READY BY date, which is the whole chapter (3 days to 1 month for Acute Stress, within 3 months of the stressor for Adjustment, resolved within 6 months of the stressor ending) painted on props whose real job is bearing dates. The 1-month boundary where Acute Stress becomes PTSD is the ticket that was never collected and got moved to the OVER 1 MONTH rail.
המקוםA cramped back-street alterations counter in a parade of shops, mid-afternoon: three-way fitting mirror, a carpeted fitting box, a curtained cubicle, and a rail of other people's trousers waiting on numbered claim tickets
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having a garment altered — standing on the fitting box being pinned, kneeling to chalk a hem, feeding cloth through the machine, or handing in a claim ticket at the counter
מבנה מרכזיThe long chest-high cutting table with the overhead garment rail above it, both running lower-left to upper-right, hung with tagged garments and dangling claim tickets

50. REEVE & SONS MEMORIALSמשחק צליל

פרקGrief, bereavement, and Prolonged Grief Disorder
משחק המיליםbeREAVEment -> 'Reeve & Sons', exactly the BENZodiazepine -> Ben's Diner move: one syllable of the topic wearing an ordinary family-firm surname. The yard is chosen for inventory, not mood — it is a dusty industrial trade premises at noon, not a graveyard, and nobody in it is mourning; they are working or shopping. Its stock ships the one carrier the chapter needs most: carved dates. Prolonged Grief Disorder's 12 months (adults) and 6 months (children / ICD-11) are chiselled deep in stone in light-cut letters on dark granite, the highest-contrast number carrier available. Normal grief versus PGD versus MDD is a CONTRAST_PAIR of two nearly identical display stones differing in one carved line.
המקוםA memorial mason's display yard on a wide road at midday — gravel, an awning over a row of finished headstones on wooden cradles, a workshop shed behind with sandblasting hoses and a gantry crane on a rail
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working or shopping the yard: choosing a stone from the display row, running a finger over sample lettering, sandblasting through a rubber stencil, hosing granite dust off a slab, wheeling a trolley
מבנה מרכזיThe row of upright display headstones on their cradles, running lower-left to upper-right under the awning, with the gantry crane rail tracking above them and a granite slab half-off its rollers

51. WARD & CRADLE PICTURE RESTORERSמבנה מרחבי

פרקChild abuse and neglect
משחק המיליםWARD and CRADLE are both genuine terms of this trade - a work is held in the studio's ward, and a cradle is the lattice of battens glued to the back of a panel to stop it splitting - and both are equally the ordinary English words for a child in another person's care and the bed an infant is kept in, so the fascia indexes the chapter twice without printing a word of it and without the cinema mis-cue that PALACE carried. The isomorphism is the real basis: the conservator dates damage by how far it has aged, which is bruise dating; separates inherent vice from inflicted damage, which is the whole differential of brittle supports and factory blemishes against a blow; x-rays for what the surface hides, which is the skeletal survey; takes the owner's account without leading her and writes it verbatim because a led account contaminates the record; and files a dated, signed condition report whether or not anyone asked for one, which is the reporting duty. Neglect - half the chapter title and the commonest form - is this trade's own second category and has its own furniture here: the flat dead line running across whole months of the thermohygrograph chart, the tide-mark of damp up a stretcher with bloom clouding the varnish, and the far bay of racks holding works nobody has come back for, their tickets dated years ago.
המקוםA paintings conservation studio on an ordinary working weekday: a rank of easels under a slotted raking-light rail, most of them holding Victorian and Edwardian portraits of children with numbered condition tickets tied to their stretchers, and the x-ray viewing box glowing on the end wall. A floor-to-ceiling run of sliding mesh racks stands along the far wall with half of them pulled out on their runners, a drum thermohygrograph ticks above the intake counter at the street door, and the far bay of the racks is under dust sheets.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is examining a picture before any work starts on it - tipping it into the raking light and sighting along the surface, turning it face down to read the back, holding it up to the x-ray box, taking the owner's account down word for word at the counter, and writing up the condition report.
מבנה מרכזיThe floor-to-ceiling run of sliding mesh picture racks, half of them pulled out on their runners, carrying from the lower left of the frame up to the far corner and dividing the room into the intake counter, the easel floor under the light rail, the rack bay, and the x-ray room door behind it.

52. ALL-HITCH TOWBARSתמונה מילולית

פרקReactive Attachment Disorder + Disinhibited Social Engagement
משחק המיליםALL-HITCH is an ordinary towing firm's board and it is simultaneously the second disorder stated as a trading policy — this yard will hitch to anything that rolls up — so the sign carries the pun and the word attachment is kept off it and put where the corpus puts it, hand-lettered small on the fitting chart inside; the yard is the plain-English picture inside the chapter's own noun and it is the only mundane premises that stocks both failure modes as ordinary equipment faults standing side by side, one caravan whose coupling head is seized shut and chalked WILL NOT COUPLE, ball after ball offered to it and the thing still sitting on its own jockey wheel taking nothing from anybody, and one trailer with no coupling lock at all being towed out of the open gate behind a car nobody in the picture knows, while the trade's own phrase for a properly bolted-through bar is a secure fixing and the age criteria ride on the plated towing capacity, a carrier whose whole job is bearing numbers.
המקוםA roadside towbar and trailer yard on an ordinary weekday: a fitting bay with a hatchback up on ramps and a man under the rear valance, rows of box trailers and caravans stood nose-down on their jockey wheels, a parts counter of pigeonholes behind a glazed door, and a test ramp with a tow ball bolted to a concrete block. The gate stands open on the road and the week's job cards are pegged out along a wire.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is coupling and uncoupling — winding a jockey wheel down, dropping a coupling head onto a ball, working the handle until it clicks, giving the drawbar a lift to test it, and hooking on the breakaway cable.
מבנה מרכזיThe line of parked trailers and caravans on their drawbars with the fitting-bay ramps at its head, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, splitting the yard into fitting bay, trailer line, test ramp and counter.

53. PARTITION SELF STORAGEמבנה מרחבי

פרקDissociative disorders
משחק המיליםThe mechanism IS the architecture, so this venue takes the p272 route — no punned shopfront, one mechanism morpheme on a real trade sign. Dissociation is compartmentalisation: one tenant, one lease, many separately padlocked units, and no unit can see inside any other. Each roll-up door is an alter, holding a different set of belongings and opened by a different key, and the corridor makes the separation the largest fact in the frame. Dissociative amnesia is the unit whose lease was forgotten and whose padlock has been cut by staff; dissociative fugue is the transfer docket to the branch in another town; depersonalisation is the mirrored goods lift where a tenant watches himself from outside; derealisation is the reception window's tinted glass. PARTITION is the storage trade's own word for a demountable dividing wall — it names the mechanism without printing the diagnosis.
המקוםThe ground-floor corridor of a self-storage facility under flat fluorescent tube light: two facing runs of identical orange roll-up doors, each with a stencilled unit number and its own padlock, a flat trolley abandoned mid-corridor, a reception desk visible at the far end
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is accessing a unit — unlocking a padlock, rolling a shutter up, stacking boxes onto a flat trolley, signing the access log at the desk
מבנה מרכזיThe corridor itself: the two receding runs of numbered roll-up doors and the overhead conduit and light strip, driving lower-left to upper-right, splitting the frame into sealed compartments

54. SOMA & SONS BUREAU DE CHANGEתמונה מילולית

פרקSomatic Symptom + Conversion + Factitious
משחק המיליםSOMA is the body and is one morpheme of the chapter, never a diagnosis printed whole — the p272 MINIMUM device — and a bureau de change is the one ordinary place whose entire business IS conversion: something real is presented at a counter, turned into another form, and a note that only looks genuine is caught under the violet lamp at the side desk.
המקוםA high-street currency exchange on a Friday afternoon: a long counter of four glassed positions under a rate board that runs the width of the back wall, a rope queue folded twice across the floor, and a side desk where a note that will not pass is held under a violet lamp. Sealed bags of coin stand behind the grille and the day's takings are being counted into a tray at the end position.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having something changed over the counter — sliding notes under the glass, watching the board for the rate, waiting in the rope queue with a docket, counting what comes back.
מבנה מרכזיThe counter run with its four glassed positions and the rate board above it, carrying from the lower left of the frame up to the strongroom grille at the upper right and splitting the room into queue, counter, back office and the violet-lamp desk.

55. SPLIT LANES BOWLINGתמונה מילולית

פרקSchizophrenia core
משחק המיליםschizo- is Greek for split, and a bowling alley is the one everyday premises where SPLIT is the technical term printed on the scoreboard when it happens. The pin deck then does the chapter's central discrimination as ordinary equipment: positive symptoms are pins present that should not be there (extras standing in the gutter, a stray ball on the approach), negative symptoms are pins that should be there and are simply gone (a near-bare deck, nothing coming back down the return) — a CONTRAST_PAIR across two adjacent lanes with no metaphor invented for either. Duration is native too: the league board carries the 6-month standing and the 1-month active block, and lane numbers, shoe sizes and score frames are all carriers whose real job is bearing digits. Skittle-night banners give the second phonetic hook on the shop's own stock.
המקוםA ten-pin bowling alley on league night under flat overhead light: eight numbered lanes, ball returns burping between them, a shoe-rental counter of pigeonhole shelves, moulded plastic seating in the wells, a snack hatch at the back
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is bowling — stepping to the foul line, following through, waiting at the ball return, marking up at the scoring console, lacing rental shoes
מבנה מרכזיThe run of numbered lanes with their ball-return rails and gutters, driving lower-left to upper-right toward the pin decks, with the overhead score monitors banked above

56. D. A. HYMAN & N. M. DALE - 5 HIGH TERRACEראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSchizophrenia neurobiology: DA + NMDA + 5-HT hypotheses
משחק המיליםThe proprietor initials 'D. A.' embed Dopamine, partner name 'N. M. DALE' embeds NMDA, and address '5 HIGH TERRACE' embeds 5-HT (5-Hydroxytryptamine).
המקוםA bustling commercial laundry washhouse with concrete drainage channels, steaming wash aisles, and overhead linen rails. Rows of heavy industrial washing machines and centrifugal extractors operate steadily under high clerestory windows. Baskets of sorted white bed linen and folded towels are staged along the main sorting floor.
מה כולם עושיםFolding dry hotel bath towels at wooden sorting benches.
מבנה מרכזיA heavy galvanized overhead laundry-bag monorail track cutting diagonally across the hall from the sorting dock at the lower left to the continuous wash tunnel at the upper right.

57. SKITS & TURNSמשחק צליל

פרקSchizoaffective + Schizophreniform + Brief Psychotic + Delusional
משחק המיליםSCHIZ- is pronounced /skits/, so a variety bill of SKITS puts the chapter's shared morpheme on the most ordinary theatre fascia there is, and the trade then hands over the whole chapter as ordinary box-office business: a booking run is measured in printed dates, so the duration ladder that separates these four diagnoses lands on the theatre's own paperwork rather than on invented digits — the slip pasted across one bill reading ONE NIGHT ONLY, played and struck with the deposit returned and the house back to normal in the morning; the booking the box office has rubber-stamped PROVISIONAL, which is the DSM's own word for the schizophreniform run that has not yet declared whether it will be extended; the transfer chalked up as an open-ended run with no closing date; the run chart behind the counter carrying two coloured bars on one ticket, the psychosis bar opening two weeks solo before the mood bar joins it and the mood bar then running more than half the total length, which is the schizoaffective criterion drawn as a booking chart; and the stage-door queue, five perfectly ordinary people each holding one impossible fixed belief — the leading man is in love with her, the act was stolen from him, she is the real headliner — every other thing they do at the hatch entirely normal, which is non-bizarre delusion with function preserved.
המקוםA suburban variety theatre on a band-call morning, front of house open to the street: a run of glazed bill cases along the frontage with dated bills pasted up in layers, the box office behind them with the plan of the house, the ticket blocks and the date stamp on the ledge, and the stage-door alley beside it with a hatch, a callboard and a few people waiting at the rail. Through the propped pass door the stage is under worklight, the pianist's stand out, and the dressing-room passage runs off it with its mirrors lit.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is settling dates — reading a run off a poster, pushing a card across the box-office plan, having a booking stamped, chalking a turn onto the run chart, pasting a new date slip over an old one.
מבנה מרכזיThe long glazed bill case running the whole frontage, its overlapping dated bills behind the glass, cutting from the lower left corner to the upper right and dividing the frame into the pavement queue, the box-office lobby, the stage-door alley and the open pass door to the stage.

58. SIMAZINE & DAIRY SUPPLIESמשחק צליל

פרקFirst-generation antipsychotics
משחק המילים-azine is buried inside SIMAZINE, an ordinary herbicide that a farm-chemicals counter really does sell by the sack and really does paint on its board beside ATRAZINE, so the class hook is carried the way GAZING carried it - inside a real word on real signage - instead of being printed bare as the chemical term, and the trade is not a colour-matching one, so it does not sit on top of the dye house or the conservation studio. The counter owns the chapter's hardest fact outright: the application-rate chart runs from twenty grams a hectare at the top to five kilos a hectare at the bottom, which is the chlorpromazine-equivalent table in the merchant's own units, and one sack alone carries a red MAXIMUM RATE - DO NOT EXCEED band, the ceiling that exists for the heart rather than for the effect. Photosensitivity and slate-blue skin come off the shelves without invention - sample sacks bleached pale down the sun side of the window, and the tub of Bordeaux mixture with blue-grey handprints round its rim and up the shelf edge - the brown-lensed spray goggles on the PPE hook carry the retinal pigmentation, the old hessian sacks of the pre-war lines still stood at the far end beside the new plastic drums carry 'first generation' with no digit anywhere, and the whole yard stands in full sun.
המקוםAn agricultural chemicals and dairy sundries store on a Saturday morning in the spraying season: the trade counter under its awning with the application-rate chart screwed above it, stencilled paper sacks and drums stacked in the aisles behind, and the wash-down apron and filling stand out in the yard with the header tank on its gantry over them. The dairy department fills the back of the store with clusters, filters and churn lids on numbered shelves, and a milking-machine pump has been stood out on the apron and run up on test with the milk from its split rubber spreading across the concrete.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is making an order up - reading the rate off the chart, working out the sacks to the acre on the pad, signing the poisons register, and wheeling the sacks out to the yard on the barrow.
מבנה מרכזיThe filling stand - the raised concrete bund with the header tank on its gantry above it and the delivery hose slung down from the tank - running from the lower left of the frame up to the store's loading door at the upper right and splitting the picture into the yard and its parked sprayer, the bund and wash-down apron, the trade counter under its awning, and the dairy department at the back of the store.

59. SECONDS & IRREGULARSתמונה מילולית

פרקSecond-generation antipsychotics overview
משחק המיליםSECONDS is retail's own word for goods of the second grade, and IRREGULARS is retail's own word for atypical stock — the shop name states 'second generation' and 'atypical' in plain trade English without printing a drug name, and the ordinal arrives as a word on a real sign rather than as a digit. The outlet's native inventory then carries the entire class side-effect profile with no invention: the coin-operated scale at the door is weight gain, the bulk sugar bin is hyperglycaemia, the drums of cooking oil are dyslipidaemia, and the dairy fridge is prolactin (risperidone's trolley is the one parked in front of it). Lower EPS is a NEGATION — the cogwheel display that filled the shelf next door is here reduced to a nearly empty end-cap with a 'CLEARANCE' card. The hanging banner takes the biggest lettering slot with a tagline, not the shop name.
המקוםA discount factory-outlet warehouse in a converted unit: pallet racking to the ceiling, dump bins of dented tins down the centre, a dairy fridge humming along one wall, drums of cooking oil and a bulk sugar bin at the end of the aisle, a coin-operated weighing scale by the doors
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is rummaging the bins and loading trolleys — digging through the dump bins, checking a dented tin, wheeling a piled trolley, queueing at the single open till
מבנה מרכזיThe central run of dump bins and pallet racking driving lower-left to upper-right, with a hanging vinyl banner slung above it the length of the aisle

60. CLOZA PINE MILLמשחק צליל

פרקClozapine - the gold standard for treatment-resistant
משחק המיליםCLOZA + PINE reads out the drug's syllables in order while staying a wholly plausible mill name in the Ponderosa Pine mould — the p208 'Lithium Lift' move, where the drug name is printed but wrapped inside a real place-noun. The mill then supplies almost every clozapine fact from equipment that was already there: the weekly tally board and the scale-house readout are the ANC monitoring schedule and the 1500/1000/500 thresholds on carriers whose real job is bearing numbers; the enamel NO SMOKING sign — the single most prominent sign in any real sawmill — is the CYP1A2 induction fact, and a stubbed-out cigarette by the gate is why one man's dose is different; the tapped pine dripping resin into a hung bucket is sialorrhoea; the offcut chute jammed solid is constipation and ileus; the saw's kickback hazard placard is the dose-related seizure risk; the weighbridge is weight gain; and the 'PRIME GRADE' stamp on the best boards is the gold standard. Treatment resistance is the knot that already broke two blades — the two spent blades hang on the wall of the sharpening room before this one was fitted.
המקוםA working sawmill yard in daylight: a log deck feeding the headrig band saw, a green-chain conveyor carrying boards past a grading station, banks of stickered lumber drying under a lean-to, a weighbridge with a scale house window at the gate
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the mill run — rolling logs onto the deck, tailing boards off the green chain, stamping grades, banding and stacking, driving the forklift to the drying bank
מבנה מרכזיThe green-chain conveyor and the headrig saw carriage running lower-left to upper-right, with banks of stickered lumber walling both sides of the run

61. PIP PIANO WORKSמשחק צליל

פרקPartial agonists: Aripiprazole, Brexpiprazole, Cariprazine
