משחק המילים-PIP- is the syllable shared by ariPIPrazole and brexPIPrazole, and PIP Piano Works reads as an ordinary maker's name of the kind actually painted on piano fallboards. The trade is the mechanism, exactly: a tuner brings the sharp string DOWN and the flat string UP to one fixed reference, which is what a partial agonist does — functional antagonist where dopamine is high, agonist where it is low. The tuning fork is intrinsic activity: it is never louder and it is never silent, so nothing in the room can be tuned above it or below it, which is the ceiling effect drawn as an object. Cariprazine is the caged canary over the little heart-lidded baby grand in the corner (cari/canary, and the corner is the limbic sub-chamber where D3 outnumbers D2). Akathisia is native stock — the apprentice who cannot stay on his stool.
המקוםThe tuning floor of a small piano factory mid-morning: a long line of finished uprights standing backs-out with their top doors off and a tuner at each one, benches of wire spools and hammer trays down the other side, the humidity trunking overhead and the loading door open onto the road
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is tuning a piano — striking the note, holding the tuning lever on the pin and easing the string up or down until it sits with the fork
מבנה מרכזיThe line of upright pianos standing back to back, running lower-left to upper-right the whole length of the floor, with the overhead humidity trunking following it

62. O'LANZA, QUAYLE & RISPINמשחק צליל

פרקMetabolic-heavy SGAs: Olanzapine, Quetiapine, Risperidone
משחק המילים'O'Lanza' encodes Olanzapine, 'Quayle' encodes Quetiapine, and 'Rispin' encodes Risperidone.
המקוםA busy commercial bakery on a production morning, with stainless steel dough troughs, cooling conveyors, and flour dust in the air. Long wooden workbenches run between proofing chambers and deck ovens where freshly baked bread is unloaded. Wheeled racks of cooling baguettes and rustic sourdough loaves line the packaging corridor.
מה כולם עושיםScoring sourdough bread loaves with razor-sharp baker's lames.
מבנה מרכזיA 30-foot multi-tier spiral bread-cooling conveyor tower cutting diagonally from the dough divider at the lower left to the overhead discharge chute at the upper right.

63. LURA'S BAIT & TACKLEמשחק צליל

פרקLow-metabolic SGAs: Lurasidone, Ziprasidone, Lumateperone
משחק המיליםLURA'S / LURE = LURAsidone, and the shop's whole trade is bait — which IS the drug fact: lurasidone and ziprasidone are the two SGAs that must be taken WITH FOOD or absorption collapses. You cannot fish here without buying bait. ZIPrasidone is cashed a second time on the rack of 'ZIP' zip-lock bait bags and on the very long tape measure hanging by the weigh scale (QTc prolongation = the long measure). LUMAteperone is cashed a third time on the 'LUMA' headlamp and lantern display for night fishing. Largest lettering is the chalk board 'NO BAIT, NO BITE'.
המקוםA lakeside bait-and-tackle shop at 5am — pegboard walls hung with lures, aerated live-bait tanks bubbling behind the counter, rod racks by the door, headlamps still on
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is kitting out for a dawn trip — buying bait, picking lures off the pegboard, rigging rods at the counter
מבנה מרכזיThe pegboard lure wall and the diagonal run of the bait counter with its lit live-bait tanks, crossing the frame lower-left to upper-right

64. CONSTA-LUBE GREASE & OILמשחק צליל

פרקLong-Acting Injectable Antipsychotics (LAIs)
משחק המיליםCONSTA sits at the head of a name any lubricant firm in the country might paint on its drums, and a grease gun is the plain-English picture of the whole chapter — a charge forced through a needle into a fitting where it sits and feeds the bearing slowly for a fixed number of days — so the venue's ordinary paperwork is the syllabus: the glazed lubrication chart carries the intervals in days per point, which is the fourteen, twenty-eight, eighty-four and one-hundred-and-sixty-eight day dosing spread on a carrier whose real job is printing intervals; the chart's own PRIME TWICE IN WEEK ONE line is the loading regimen and the long-spout drip-feed can kept going for the first three weeks is the oral overlap; the brass tag moved onto a red hook when a point is missed, and the dry bearing squealing on the trolley beside it, are non-adherence and relapse in one object; the refrigerated cupboard is there because some cartridges genuinely will not keep out of the cold; the two nipples on the same axle, one high on the shoulder and one low under the hub, are the deltoid and gluteal sites; and the card on the windscreen reading DO NOT SIGN OUT is the compulsory observation period after the heavy charge, which the garage enforces for its own reasons.
המקוםThe greasing bay of a bus garage on a wet Tuesday: an open inspection pit down the middle with a steel handrail and bulkhead lamps along its wall, a rack of grease drums and a wheeled bucket pump beside it, and the glazed lubrication chart on the wall next to a board of numbered brass tags. A cold store cupboard with a thermometer on its door stands by the bench, and one vehicle sits over the pit with a card on its windscreen.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working a greasing round — reading the next point off the chart, wiping a nipple clean, pushing the gun on and pumping until it takes, then hanging the tag and dating the card.
מבנה מרכזיThe inspection pit — the long open trench with its steel handrail, drain channel and string of bulkhead lamps down the wall — running corner to corner and splitting the bay into the drum rack, the pit itself, the tag-board wall and the wash-down end.

65. THE DAILY EXTRAתמונה מילולית

פרקEPS spectrum: dystonia, akathisia, parkinsonism
משחק המיליםExtrapyramidal already contains its own picture and a newsroom is the one ordinary place that supplies both halves without being asked: EXTRA is the newspaper's own word, painted large on the masthead and shouted for the late edition, and the pyramid hat is the folded-newsprint hat that print workers genuinely wear, walking up from the composing room. The corpus builds exactly this cue (EXTRA plus pyramid hat) and this venue is where it lives natively. The three movement pictures are all native newsroom behaviour rather than invented metaphor: the reporter frozen mid-stride staring at the ceiling for a line, head craned right back and tongue out (acute dystonia, oculogyric); the three reporters pacing the length of the desk run on stretched telephone cords because they cannot make themselves sit down (akathisia, and the corpus's own literal depiction mechanism); the old sub at the horseshoe working in slow motion, hunched, expressionless, his pencil hand trembling over the proof (parkinsonism). The chapter's timing fact is on the wall: everything here is happening within hours.
המקוםThe editorial floor of a small city newspaper twenty minutes before the late edition goes: a double run of desks with typewriters and telephones, a copy spike on every desk, the sub-editors' horseshoe closing the far end, the wire teleprinter chattering against the wall, the pneumatic tube down to the composing room and the deadline clock over the door
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is handling a page of copy — hammering it out on the typewriter, pulling it off the roller, correcting it, spiking it and walking it up the room to the horseshoe
מבנה מרכזיThe double run of reporters' desks butted end to end, running lower-left to upper-right, with the sub-editors' horseshoe table closing its far end under the deadline clock

66. TARDY GATE WORKSמשחק צליל

פרקTardive Dyskinesia + VMAT2 inhibitors
משחק המיליםTardive is simply tardy, and Tardy Gate reads as a genuine works entrance — it is a real place name in Lancashire — so the sign is an ordinary factory gate that happens to print the one word that dates the syndrome. The time office then carries every exam fact on objects whose real job is to carry them: the stamp lands LATE and it lands in permanent red ink on a card that cannot be un-stamped (often irreversible); the long-service honours board with its year columns is the risk, which is cumulative exposure in years, and the men worst affected are standing under the longest column; the timekeeper's hatch frames faces, which is where the movements are worst (orofacial before limbs before trunk); and the time-and-motion man working down the queue with a stopwatch and a rating sheet is a screening instrument scoring involuntary movement item by item, which is AIMS drawn as an ordinary industrial job. The gate is the pine mill's own gate, so switching treatment is walking through it into the yard.
המקוםThe clocking-in lobby of a timber works at six in the morning: a waist-high card rack of numbered pigeonholes down the room, the cast-iron time recorder bolted at its near end, a queue of men along it, the timekeeper's hatch at the far end with the late book open on the sill and the pine yard visible through the window
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is clocking in — pulling his card out of the OUT rack, pushing it into the recorder for the stamp, dropping it into the IN rack and walking on
מבנה מרכזיThe clocking-in run: the waist-high timber card rack of numbered pigeonholes running lower-left to upper-right, the cast-iron time recorder bolted at its near end and the timekeeper's hatch closing its far end

67. N. M. SALTER & CO. FOUNDRYראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקNeuroleptic Malignant Syndrome
משחק המיליםThe company initials N. M. S. embed Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).
המקוםA high-bay iron casting foundry on a working Tuesday morning, lit by dusty skylights and the orange glow of the cupola furnace. Sand-casting flask boxes lie stacked in neat runs across the rammed-earth floor, while heavy iron pouring ladles rest in floor stands beside the tapping spout. Through the open loading doorway in the back wall, the rail siding runs up to the colliery coal bunker.
מה כולם עושיםramming green sand into moulding flask boxes with wooden rammers
מבנה מרכזיThe overhead gantry crane and its long steel runway beam cutting diagonally across the foundry from the furnace tap at upper left to the casting shakeout floor at lower right

68. THE CAT & TONICמשחק צליל

פרקCatatonia
משחק המיליםCATATONIC splits cleanly into two ordinary words that make a perfectly plausible pub name — 'The Cat and Fiddle' is the template — so the name is two innocent nouns, never the diagnosis printed out. The pub then supplies the criteria from its own furniture: the regular whose arm the barman lifts to wipe the counter and which simply stays up is waxy flexibility (the wax runs down the candle-bottle beside him), the man who will not speak to the barmaid is mutism, the man who pulls the door marked PUSH is negativism, the drinker tapping the same beermat over and over is stereotypy, and the jukebox stuck repeating one line is echolalia. Largest lettering is the chalked board 'ORDERS TAKEN, NONE GIVEN'. The pub sits next door to Ben's Diner, because the lorazepam challenge is the diagnostic test.
המקוםA village pub at three in the afternoon — a long polished bar with a row of hand-pumps, mirrored back-bar, a snug with a bench, a dartboard corner, an unlit fireplace
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having an unhurried afternoon pint at the bar and in the snug
מבנה מרכזיThe long polished bar counter with its bank of hand-pump handles and brass foot rail, running lower-left to upper-right, with the mirrored back-bar behind it, splitting the frame into bar, snug, dartboard corner and doorway

69. THE DOWN ESCALATORמשחק צליל

פרקAcute psychosis ED management
משחק המיליםDe-escalation contains ESCALATOR whole, and the object it names is also the best inanimate diagonal in ordinary retail, so the pun and the anchor are the same thing. The store then runs the chapter's ladder as its own everyday procedure, in order: keep your exit behind you and the counter between you (safety first — the floorwalker standing with the open aisle at his back); one member of staff only speaks, at arm's length, everyone else told to stand off, and a chair and a cup of tea offered from the café trolley (verbal de-escalation, which is where the ladder is supposed to stop); the fragrance counter's tester tray of three atomisers taken together (the three-drug intramuscular combination) with a printed card on the tray forbidding one pair of them from being combined; and only then, at the very foot of the run, the emergency stop under its flip cover — deliberate, hand on the clock, written up afterwards in the incident book on the service desk (physical restraint: last resort, time-limited, documented). The floor-directory board is the frame's only proper numbered carrier.
המקוםThe escalator well of a four-floor department store on a Saturday afternoon: the two escalator runs crossing the well, a brass floor-directory board at the foot, the glass counters of the fragrance hall spread around it, a customer-service desk under the stairs, a rope barrier and stanchions across one aisle and a store detective standing on the half-landing
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is riding the escalator down through the store — stepping on at the top with their bags, standing the ride out, stepping off at the comb plate at the bottom
מבנה מרכזיThe down escalator itself, cutting the frame corner to corner: comb plate at the foot, moving handrail, balustrade lamps running its whole length and the emergency stop button under its flip cover at the newel

70. EDDY'S CUT & TACKראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקECT and other somatic therapies
משחק המיליםE, C and T stand as ordered word-initials inside a perfectly ordinary trade fascia — Eddy's, Cut, Tack — which is the expreSS tRIps device, and the sign never says what it is for. The pun then pays out on every aspect without a single invented metaphor, because a welding shop already does, as routine work, everything this chapter teaches. A brief controlled current is passed through a workpiece that has been clamped so it cannot move: that is a tack weld and it is also the treatment. The choice the shop argues about all day is whether to run one side of the joint or both — single-sided against double-sided — which is unilateral against bilateral placement in the trade's own words. A course is a counted run of tacks chalked off on a tally board, not one long pass. The current dial and the ammeter are dose and threshold, and the strike current needed to establish the arc is the seizure threshold. The side effects are native too: the chalk setting-out marks burn clean off the steel either side of a seam and never come back, while fresh chalk will not take on hot metal at all — retrograde and anterograde amnesia rendered as one ordinary nuisance — and every welder in the frame is lifting a helmet and blinking at an after-image, which is post-ictal confusion by literal depiction. The comparators fit the same inventory: a magnetic drill working with no contact at all is induction, a regulated gas line is the anaesthetic, an earth cable clamped round the neck of a workpiece is a continuous stimulator, and an electrode driven deep into the middle of a thick block is the deep one. The apprentice permit board on the wall is the consent and minors question as posted shop regulation. The yard gate is declared adjacency: the rigid, red-hot piece that arrives from North Main Steel next door is the indication that walks in from the chapter next door.
המקוםA jobbing welding and fabrication shop in a small industrial unit, mid-morning: the roller shutter up onto the yard, six welding bays screened off down one side by hanging flame-proof curtains, a chained rack of gas cylinders against the wall, the finished-work bench under the window, and a barrow of hot billets just wheeled in through the side gate from the steelworks next door.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is running a weld through: clamping a piece into the jig, flipping the helmet down and striking the arc, laying one short tack and marking it off on the job card, lifting the helmet to blink and chip the slag away, then setting up for the next pass.
מבנה מרכזיThe long slotted cast-iron fit-up bench — clamp jig, earth bar and the run of screened bays along its length — crossing from the lower-left corner of the frame to the upper right, splitting the shop into the yard shutter, the bay line, the cylinder wall and the finished-work bench.

71. SHUT EYE BLINDSמבנה מרחבי

פרקInsomnia + CBT-I
משחק המיליםCBT-I's two working instructions are narrow the sleep window and let the bed mean only sleep; a blind shop is an ordinary room full of window openings that are measured, masked down and shut, and the trade's own English for the result is shut-eye. Sleep efficiency is also the shop's native quantity — how much of the opening the fabric actually blocks — and every swatch here is sold on that percentage, so the chapter's numbers ride on a carrier whose real job is to carry a percentage. The sign takes only the ordinary word for sleep and never the diagnosis, and the shop stands two doors from the mattress showroom of the next chapter, which is what you reach for when the blinds are not enough.
המקוםA window-blind and shutter shop in a quiet strip-mall parade, mid-morning: a display wall of dummy windows each dressed differently, a fitting bench heaped with cut roller tubes, swatch books chained to a rail, and a fitter's van half-loaded at the kerb outside
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is fitting a blind to a window — running a tape across the opening, cutting the tube to length, hanging it on its brackets and pulling it down to see how much light it shuts out
מבנה מרכזיThe long cutting bench with its steel measuring rule and rotary saw, running from the shopfront glass at lower left to the stockroom door at upper right, racked roller tubes stacked underneath along its whole length

72. Z.Z.Z. MATTRESSESראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSleep aids: Z-drugs, DORAs, Melatonin
משחק המיליםThe class letter Z, counted three times, is the corpus's own venue for the three z-drugs — zolpidem, zaleplon, eszopiclone — and reusing it verbatim buys a whole chapter of free rehearsal for anyone who has met the page before. The showroom then pays for the two newer families off its own stock: the glass DOUBLE DOORS at the front, barred shut by a sales rep whose badge reads DORA, are the dual orexin receptor antagonists blocking OX1 and OX2 (suvorexant, lemborexant, daridorexant — three key fobs on her belt); and the blackout-curtain display with a pine cone sitting on the sales desk is melatonin, made in the pineal gland and released only in darkness. Largest lettering is the hanging banner 'WALK OUT IN YOUR SLEEP' — the complex sleep-behaviour boxed warning.
המקוםA strip-mall mattress showroom on a slow weekday — a diagonal row of display beds under fluorescent tubes, price tags on wire stems, a cutaway mattress on a plinth, glass double doors at the front
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is trying out beds — lying down on the displays, testing the adjustable bases, being written up at the sales desk
מבנה מרכזיThe row of display bed frames running lower-left to upper-right across the showroom floor, dividing front doors, sales floor and the curtained stockroom

73. CATAPLEX CINEMASמשחק צליל

פרקNarcolepsy + Pitolisant
משחק המיליםcataplexy -> multiPLEX. 'CATAPLEX CINEMAS' reads as an ordinary strip-mall multiplex while carrying narcolepsy's defining symptom, and the venue then supplies the rest of the tetrad without invention: everyone falls asleep at the movies (sleep attacks), the film on the screen is the hypnagogic hallucination played while you are still awake, and being unable to move in your seat is sleep paralysis. Screen 3 is the H3 receptor and the projectionist running that reel backwards is pitolisant's inverse agonism. The lobby claw machine whose claw goes limp and drops the prize while the lights stay on is cataplexy exactly - tone lost, consciousness kept.
המקוםA suburban four-screen multiplex on a weekday afternoon: sticky carpet, the concessions counter, a roped queue, and the open door of Screen 3 with the trailers already running
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is going to the movies - buying tickets and popcorn, waiting at the rope, filing in and sitting through the show
מבנה מרכזיThe raked bank of seating rows and the central aisle running lower-left to upper-right, with the lit screen wall and the projector beam crossing above them

74. THE NIGHT ROVERתמונה מילולית

פרקParasomnias + RLS
משחק המיליםA named night service reading THE NIGHT ROVER is what a railway genuinely letters on a headboard and a ticket, and it is also the plain-English picture of this entire chapter — people up and roving in the small hours when they are supposed to be lying still — while the carriage supplies the examinable structure for nothing: an overnight run is a printed timetable, so the night's thirds arrive already numbered on the card in the corridor frame, and the deep-sleep events sit in the first third just out of the terminus (the child bolt upright and inconsolable in the family berth, remembering none of it in the morning) against the dream events in the last third before arrival (the man rowing and swinging his arms in his sleep in the upper bunk, and his neighbour awake, alert and able to tell you the whole thing), which is the non-REM versus REM split drawn as stations passed; the berth itself is the classic provocation for the legs, since sitting still in the evening in a train is exactly where the urge arrives and walking the corridor is exactly what relieves it, so the aisle-pacers and the kicking feet under the blanket in berth after berth need no explaining; and the EARLY CALL cards hung outside the doors with times pencilled steadily earlier are augmentation on a carrier whose real job is bearing times.
המקוםThe sleeping car of an overnight service, ten minutes out from the last stop: a side corridor with a brass handrail, ribbed rubber floor and a run of dropped windows, berth doors down the other side with numbered plates and call-bell pushes beside each one. The attendant's pantry at the end has the tea urn, the crate and the board of berth cards on it, and two berth doors stand open on made-up bunks with the folding ladder hooked at the foot.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is turning in — making up a berth, climbing to the upper bunk, hanging a jacket on the door hook, filling in a breakfast card and hooking it outside, working along the handrail to the lavatory and back.
מבנה מרכזיThe side corridor — the full-length passage with its brass handrail, ribbed floor and row of dropped windows — receding from the lower left corner to the upper right and splitting the car into the berths, the corridor, the vestibule and the attendant's pantry.

75. SHORT POUND LOCKמבנה מרחבי

פרקAnorexia Nervosa
משחק המיליםA lock exists to raise something starved of water back up to level, and the one absolute rule of working one is that you let the water in slowly, a notch at a time — draw all the paddles at once and the chamber boils in, the boat is thrown against the cill and holed. That is refeeding syndrome, drawn as the trade's own cardinal safety rule rather than as a metaphor, and it is the single hardest fact in the chapter to place anywhere else. The sign is the second half of the pun: on a canal a pound is the level stretch of water between two locks, and a pound short of water is the everyday phrase for a level that has run too low to float anything — while in trade a short pound is a pound that weighs less than a pound. One three-word place name that a canal would genuinely carry therefore says low weight twice, in two registers, and never says the diagnosis. The rest of the syllabus falls out of the stock: the subtypes are two boats, one that takes nothing on at all and one that fills its tank and then runs the bilge pump straight back over the side; the gauge board and the boat-gauging tape are the assessment instruments and also the disturbed reading of a hull that plainly fits and is recorded as too wide; bradycardia is the paddle wound at half speed, hypothermia the cold green water, the low electrolytes three low marks on the same board, and osteopenia the crumbling mortar of the chamber wall, which is the only structural thing in the frame and is losing it. Family-based treatment is the strongest image the venue supplies: a family works one boat through with the parents on the paddle gear controlling the rate of filling and the adolescent aboard, which is exactly the transfer of control FBT prescribes. Mortality is carried by the lifebelt, the rescue pole and the plate on the wall, and by the fact that this is the only venue in the batch where the ordinary hazard is drowning.
המקוםA canal lock on a working navigation, mid-morning: the stone chamber with its gates shut at the tail, balance beams swung out over the towpath, a queue of narrowboats waiting down on the low pound below with their propellers half out of the water, and the lock cottage with its porch bench and gauging tape at the top of the steps.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working a boat through the lock: winding a paddle up one notch at a time on a windlass, leaning a balance beam round to swing a gate, holding a centre line while the chamber fills, watching the water climb the painted gauge board, and stepping off to set the next one.
מבנה מרכזיThe lock chamber wall itself — the long coursed stone face with its painted gauge board, ladder rungs, green water line and spalled mortar — running from the bottom-left of the frame to the top right, dividing the scene into the starved low pound with its waiting boats, the towpath and beams, the chamber, and the full pound above.

76. BULLIMORE & SON, COOPERSמשחק צליל

פרקBulimia Nervosa + Binge Eating Disorder
משחק המיליםBULLIMORE is a real family name that carries B-U-L-I-M as an ordered subsequence in the expreSS tRIps manner and reads out loud as BULL-MORE, which is exactly what the word means — Greek bous limos, ox-hunger — so the fascia is the term's own etymology painted as a family firm and no clinical word appears on it. The trade is then the cycle itself: a cask is filled to the bung in one go and emptied down the grating in minutes, over and over, several times a week, and the register on the bench is ruled a line a week with the last twelve weeks ticked; and because a cask looks precisely the same full or empty from outside, this trade tests it by tapping it, which is why bulimia at an unremarkable weight is invisible unless you ask. The medical mimics are the cooperage's ordinary defects and are already chalked on the stock: staves eaten thin and pale on the inside where the liquid stood and the chime worn back (dental erosion), the pair of casks at the door swollen at the bilge with EASE HOOPS chalked on them (parotids), one split lengthwise at the head from being filled too hard (Mallory-Weiss), the potash drum run low (potassium), and every man's knuckles skinned by the hoop driver with the plaster tin left open beside it. Shape is what this trade judges everything by — the shape gauge is held to the bilge and a cask off shape is worth nothing however sound it is — and the one cask standing bunged and still full in the corner, chalked LEFT FULL, is the binge that is never got rid of.
המקוםA working cooperage on an ordinary morning: the test bay down the middle with a filling stand-pipe over a floor grating, casks standing on end along both walls with their gallonage stencilled on the head, and the raising fire and hoop-driving block at the far end. The men's snap bench and stove are in the corner by the window, and a shaving horse and a rack of staves fill the wall behind them.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is testing a cask — rolling it onto the stand, filling it to the bunghole from the hose, tapping it round with the sounding hammer to hear where it is, then drawing the bung and letting the whole lot go straight down the grating.
מבנה מרכזיThe roll-way — the timber runway with its floor grating, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, from the raising fire past the filling stand-pipe to the stack of finished casks at the packing end.

77. PICK-A-PART SALVAGEמשחק צליל

פרקARFID + Pica + Rumination
משחק המיליםPICA -> 'PICK-A-PART', which is genuinely what self-service wrecking yards are called, and the yard's stock IS the pica menu with nothing added: paint chips, chalky brake dust, rubber, seat foam, wire, glass, soil. Junkyards label their rows with letter codes, so ARFID gets a fully diegetic home on a painted marker post reading AISLE ARFID; the gloved, masked picker who will take only smooth chrome and refuses anything rusty is the sensory-avoidant subtype. The goat tethered at the gate, chewing a rag and bringing it back up, is rumination in the one animal that does it for a living.
המקוםA self-service auto salvage yard on a Saturday: rows of stripped car hulks up on their rims, a gravel aisle between them, the parts-counter shed and a crane at the far end
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is walking the rows with a wheelbarrow and a socket set, pulling parts off the wrecks and carrying them down to the counter
מבנה מרכזיThe long row of stripped car bodies raised on bare rims, running lower-left to upper-right, with the painted aisle-marker posts and the crane at the far end

78. URE VALLEY WATERWORKSמשחק צליל

פרקEnuresis + Encopresis
משחק המיליםURE is the middle of enuresis and it is also a real river, so an ordinary water board's name carries the morpheme while reading as a utility and printing no diagnosis. The rest of the chapter is the works' own daily trouble in physical form: a tank that empties itself in the night because the float has stuck, a level bell on a bracket that is supposed to wake the duty man and does not, a valve throttled down for the night shift so less comes through; and for the chapter's second half a screen that packs solid until the channel backs up behind it and slops over the weir, which is retention with overflow, cleared by the rodding gang and a sack of white powder dosed into the flow.
המקוםA small municipal water pumping station on the morning round: a brick engine house with two pumps, an open storage tank with a float and a level board, a screen chamber with a rake leaning against it, a run of valve wheels along the wall and a duty board by the door
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is doing the round — dipping the tank, cranking the valve wheels shut, raking the screen clear and writing the reading up on the board
מבנה מרכזיThe open concrete channel with its sluice gate and overflow weir, running corner to corner across the yard with a steel walkway bridging it half way along

79. CIRCA COACHWAYS TERMINALמשחק צליל

פרקSleep development in children + adolescent shift
משחק המילים'CIRCA' phonetically encodes 'circadian', denoting the 24-hour biological rhythm and developmental shifts across childhood and adolescence.
המקוםA municipal coach departure terminal on an overcast late afternoon, smelling of diesel exhaust, hot tea, and floor polish. Under the high glass concourse roof, passengers wait along the platform barrier rail while buses reverse into their numbered bays. Outside through the glazed entrance wall, the street frontage opens onto the commercial forecourt.
מה כולם עושיםpunching date stamps onto card tickets at the departure barrier
מבנה מרכזיThe suspended concourse canopy and tubular barrier rail cutting diagonally across the terminal floor from the early-morning express bays at upper left to the late-night departure gate at lower right

80. F. B. TRENT & SONS STRUCTURAL TIMBERראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקEating disorders intensive: FBT + medical stabilization
משחק המיליםThe initials F. B. T. embed Family-Based Treatment (FBT), the first-line Maudsley model for adolescent eating disorders.
המקוםA timber truss fabrication works on an ordinary working Thursday, smelling of fresh pine sawdust and machine oil. Long structural chords of Douglas fir lie laid out across steel assembly jigs while pneumatic tools hang from overhead spring balancers. Finished roof trusses are strapped into delivery bundles beside the wide sliding yard doors.
מה כולם עושיםdriving galvanized gang-nail plates into timber chord joints with a hydraulic press
מבנה מרכזיThe forty-foot steel truss jig table and its traveling hydraulic press gantry cutting diagonally across the workshop from the timber stock racks at upper left to the inspection bay at lower right

81. CIder WAgonsראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקAlcohol Use Disorder + Withdrawal
משחק המיליםCIWA — the scale this whole chapter is scored on — stands in order inside an ordinary farm business name, CIder WAgons, exactly the expreSS tRIps device; and the wagon at the door pays a second time, because being on the wagon and falling off it is the plain English of abstinence and relapse, so one man can sit up on the dray with the reins while another is on the ground beside the wheel. The press house then supplies the withdrawal picture without inventing anything: a whole building that shudders while the mill runs, a shed full of vessels that have to be brought down slowly rather than stopped, and a chalk tally board where every load coming in is scored as it arrives.
המקוםA farm cider press house on pressing day: apple bins tipped at the door, a rack-and-cloth press standing under its beam, the slatted elevator carrying fruit up to the loft hopper, barrels ranked along a stillage down one wall and the farm-shop hatch open onto the yard where the loaded dray waits
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is pressing the day's apples — tipping bins into the hopper, building the cheese of cloths, winding the screw down and running the juice off into barrels
מבנה מרכזיThe slatted apple elevator, running from the yard bins at lower left up to the loft hopper at upper right, with the press standing under its head and the stillage of barrels beneath it

82. CAMP ROSEמשחק צליל

פרקAlcohol treatment: Naltrexone, Acamprosate, Disulfiram
משחק המיליםa-CAMP-ROSe-ate becomes CAMP ROSE, a name every state park already owns. The campground then hands over the other two drugs from its own standing furniture rather than from invented symbols: the standpipe stencilled NON-POTABLE - DO NOT DRINK is disulfiram's entire clinical contract, the camper by the fire ring gone bright red in the face and neck is what happens if he ignores it, and the shower-block card reading PLEASE FLUSH names the reaction on a door that genuinely carries that word. The padlocked bear-proof box that will only close on an empty container is naltrexone's opioid-free requirement, with a child's toy T-rex dropped in the dirt beside it to name it; the RV DUMP STATION is acamprosate's renal clearance.
המקוםA state-park campground on a Friday evening: a timber entrance arch, a gravel loop road past numbered pitches, tents and a couple of RVs, the toilet-and-shower block and the ranger's notice board
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is making camp - pitching tents, laying fires in the rings, filling water containers and cooking supper at their own pitch
מבנה מרכזיThe gravel loop road with its timber entrance arch, running lower-left to upper-right past the numbered pitch posts to the shower block

83. POPPY LANE CREAMERYתמונה מילולית

פרקOpioid Use Disorder + Withdrawal
משחק המיליםThe poppy is the plant this entire chapter comes out of, so the dairy's lane name is the term's own picture and the diagnosis is never printed. The creamery is chosen because the fixed course symbol for this chapter is already a farm — the cow that says moo is the receptor — so the token can stand up the lane and send its churns in at the door instead of being bolted onto an unrelated world. Everything else is ordinary dairy work doing the clinical work for free: a supervised measured pour into a marked jug every morning for each name on the round, a vessel that cannot be filled past its overflow lip however hard you pour, a chill room where every bare forearm goes to gooseflesh, and taps, drips and running noses the length of the building.
המקוםA small country creamery at the morning intake: churns swung off the stand into the weighing trough, the separator and pasteuriser pipework running down the middle of the tiled room, a chill room with its heavy door propped open, and a measured-pour hatch onto the yard where the doorstep round is being loaded
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is taking in and measuring out the morning milk — tipping churns into the trough, running it through the separator, and filling each round's jug to the marked line at the hatch
מבנה מרכזיThe stainless intake trough and its pipe run, crossing the tiled floor from the churn stand at lower left to the tanker bay door at upper right, with the separator standing over the middle of it

84. DON'S ONE-STOP FUELמשחק צליל

פרקOUD treatment: Methadone, Buprenorphine, Naltrexone, Naloxone
משחק המיליםmethaDON-e plus the shared -ONE of naloxone and naltrexone give DON'S ONE-STOP, a name any roadside filling station already carries, and the forecourt then does the pharmacology out of its own hardware: the FULL SERVE lane where the attendant fills to the brim every morning and hands the ticket over is supervised methadone dosing; the self-serve nozzle that clicks itself off three-quarters up is buprenorphine's ceiling effect; the WRONG FUEL - ENGINE DAMAGE decal is precipitated withdrawal; the red EMERGENCY STOP that cuts every pump instantly and must then be reset is naloxone, short-acting and repeatable; and the covered pump carded OUT OF USE - TANK MUST BE EMPTY is naltrexone's opioid-free window. The ticket tucked under the wiper blade rather than posted through the window is sublingual, not swallowed.
המקוםA two-island filling station on the edge of town at seven in the morning: a canopy over four pumps, a queue of cars nose to tail for the full-serve lane, the kiosk window and the air-and-water bay
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is filling up - queueing onto the island, holding the nozzle, waiting to be served at the kiosk hatch and paying
מבנה מרכזיThe pump-island canopy and the row of pumps and hoses running lower-left to upper-right, with the price totem at the near end

85. PURE CUT CRYSTALתמונה מילולית

פרקStimulant Use Disorder
משחק המיליםPURE, CUT and CRYSTAL are the glass trade's own flat everyday words for its product and are simultaneously the street vocabulary of the class this chapter covers, so an ordinary works fascia names the drugs in plain English while naming nothing but glass.
המקוםA cut-glass works on a hot afternoon: a long run of cutting frames under one line shaft, every wheel spinning with its water can dripping over it, racks of chalked blanks waiting along the wall behind. The acid-polish room is shut off behind a hazard-boarded door at the end, and the packing bench with its straw and stencilled crates stands by the loading door.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is cutting the same pattern — marking the blank out in whiting, holding it up under the mitre wheel, running the cuts, dipping it in the trough and carrying it on to the polishing wheel.
מבנה מרכזיThe line shaft and its run of cutting frames — one long bench of spinning wheels with the flat belts dropping to each from the shaft overhead — cutting from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, dividing the shop into the blank racks, the cutting line, the polishing end and the packing bay.

86. HIGH STREET POTTERYמשחק צליל

פרקCannabis Use Disorder + Cannabis-induced disorders
משחק המיליםEvery street word for this chapter is already the pottery trade's own vocabulary, so the venue pays out four puns off stock it was obliged to carry anyway: the shop's completely ordinary fascia name carries HIGH and POT together, the kiln BAKES, the first firing is called BISCUIT (the tin on the shelf is emptied of them — munchies on a native object), and unfired ware is called GREENWARE. Nothing is imported and nothing is invented; a potbank is a boring, physically coherent workplace whose whole inventory is pots.
המקוםA working pottery on a high street mid-morning: two rows of kick wheels down the throwing shop, ware boards racked to the ceiling, clay bags stacked by the pug mill, and the brick arch of the kiln room at the back with a loaded kiln car standing on its rails
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the throwing shift — wedging clay, centring and pulling up pots on the wheels, and carrying boards of finished ware down to the kiln
מבנה מרכזיThe loaded kiln car on its steel rails, running from the lower-left of the throwing floor up into the kiln arch at the upper right, with the racked ware boards standing behind it

87. VARENICLEAN WINDOWSמשחק צליל

פרקTobacco cessation: Varenicline, NRT, Bupropion
משחק המיליםVARENICLEAN is a near-total homophone of varenicline (va-reni-kleen) and reads exactly like a real cleaning firm's van livery, and the word WINDOWS keeps it clear of any laundry trade. The premises make cessation native rather than imported: getting the yellow nicotine film off pub glass is a real thing this trade is paid for. The rest of the class then lands on genuine window furniture — a sash restrictor lets the window open part way and only part way, which is partial agonism and competitive block in one ordinary catch; leaded lozenge panes, gum scraped off the glass with the blade and a taped pane patch are NRT's three forms on glazier's stock; and a casement prop lying on the sill carries buPROPion.
המקוםA window-cleaning firm working its morning round on an old parade of shops and the smoke-yellowed pub on the corner: the liveried van at the kerb with its water tank and pole rig, buckets and squeegees out on the pavement, ladders pitched to the first-floor sashes
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the round — wetting the glass, scrubbing the yellow smoke film off it, squeegeeing down and drying the sills
מבנה מרכזיThe long extension ladder pitched from the lower-left kerb up to the upper-right first-floor sill, with the parade's gutter run and fascia board it leans against crossing the frame behind it

88. THE TAPER WORKSמשחק צליל

פרקSedative/Hypnotic/Anxiolytic Use Disorder
משחק המיליםA taper is a thin candle and a taper is the one instruction this chapter exists to give, and they are the same word, so a working candle shop puts the treatment rule on the fascia in the shop's own honest trade English. The device pays out because everything a taper does physically is what a dose schedule does: the burn-test bench carries a graded run of candles stepping down in height across the board, which is a written withdrawal schedule rendered as an object; and the one at the end that was snapped off and blown out instead of snuffed has flared, scorched the bench and put the fire bucket into the picture — an abrupt stop that turned dangerous, which is precisely why the chapter says withdrawal from this class can kill and alcohol-type withdrawal from any other cannot be assumed milder. The shop rules board carries the never-blow-one-out rule as posted regulation, which is the deontic half of the chapter. Cross-tolerance is a native fact of the trade rather than a metaphor: the same frames of wicks go into any vat on the bench, paraffin, stearin or beeswax, and the spirit bottle kept under the bench for thinning is the fourth thing that fits. The three drug families each get a prop family of their own — the graded tapers, three boxes stamped with Z's, and the barbed wire along the wall opposite — without any of them becoming the venue. The seafront back parade is a declared adjacency, not an accident: the deckchair hire at the end of the terrace is the prescribing chapter, and putting the use-disorder shop a few doors down the same parade is the corpus's barbershop-next-to-Cab-A move, where which building is next door is itself the teaching. It also puts the fixed five-storey hotel across the street as an ordinary seaside guest house rather than an imported structure.
המקוםA small candle works with its dipping room open to the street on a seaside town's back parade, late afternoon: a row of heated wax vats down the middle, frames of wicks hanging over them from the overhead rail, the cooling rack along one wall, the burn-test bench beyond it and the packing counter at the sash window, with the deckchair lock-up at the end of the terrace and the five-storey hotel directly opposite.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is dipping tapers: lifting a frame of wicks off the rail, lowering it into a vat for a slow count, raising it and standing it on the cooling rack, then taking it round again — one thin layer at a time, over and over.
מבנה מרכזיThe long dipping bench — the run of heated wax vats with the overhead wick rail above it and the cooling rack alongside — crossing the room from the lower-left corner to the upper right, dividing it into the vats, the cooling rack, the burn-test bench and the packing counter at the street window.

89. LOWER STREET DECORATORSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקHallucinogen + Caffeine + Inhalants
משחק המיליםL, S and D stand as the ordered word-initials of an unremarkable merchant's fascia, so the chapter's headline hallucinogen is painted right across a shop whose ordinary stock is the rest of the chapter.
המקוםA decorators' merchant on a wet Tuesday: a long trade counter with the tinting machine and the shaker standing at its far end, floor-to-ceiling racking of tins behind it, and a round pattern-book table in the front window where the wallpaper books are chained down. The caged solvent store stands at the back with its hazard boards screwed to the mesh, and the tea room and the wash-out room open off either side of the counter's head.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having a colour made up — picking a chip off the card carousel, calling the number over the counter, waiting out the shaker's two minutes with a cup from the urn, and carrying the tin away with the number stamped on the lid.
מבנה מרכזיThe trade counter with the tinting machine and the shaker standing at its head — running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right — dividing the shop into the pattern-book table and window, the customer side of the counter, the racked tin wall behind it, and the caged solvent store at the back.

90. CHASE'S PLEDGE OFFICEמשחק צליל

פרקGambling Disorder + behavioral addictions
משחק המיליםBoth words on the fascia are ordinary pawnbroking and both are the chapter. Chase is a plain surname and chasing losses is the criterion that defines the disorder; a pledge is the object left over the counter and the pledge is what is taken at the Thursday meeting; and a pledge office is genuine trade English for the shop, so nothing on the sign is a joke a real high street would not carry. The venue was chosen over the obvious one because the casino is a fixed course-wide symbol and must stand inside the chapter's world, not replace it — so the world is the shop on the other side of the road, and the traffic between the two is the whole mechanism. Chasing is not asserted, it is drawn: the same watch redeemed and re-pawned, three stubs deep on the same spike, the customer going back out of the door and across. Tolerance is the escalating size of what comes in. The wedding ring in the tray is the relationship criterion and the parent at the counter paying off someone else's ticket is the bailout criterion, both of them literal depiction with no invented glyph. A pawnshop is also the only ordinary venue that keeps an explicit written list of what it will and will not take, which is where the DSM's decision lives: the dice are on the accepted list, and the games console sits in the locked cabinet with a not-yet label on it, because internet gaming is filed for further study rather than admitted. Treatment fits the same furniture — the small ad card in the window for the Thursday back-room meeting, the ledger where what was actually got back is written next to what was paid, and the bolt on the door. The stock inventory is enormous and every item on the shelf is a life someone has already handed over, which is a free fact-slot per object.
המקוםA high-street pawnbroker's on a Friday afternoon: a long counter with a brass grille, the redemption window at one end, a wall of racked guitars, watches and labelled unredeemed lots behind it, bicycles hung from the ceiling, and the shop door standing open onto the street with the amusement arcade opposite.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is pawning or redeeming something over the counter: unwrapping a watch out of a tea towel, watching it weighed and put under the loupe, taking a numbered ticket and counting the notes, or handing a ticket back through the grille and waiting while the lot is fetched.
מבנה מרכזיThe long mahogany pledge counter with its brass grille and the loaded ticket spike standing on it, running from the lower-left corner of the frame to the upper right, splitting the shop into the queue by the open door, the counter, the racked stock wall and the strong-room passage.

91. PARA LOFTמשחק צליל

פרקParanoid Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםPARA is the chapter title's own first morpheme and 'para loft' is the genuine trade name for the room where rigs are packed, so the sign is both the pun and a real place. The venue's actual working rule — you pack your own rig and you do not take another rigger's word for it — states the disorder's central criterion as a workplace regulation instead of as a mood, which is exactly the move the picture needs.
המקוםThe packing loft of a small airfield drop-zone: a long low room with a rubberised floor, canopies stretched out full length, steel lockers down one wall, the windsock visible through the open door
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is packing and inspecting a parachute rig — flaking lines, checking every fold, filling in their own logbook
מבנה מרכזיThe forty-foot rubberised packing table running corner to corner with a canopy stretched along its whole length and the suspension lines laid out beyond it

92. SOLO CLASS MODEL YACHTSמבנה מרחבי

פרקSchizoid Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםThe pond's geometry is the disorder. Twenty people stand round one sheet of water doing exactly the same thing at exactly the same time, each rooted to his own arc of the coping, none of them closer than four paces to the next, and not one boat ever comes alongside another — present, parallel, permanently out of contact, and nobody in the frame is troubled by it. That is the distinction the chapter turns on, and the venue draws it rather than asserting it: the man on the far bank holding a boat he will not put on the water, watching a hut door he will not walk through, is Avoidant and he is plainly suffering; the men on the wall would not notice if the hut were open or shut, and that is Schizoid. The class name on the board does the retrieval work — Solo is a real single-handed class, so the fascia says solitary activities in the sport's own vocabulary without printing a diagnosis. The rest of the criteria are stock: one flask and one cup, a courting couple passing behind the trestles entirely unregistered, nobody smiling at a win, a member who reacts neither to the trophy shelf nor to the protest flag raised against him, and a flat face at a transmitter. The autism differential gets its own figure without a second venue — the member sailing the identical circuit over and over with his tools laid out in a rigid row is restricted and repetitive, which the others are not. Treatment is the coach who stands a deliberate two paces back and passes a spanner across without small talk. And the pond has, as an ordinary municipal feature, a small island with one tree on it, which is where the chapter's fixed glyph stands without being imported.
המקוםA municipal model-yacht pond in a park on a Sunday morning: a paved perimeter walk right round the water, a small brick club hut with a glazed noticeboard beside its door, boat trestles set out along the path at wide intervals, and a low concrete island with a single tree standing in the middle of the pond.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is sailing a model yacht: standing at their own spot on the perimeter walk with a transmitter, trimming a sail, walking a few paces along the coping to follow the boat, lifting it out at the wall to shift the rig, and setting it back on the water.
מבנה מרכזיThe pond's long concrete rim and perimeter walk — the coping, the boat trestles ranged along it and the low island wall beyond — running from the bottom-left corner of the frame to the top right, splitting the scene into the club hut, the near walk, the open water with its island, and the far bank.

93. TIPI TOP BRIC-A-BRACמשחק צליל

פרקSchizotypal Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםTypal to tipi is the course's own fixed derivation for this disorder and Tipi Top is the sort of cheery name a junk shop on a parade genuinely carries, so the fascia holds the phonetic hook while the actual tipi stands pitched at the back of the same room — the pun said twice, once in lettering and once in canvas. The shop was chosen because every object the fixed glyph needs is already its stock: the tarot deck under a rubber band, the crystal ball on a doily, the lava lamp, the dream catcher, the astrological chart and the four layers of donated clothing a rummage puts on a real customer's back, so odd appearance needs no inventing. The criteria hardest to draw are the ones the trade supplies best: the shoebox of second-hand greetings cards is a rack of messages addressed to a stranger in the second person — THIS IS YOUR DAY, SOMEONE IS THINKING OF YOU — and the customer standing with one of them open is idea of reference on pre-printed stock, doubled by the donated television plugged in to prove it works with its presenter apparently talking straight at her. The differential is native too: the foxed mirror and the crackling transistor are unusual perceptual experiences that anyone can check are simply a bad mirror and a bad radio, because nothing here is actually psychotic and everything works once you wind it. Treatment is on the tickets — the hand-written HOW IT WORKS card tied to the mangle, worked through step by step with a customer, is skills training done as shop routine, and the transistor left playing with its volume screwed right down under a ticket reading WORKS — TURN DOWN, NOT OFF, is the low-dose second line. The parade is a declared adjacency: the bowling alley two doors along is the schizophrenia chapter, several boxes on the table are lotted from the same house clearance as its raffle stock, and the spectrum relationship is drawn as which premises stand on the same street.
המקוםA second-hand bric-a-brac shop on a small-town parade on Saturday, next door but one to the bowling alley: a long deal table of unsorted house-clearance boxes down the middle, rails of mismatched donated coats along one wall, and floor-to-ceiling shelves of crockery, lamps and paperbacks behind the counter. A child's play tipi is pitched in the toy corner at the back with a lamp burning inside it, and above the window display six old framed prints hang in a lettered row with a faceless dress form standing under them.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is rummaging — lifting things out of the boxes on the long table, turning them over for a price, trying the switch or winding the key to see whether it goes, and putting them back.
מבנה מרכזיThe long deal table of unsorted clearance boxes, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right, dividing the shop into the window display and framed row, the rummaging aisle, the counter and shelves, and the toy corner with the tipi.

94. BORDER POSTתמונה מילולית

פרקBorderline Personality Disorder
משחק המילים'Border' is the term's own plain-English picture and a border post is a real place that can carry that one morpheme on ordinary signage without printing the diagnosis. The crossing's native furniture then does the clinical work for nothing: the twin channels signed NOTHING TO DECLARE and GOODS TO DECLARE are idealization and devaluation reduced to a lane choice, the lane-status gantry reading 5 OF 9 LANES OPEN puts the diagnostic threshold on a sign whose real job is numbers, and ABANDONED VEHICLES WILL BE REMOVED is a genuine road sign that happens to state the core fear.
המקוםA small road border crossing at midday: two lanes under a canopy, a passport booth, a red-and-white boom barrier, a duty-free kiosk and a currency window off to one side
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is being processed through the crossing — queueing, handing over documents, opening bags on the inspection bench
מבנה מרכזיThe painted white borderline running corner to corner across the tarmac with the red-and-white boom barrier lying along it, splitting the frame into two countries

95. LINEHAN & DAUGHTERS ROAD MARKINGתמונה מילולית

פרקBPD treatment: DBT
משחק המיליםThe fascia names the theorist exactly as an ordinary family contractor is named, in the corpus's own BOWLBY & SONS / MINUCHIN & SONS register with no clinical word painted anywhere, and the trade it names is the one trade on earth whose finished product is a border line laid down at full size — so the chapter's disorder is hosted rather than pointed at, while the yard pays the therapy out of its own statutory furniture: the printed order-of-markings chart that ranks stop line, then hazard line, then lane line is the target hierarchy already numbered on a real board, the day's lining sheet ruled into columns and filled in as they go is the diary card, the gang's briefing round the job board is the consultation team, the radio clipped in the lining cab is between-session coaching in a crisis, four stencil sets in numbered trays are the four skills modules, and the weather card that forbids laying below 5°C or on a wet surface is the acceptance half of the dialectic stated as a condition of work rather than as a slogan.
המקוםA road-marking contractor's yard at half past seven on a working morning, the gates standing open onto the road. A towed thermoplastic boiler, a ride-on lining machine and a bead applicator are coupled nose to tail across the concrete; the drum store and stencil rack fill one side, and the mess hut with the job board stands by the gate. At the back a practice slab carries full-size sample lines laid in white, yellow and red.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is laying a line: stirring the boiler, snapping a chalk line and setting the road pins, walking the machine down the guide, dropping beads onto the wet material, kneeling to a stencil, then coning the work off until it sets.
מבנה מרכזיThe lining train — the towed thermoplastic boiler, the ride-on lining machine and the bead applicator coupled nose to tail — running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the yard into the drum store, the machine run, the practice slab with its sample lines, and the mess hut and job board at the gate.

96. ALBION SCRAP & PLANT DISPOSALראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקAntisocial PD + Conduct Disorder
משחק המיליםA-S-P-D falls out of Albion Scrap & Plant Disposal as an ordered subsequence of word-initials on a fascia you could photograph on any industrial estate, the expreSS tRIps device with nothing clinical lettered — and the trade is chosen not for menace but because it is the one ordinary business whose statutory paperwork is identity and deceit: a scrap dealer must record the seller's photographic licence for every load, may not pay in cash, and must print GROSS, TARE and NET on a ticket that either does or does not match what came off the lorry, so the criteria are carried by counter business rather than by anybody's expression; the licence conditions supply clause 15 headed CONDUCT ON SITE for the before-15 onset, the baler's age plate supplies the 18 that is the floor for the diagnosis itself, and the office calendar with its dates ringed back to a first entry made at fourteen supplies the rest of the history as ordinary wall furniture.
המקוםA scrap metal merchant's weighbridge on a Saturday morning, cars and tippers queued out to the road. The long steel deck is set into the concrete with its dial post at one end and the office window facing it across the tarmac, the baler and the hydraulic shear standing beyond; graded bays run down the far fence with their grade boards chalked up. The price board by the gate is in pounds per tonne and has already been rubbed out and rewritten twice this morning.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is weighing in a load: pulling onto the deck, taking the printed ticket to the office window, handing a licence through to be copied into the register, tipping into the graded bay, then driving back over the empty deck to be weighed out.
מבנה מרכזיThe weighbridge deck — the long steel plate set into the concrete with its dial post at one end and the baler standing square beyond it — running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the yard into the gate queue, the deck itself, the office window, and the graded bays along the back fence.

97. HISTORIC HOUSE TOURSמשחק צליל

פרקHistrionic Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםHistrionic -> HISTORIC: a near-homophone, only the 'ri' differs, and the sign carries no diagnosis word. The pun is cashed a second time by the venue's own staff, because the Latin root histrio means 'actor' and a heritage house employs people who perform in costume for an audience all day, on the hour, whether or not anyone is watching.
המקוםA National-Trust-style historic house on a public open day — stone entrance hall with a ticket desk, a roped-off parlour, costumed docents, a coach party queueing on the gravel drive outside the porch.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is on the guided tour — docents performing their period patter from the stairs, visitors shuffling behind the velvet rope with audio-guide handsets pressed to their ears.
מבנה מרכזיThe grand staircase and its carved banister, sweeping from the lower-left of the hall up to the landing at upper right, splitting the frame into gravel drive / ticket hall / roped parlour / upstairs landing.

98. SPRING NARCISSUS SHOWמשחק צליל

פרקNarcissistic Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםNarcissistic -> Narcissus, the botanical genus of the daffodil, named for the youth who could not stop looking at his own reflection. 'Narcissus' is a single morpheme, never the diagnosis, and it is the ordinary class name a real flower show would letter on its banner. The reflection comes free from the water in the show bottles and the mirror-backed cabinet at the end of the bench.
המקוםA county horticultural show in a white canvas marquee on a village playing field — trestle tables of cut daffodils standing in numbered green show bottles, judges with clipboards, prize cards propped against the vases.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is showing and judging flowers — staging blooms, measuring stems, leaning in to compare one bloom against the next and pin cards on the winners.
מבנה מרכזיThe long trestle staging run of numbered show benches, crossing from lower-left to upper-right beneath the marquee's guyed ridge pole, splitting the frame into entrance flap / staging benches / judges' table / prize wall.

99. AVOID ANTS PEST CO.משחק צליל

פרקAvoidant Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםAvoidANT breaks exactly on the pest trade's own product, so AVOID ANTS PEST CO. is a firm name that could be signwritten on any real van and prints nothing clinical; siting it at the depot rather than on the customer's doorstep is what makes it usable, because a depot supplies fifteen people all doing one ordinary job and an inventory that belongs to the firm, and the criteria then hang on counter furniture - the round card nobody will lift, the door card saying the crew will not knock, the standing list of empty properties only, and a key safe of houses entered when no one is home - which is a trade that wants the work and will not risk the doorstep, not one with no interest in it.
המקוםA pest-control firm's depot yard at seven in the morning: eight liveried vans backed up to the loading bay, steel racking of bait boxes, glue boards and lidded sacks behind the dock lip, the mixing shed's roller door up at the end of the range, and a fibreglass ant bolted to the roof of the end van. The round board and the key safe hang by the office window, and the yard gate stands open onto the road.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is loading out for the day's round - lifting a job card off the round board, carrying bait boxes down the racking, filling and sealing a sprayer at the mixing shed, signing the poisons book at the hatch, and stacking the lot into a van.
מבנה מרכזיThe raised loading dock with the steel racking range standing behind it, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the yard into the van line, the dock lip, the racking and the mixing shed at the end.

100. THE PENDANT SHOPמשחק צליל

פרקDependent Personality Disorder
משחק המיליםDePENDANT -> 'pendant', which in the lighting trade is the exact word for a lamp that hangs from a fixed point and cannot stand up by itself: unhook it and it is on the floor and dark. The venue then pays a second time from stock, because the showroom's normal business is a customer who cannot choose between two identical shades and a fitter who will do it for you free.
המקוםA high-street lighting showroom — a steel ceiling grid hung solid with pendant lamps on flexes of every length, fitters up stepladders hooking new ones onto ceiling roses, customers at the counter with shade swatches.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is hanging or being shown hanging lamps; nothing in the shop stands on its own, every fixture in the frame is suspended from something above it.
מבנה מרכזיThe steel ceiling track grid running from the upper left down to mid-right, dense with flexes and pendants, splitting the frame into shopfront window / display floor / counter / fitting bay.

101. O. C. PENFOLD & DAUGHTERSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקObsessive-Compulsive Personality Disorder (OCPD)
משחק המיליםO-C-P-D reads straight off an utterly ordinary family shopfront as an ordered subsequence of its four initials — O., C., Penfold, Daughters — with no clinical morpheme painted anywhere, and the trade underneath it is the one high-street business whose entire daily method is the disorder rendered as competent professional practice: stock filed in catalogue-number order, perforations counted on a printed gauge rather than judged by eye, MOUNTS ONLY — NO HINGES as a house rule, NO OFFERS — CATALOGUE PRICE as the pricing policy, a framed dealers' code of practice with numbered clauses requiring that a repaired stamp be declared, a FAULTS box of worthless damaged material that is never emptied, a tin marked NOT TO BE BROKEN INTO on the back shelf, and a proprietor who re-checks a lot for the fourth time while the queue holds its want-lists — so every criterion is carried by shop stock rather than by invention, and the one bar burning on a two-bar fire says miserliness without a word.
המקוםA stamp dealer's shop on a small parade, half past two on a Thursday, STAMPS & POSTAL HISTORY lettered on the glass. A long baize-topped sorting bench runs down the middle with open stock-books laid end to end along it, a wall of shallow numbered drawers stands behind the counter, and the catalogue lies open on a lectern at the till. One bar of the two-bar fire is on and the shop is otherwise unheated.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is checking stamps: lifting one out of a stock-book with tweezers, laying it on a perforation gauge, holding it up against the shade card, ticking a want-list, and writing the catalogue number on a mount card.
מבנה מרכזיThe long baize-topped sorting bench, loaded end to end with open stock-books and the gauge rack standing on it, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and dividing the shop into the window display, the customers' side of the bench, the proprietor's counter with its catalogue lectern, and the wall of numbered drawers behind.

102. TARA'S SOFT SERVEמשחק צליל

פרקForensic psychiatry: competency, insanity, Tarasoff
משחק המיליםTarasoff -> TARA'S SOFT (serve). A food kiosk is the one ordinary place whose native furniture is warnings and thresholds, so the rest of the chapter rides on stock: the allergy placard is the duty to warn, 'we only call named orders' is the identifiable victim, the painted height gauge is a legal standard you must reach before you are served, and the 'ORDERS ON HOLD' rail under the heat lamp is the involuntary hold.
המקוםA roadside soft-serve kiosk beside a municipal car park on a hot afternoon — serving hatch under a painted awning, an order-ticket rail beneath the heat lamp, picnic tables bolted to the tarmac and a queue along the kerb.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is queueing, ordering by name at the hatch, and eating ice cream at the picnic tables.
מבנה מרכזיThe long service counter and its awning fascia running from lower-left to upper-right, menu board above it, splitting the frame into queue / counter / order-hold rail / picnic tables.

103. NOAR CLIMBING CLUBמשחק צליל

פרקIsraeli law in child and adolescent psychiatry
משחק המיליםNOAR, spelled the way a Hebrew reader reads נוער — the plural collective, not NA'AR — is at once the exact name of the law the chapter is built on and simply what a youth climbing club is called, so the fascia carries the statute without printing a legal or clinical term, and the venue then supplies the whole apparatus as ordinary club equipment: who may go up alone and who must be roped to an adult is a posted house rule keyed to age, whose signature stands on the waiver is a parent's line on a dated form, who is judged competent to hold another person's rope is a stamped card valid twelve months, who writes an incident into the ruled book is the duty instructor on the rota, and the committee sitting behind glass above the floor deciding whether a climb continues is the review body drawn as a real balcony room.
המקוםAn indoor climbing centre on a school-holiday morning: a bolted plywood wall of coloured holds rising three storeys with the overhang breaking forward at one end, ropes hanging from the ceiling anchors, and crash matting over the whole floor. A reception desk stands inside the door with the waiver folder open on it and a rack of numbered harnesses behind. A glazed meeting room on the balcony looks down the length of the wall.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is roping up and climbing: tying in at the mat edge, being checked by a partner before leaving the ground, working up a taped route, being lowered back down, and signing the sheet at the desk.
מבנה מרכזיThe leaning plywood wall — three storeys of bolted panels with the overhang breaking forward at one end — its arête running from the lower left of the frame up to the roof line at the upper right, splitting the hall into the reception desk, the mat floor, the wall itself, and the glazed committee room on the balcony above.

104. CENTRAL TRANSIT HALLמשחק צליל

פרקGender Dysphoria + LGBTQ+ affirming care
משחק המיליםTRANSIT -> transition; the concourse is the ordinary building whose entire business is changing from one line to another, and 'transit' is one morpheme, not the diagnosis. The venue then pays three more times from its own furniture, all of it neutral and respectful: a ticket validator is affirmation, the reissue window is a name change, a left-luggage tag that does not match its owner's ticket is incongruence, and the escalator marked temporarily paused and reversible is the blocker.
המקוםThe concourse of an ordinary city transit interchange in the middle of the day — a bank of ticket validators at the barriers, a flip departure board mid-change, a left-luggage counter, a reissue window, one escalator roped off with a cone in front of it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is changing lines — validating tickets at the machines, reading the board, wheeling bags between platforms.
מבנה מרכזיThe bank of ticket barriers and validator posts running from lower-left to upper-right across the concourse, the departure board hung above them, splitting the frame into street entrance / concourse / validators / platform ramp.

105. PARAPHERNALIA MARINE CHANDLERYמשחק צליל

פרקSexual Dysfunctions + Paraphilic Disorders
משחק המילים'PARAPHERNALIA' phonetically embeds 'paraphilia', while the tested mechanical gear across the counter encodes the diagnostic roster of sexual dysfunctions.
המקוםA dockside marine chandlery on a blustery weekday afternoon, smelling of Stockholm tar, brass polish, and damp canvas. Racks of galvanized shackles, rigging screws, and brass navigation fittings line the timber walls behind the serving counter. Through the harbour-facing display window, fishing smacks and motor launches ride at their pontoon moorings.
מה כולם עושיםsplicing three-strand hemp rope eyes around galvanized thimbles with a wooden fid
מבנה מרכזיThe heavy overhead timber spar and tackle hoist beam cutting diagonally across the shop ceiling from the brass fitting racks at upper left to the rope-coiling deck at lower right

106. ODDS LANE TIPראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקDisruptive/Impulse: ODD, IED, Kleptomania, Pyromania
משחק המיליםThe three letters of the acronym stand in order inside an ordinary street name — the expreSS tRIps device — and Odds Lane is already the street on which chapter 107's boxing gym stands, so the tip and the aggression chapter are neighbouring premises on one lane and the adjacency itself carries the relationship. A council tip is the one boring place that pays out on all four disorders as native site business rather than as invention. The permit queue is a running argument with an attendant who says no: arguing with authority, refusing to sort, deliberately annoying the next driver, blaming him for it, and coming back angrier — the criteria enacted rather than illustrated. A man hurling a television over the rail because his permit was refused is aggression grossly out of proportion to its trigger. Scavenging out of the skips is the taking of things of no value that the taker does not need and could have had for nothing from the re-use shed two steps away, which is precisely the line between kleptomania and ordinary stealing, and the site's own NO SCAVENGING board makes that line posted regulation. The wire cage of gas bottles and lithium batteries, a skip smouldering at one end and a man standing watching it with obvious pleasure while everyone else backs off, is the tip's real and well-known fire problem. The paperwork carries the durations for free — permit expiry dates, a visits-per-month notice, and the incident log on the cabin wall.
המקוםA council household-waste tip at the Saturday-morning rush: a raised steel skip deck behind a guard rail with a ramp of steps up to it, a queue of cars nose-to-tail down the lane, an attendant's cabin at the barrier with a permit window, a re-use shed of things too good to crush, and a wire cage for gas bottles and batteries at the far end.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is unloading a car boot into the skips — carrying an armful up the steps, tipping it over the rail, breaking a board across a knee to make it fit, walking back down the ramp for the next load.
מבנה מרכזיThe raised steel skip deck — a run of eight open skips on a concrete platform behind a guard rail, with its ramp of steps at one end — cutting the site from the lower left to the upper right and dividing it into the queue lane, the ramp, the skip row and the re-use shed.

107. A. G. GREASON MEMORIAL BOXING CLUBראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקAggression and violence in youth
משחק המיליםThe initials and name A. G. GREASON embed the letters of AGGRESSION, the core theme of conduct and violence in youth.
המקוםA municipal amateur boxing gym on an overcast weekday afternoon, smelling of floor wax, leather, and eucalyptus liniment. Along the whitewashed brick walls, rows of heavy punch bags hang beneath wire-caged lights, while sparring headgear sits neatly arranged in timber cubbies. A row of folding chairs for parents and trainers lines the perimeter under the high frosted windows.
מה כולם עושיםwinding cotton hand-wraps around knuckles and wrists at the bench
מבנה מרכזיThe raised sixteen-foot timber boxing ring and its four-strand perimeter ropes cutting diagonally across the gymnasium floor from the punch-bag wall at upper left to the weigh-in scales at lower right

108. MEANS THE CHEMISTמשחק צליל

פרקAdolescent suicidality
משחק המיליםThe chemist's is called Means, an ordinary surname over an ordinary door that is also the word in means restriction, and restricting access to means is literally the shop's whole day: two locks and two keyholders on the poisons cupboard, one pack per customer at the shelf edge, and a returns bin heaped over the rim with what people have carried back out of the house.
המקוםA high-street chemist's shop at the end of a wet Thursday afternoon: a long dispensing counter under a glass screen, a wall of small numbered drawers behind it, two aisles of shelving out front, a curtained consultation room at the side, a row of waiting chairs, and the roller rink's lit frontage across the road through the window.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is working through the same counter business — passing a prescription under the screen, counting tablets out on the triangle into short rows, initialling the ruled register, having a packet talked through at the end of the counter, tipping an old box into the returns bin by the door.
מבנה מרכזיThe screened dispensing counter with its wall of numbered drawers behind, running the full length of the shop from the lower right of the frame to the upper left and splitting it into shop floor, counter, dispensary and curtained consulting room.

109. JOHNSON'S ROLLER RINKראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSelf-injurious behavior (NSSI)
משחק המיליםN-S-S-I stands as an ordered subsequence inside an utterly ordinary rink name — JohNSon'S RInk — the expreSS tRIps device, over the one mundane trade whose floor is deliberately scored a hundred times an hour by people who are not trying to destroy it and buffed out again between sessions.
המקוםA municipal roller rink during the Saturday afternoon public session: a maple floor inside low blue barriers with the black wheel marks worked into it, a hire counter stacked with numbered boots at one end, a warm-up bench and a drinks hatch behind glass, the floor buffer parked in its bay with the gate hooked open, and the chemist's shop-front visible across the road through the foyer glass.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is skating the same anticlockwise circuit at their own speed — a beginner working the barrier hand over hand, two doing crossovers on the bend, one sitting on the bench loosening a boot, one at the hatch having a knee looked at.
מבנה מרכזיThe blue dasher barrier and the marked maple floor it encloses, its rail and gate cutting from the lower-left corner of the frame to the upper right and dividing the picture into hire counter, floor, warm-up bench and the buffer's bay.

110. FOSTER & SONS REMOVALSמשחק צליל

פרקFamily transitions: divorce, adoption, foster care
משחק המיליםFOSTER is a completely ordinary English family-firm surname and it is also the chapter's key word; '& SONS' is the adoption joke sitting where every removals firm already puts it. The trade word REMOVALS is the second pun and the load-bearing one - 'removal' is the actual child-welfare term for taking a child out of the home, and the firm's own stock offering of SHORT-TERM vs LONG-TERM STORAGE is exactly foster care vs adoption, printed in native business copy.
המקוםMoving day on an ordinary suburban street: a box-body removals van backed up to the kerb outside a semi-detached house, ramp down, front door propped open, a SOLD board on the lawn
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is carrying boxes and furniture out of the house and up the ramp into the van
