מבנה מרכזיThe aluminium loading ramp running from the pavement up into the open tail of the van, cutting the frame diagonally and separating kerb-side (the old household) from the dark van interior (transit)

111. MOSAIC TILE CO.משחק צליל

פרקCultural and religious issues in child mental health
משחק המיליםMOSAIC is the ordinary trade word painted over a real tile shop and at the same time the word for the law of Moses, so one six-letter fascia carries culture and religion at once without printing either.
המקוםA tile and stone showroom on a Sunday morning: hinged sample boards standing in ranks down the middle of the floor like the leaves of a book, pallets of boxed tiles along the walls under their stencilled pattern numbers, a wet cutting bench at the back with the hose coiled beneath it, and a trade counter carrying a carbon-copy order pad and a lectern with the pattern reference book open flat.
מה כולם עושיםEverybody is matching a piece — turning the hinged boards leaf by leaf, holding a chipped fragment brought in wrapped in newspaper up against the racks, wetting a sample under the tap to see its true colour, working down the same printed order form at the counter.
מבנה מרכזיThe double rank of hinged sample boards on their long steel frame, running from the lower right of the frame to the upper left and dividing the room into trade counter, sample aisle, pallet wall and wet cutting bench.

112. PERRY & NATAL SAIL LOFTמשחק צליל

פרקPerinatal psychiatry: postpartum depression + psychosis
משחק המילים"PERRY & NATAL" phonetically replicates "perinatal", the medical period spanning pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum year.
המקוםAn ordinary sailmaking loft on an overcast weekday afternoon. Wide bolts of white canvas lie spread across the wide timber floor under high north-facing skylights. Two sailmakers in canvas aprons work along the bench measuring and hand-stitching corner cringles with palm and needle.
מה כולם עושיםmeasuring and hand-stitching canvas sails
מבנה מרכזיThe continuous hardwood sailmaker's bench - a low timber stitching platform raised four inches above the floor - running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the loft, dividing the space into the raw canvas racks, the central stitching platform, the bench tool trough, and the sail-hoist staging floor.

113. MALONE'S FINE INFUSIONSמשחק צליל

פרקBrexanolone + Zuranolone (PPD-specific)
משחק המילים-olone is the syllable both drugs share, brexan-olone and zuran-olone, and MALONE is an ordinary family-firm surname that carries it; INFUSIONS is the tea trade's own word for what it sells and is simultaneously the chapter's defining fact, because the first of the two drugs is not a tablet at all but a sixty-hour intravenous infusion. Nothing clinical is printed on the board. A tasting room is built out of exactly the contrast this chapter is examined on: the great copper urn on a slow tap that must run for hours with somebody sitting beside it and may never be left unattended is the in-clinic monitored infusion, and the small carton of fourteen sachets on the counter marked one each evening is the oral fourteen-day course a mother takes home. The trade supplies the rest without inventing a thing — the rack of sand-timers is the dosing schedule, the taster asleep over his bowl with his mark half-written is the somnolence that dominates both labels, the cream jug and the buttered scone at the sachet end are the fatty-meal requirement, the hook board where drivers hang their keys under the clock is the twelve-hour driving warning, and the locked tin under the counter is the controlled-substance schedule. Because the room is the ground-floor unit of the Aa Hotel, the receptor both drugs modulate stands in the frame as the building itself, and the shop is two doors along the same universe as the GABA chapter's cobbler.
המקוםA tea merchant's tasting room on the ground floor of an old five-storey hotel, mid-morning: a long tasting bench down the room with a row of numbered brewing bowls and lidded pots, a rack of sand-timers above it, a spittoon at each place, chests and sample tins stacked along the wall, scales and a scoop at the packing end, and a great copper urn on a slow tap in the corner with a chair drawn up beside it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is brewing and tasting timed infusions — spooning leaf into a bowl, pouring the water on, turning a timer over, lifting the lid when it runs out, drawing the liquor up and spitting it into the spittoon, writing the mark on the sheet.
מבנה מרכזיThe long tasting bench — a scrubbed timber run carrying the row of numbered bowls, lidded pots and turned timers — crossing the room from the lower left to the upper right and dividing it into the packing end, the tasting line, the urn corner and the hotel stairwell doorway behind.

114. LIRA & SONSתמונה מילולית

פרקGeriatric overview (delirium focus — light touch)
משחק המיליםDelirium is de + lira, Latin for off the furrow, so the plate is built as the term's literal picture and the fascia carries only the host farm's ordinary family name, LIRA & SONS, while the missing morpheme is hand-lettered on the white deviation pegs stencilled DE and on the DEVIATION column of the judges' score sheets - leaving the resident to assemble the word from a place whose entire business is holding attention on one line for an hour and whose product is a permanent record in the soil of exactly when a man was on it and when he was not.
המקוםA village ploughing match on an autumn afternoon with the sun already low across the field: a stubble field pegged out into numbered plots, the host farm's gate board at the road end, a line of old tractors working up and down their own plots, a judges' table under an open awning at the headland, and a tea urn on a trailer tailgate.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is ploughing a plot and being judged on it - setting the opening split, walking back down the furrow to sight along the line, driving up and down at the same slow speed, and standing at the headland to look at what they have drawn.
מבנה מרכזיThe block of turned ground - the ribbed mass of new furrows filling the middle of the field, its opening split down the centre and the unploughed stubble lying alongside - running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and dividing the field into the stubble still to be worked, the ploughed land, the headland where the tractors turn, and the judges' awning at the top.

115. NEW ROW SHOE FITTERSמשחק צליל

פרקNeuroanatomy + neurological examination of child
משחק המיליםNEW ROW is a street name on half the high streets in England and it says NEURO out loud with no clinical word anywhere on the fascia; the shop is a children's fitters because a shoe fitting is a paediatric neurological examination that this trade already performs on every customer, in a fixed order, as routine. The child is stood on the numbered gauge and measured, sent up and back along the taped line while the fitter watches the heel strike from behind and the mother watches from the front, then sat down and handled: thumb pressed over the toe, heel held and worked side to side to feel how freely the ankle gives, foot flexed against a hand, stand on your toes for me. Gait, range, tone and power are the shop's own four checks and they are done in the shop's own sequence. The method changes with age exactly as the examination does — the schoolgirl reads her own size off the gauge, the toddler is walked between two adults and watched, and the baby who cannot stand is measured lying on the bench with the sole stroked by the cold metal slider so the toes fan, held upright until the feet touch and step, and left holding the display rail in a whole-fist grip. The record card drawer carries every visit a child has made since her first pair, dated with an age against a size, so the milestone ladder is the shop's own filing and the red recall tabs standing proud of it are the red flags. Asymmetry is this trade's daily finding and needs no invention: the returned pair with one toe scuffed through and its partner barely marked, and the customer who takes two different sizes.
המקוםA children's shoe shop on a school-holiday morning: a long padded fitting bench with a mirrored strip along the floor at its foot, a wall of boxes with the size chalked on every end, and a taped line down the middle of the floor for walking up and back. A cash kiosk stands raised a step at the front by the window, and the stockroom dumbwaiter comes down at the foot of the back stairs with its gear box open to the room.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is being fitted for shoes — standing on the numbered gauge to be measured, walking the length of the shop and back while somebody watches from behind, then sitting to have a thumb pressed over the toe.
מבנה מרכזיThe long padded fitting bench, with the mirrored floor strip at its foot and the wall of size-chalked boxes rising behind it, running from the lower-left corner of the shop up to the stockroom stairs at the upper right.

116. SEIZED LOTS AUCTIONמשחק צליל

פרקSeizures + Epilepsy
משחק המיליםGoods are SEIZED, and a seizure sale is a real, dull, municipal event with a sign already painted for it. The room's own mechanics then carry the taxonomy for free: one paddle going up alone is a focal seizure, the whole room's paddles going up at once is generalised, one paddle followed by its entire row is secondary generalisation, a bidder who freezes mid-bid and lets the lot pass is an absence, the hammer is the ictus, and the slumped bidder after it is post-ictal. The auctioneer's 'going once' is the aura.
המקוםA weekday auction of impounded goods in a draughty municipal hall: trestle tables of numbered lots, folding chairs in rows, a raised rostrum at the front, a cash desk at the back
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is bidding - watching the rostrum and putting paddles up
מבנה מרכזיThe long run of trestle tables loaded with numbered lots, crossing the hall diagonally and leading up to the raised auctioneer's rostrum, with the chalk price board behind it

117. EXTRA DURABLE CASESמשחק צליל

פרקHead trauma + TBI sequelae
משחק המיליםEXTRA DURABLE is what every luggage shop has had painted across its window since luggage was invented, and it says EXTRADURAL without a clinical word on the glass — dura is a hard-wearing-covering word first and an anatomical one second, which is why the covering was named after it. The trade then supplies the whole chapter out of stock. A hard case is a rigid opaque shell whose contents shift and cannot be seen, so a knock on one corner opening the shell at the corner diagonally opposite is the counter's most ordinary complaint and the mechanism is printed on the sign as the shop's two most ordinary words. The lining is the load-bearing detail and it is real construction: a lining is stitched down along the seams, so anything collecting between shell and lining swells into a tight lens that stops dead at the stitch lines, while anything getting in under the loose lining spreads on round the corner as a long thin crescent and crosses every seam — two shapes, both drawn on the shop's own goods, neither of them a diagram. The docket does the scale: three scored columns, does the lid open, is it still labelled with whose it is, will it still move, totted into a box that runs from three to fifteen. The case that was checked, passed and set on the shelf an hour ago and has quietly split its seam since is the interval that costs people their lives; the two chrome studs beside the handle with one pushed proud and stuck is the pupil; and the dark stain creeping under the lining behind the top handle is the bruise that appears round the back. Labels carry the amnesia with nothing added — the spike of torn-off address labels beside the lost-property book, and the case whose newest labels are gone while the old faded ones underneath are perfectly legible. The hire fleet in the corner, every handle tag tallied with the trips it has done and every one scuffed away at the same corner, is repeated impact kept where a shop really keeps it, and the notice at the till about a settling-in period after a repair is the complaint the shop cannot find anything wrong with.
המקוםThe repair-and-hire counter of a luggage shop on a Monday morning: hard shells racked open like clamshells behind the counter, a check-in scale set into the counter top, and a low drop step at the near end where a case is set down corner-first to see what it does. Dockets go on a spike beside the till, and the claims office is glazed onto the street at the front of the shop.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is checking a case over the counter — running a hand round the shell, unclipping the lid, feeling under the lining, and filling in the docket.
מבנה מרכזיThe long inspection counter with the check-in scale set into its far end, running from the lower-left corner of the shop up to the tiered rack of open shells at the upper right.

118. MANNING'S HINGESמשחק צליל

פרקCNS infections with psychiatric sequelae
משחק המילים"MANNING'S HINGES" phonetically replicates "meninges", the three protective membranes (dura mater, arachnoid mater, and pia mater) surrounding the central nervous system.
המקוםAn ordinary architectural ironmongery warehouse on a cloudy morning. Rows of brass, iron, and bronze hinges are mounted on heavy sample boards beneath industrial high-bay lamps. Two warehouse clerks in grey dust coats sort heavy gate hinges from timber crates into numbered steel bins.
מה כולם עושיםsorting and stocking architectural brass hinges
מבנה מרכזיThe three-tier steel and timber hinge display wall - three stepped vertical layers of heavy iron plate, woven brass mesh, and thin pine veneer running from floor to ceiling - cutting the frame diagonally from the lower left to the upper right and dividing the room into the loading threshold, the customer inspection aisle, the sub-mesh drainage trough, and the rear stock bins.

119. HUNT & SON EXTENSIONSמשחק צליל

פרקMovement disorders: Huntington, Wilson
משחק המיליםHUNT is an ordinary surname over an ordinary family firm, and & SON is the firm handing itself down — the three framed photographs above the till show each generation taking the bench over younger than the last, which is anticipation drawn as a shop's own history wall rather than a pedigree chart. EXTENSIONS is the load-bearing word and here it is literally copper: this trade sells length, cut off a numbered drum, and length is the only thing the trade argues about, because the longer the run the worse it performs and the sooner it fails. The rack chart on the wall has a red line ruled across it at forty, above which nothing leaves the bench without a warning ticket, so the threshold everyone must remember is the shop's own house rule. The worn drum whose hub has gone to a square hole, so the wind sits loose round an empty middle, is the caudate gone and the ventricle squared off, drawn on a real thing that really wears that way. Leads that will not lie still are the workshop's daily nuisance — coils sprung off their hooks and writhing across the floor, a lead pulled restlessly through the hands at the bench — and the two men holding a long one out at arm's length between them to check it for nicks cannot keep it from flapping. The second disease is the same stock read the other way: copper is what this whole trade is made of, it collects first at the meter cupboard by the door where everything comes in and only later shows at the far end of the run, every brass ferrule on the rack has gone brown-green in a ring right round its rim, and the two things the bench reaches for are the strippers that take the copper out and the tub of zinc-plated ferrules that stop it getting back in.
המקוםA back-street workshop that makes up extension leads, on an ordinary Tuesday: a cable drum on a stand paying off across a long bench, a wall of finished coils on hooks with their length tags tied on, and a scrap bin of bright copper offcuts filled to the brim underneath. The meter cupboard by the door stands open, and the till at the far end has three framed photographs above it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is making up a lead — pulling off the drum to length, stripping the ends, screwing them into the plug, and hanging the coil on its hook with the length written on the tag.
מבנה מרכזיThe cable drum on its stand with the lead paying off across the whole length of the bench, running from the lower-left corner of the workshop up to the door at the upper right.

120. SWELL BAY CANNING CO.מבנה מרחבי

פרקBrain tumors + pseudotumor
משחק המיליםA can is a skull: rigid, sealed, opaque, and the only thing that shows from outside is the round stamped end, which loses its concentric rings and its sharp outer rim as the pressure inside rises — so the swollen disc is drawn on the venue's core prop and is felt by hand by every worker on the bench. Swell is the canner's own trade word for a bulged can and the plain word for a mass, and SWELL BAY reads as an ordinary coastal cannery. The grading bench pays out the chapter without invention: cans are graded by where they bulge and by what they sound like when tapped, so location is the whole diagnosis, and the marked bins run FLAT, FLIPPER, SPRINGER, HARD SWELL, which is a real four-step ladder of rising pressure that this trade counts up every day. The one that bulges hard but rattles empty when it is shaken, and reads light on the scale beside a heavy one — same shell, same gauge, nothing inside — goes into a bin of its own, and that contrast is the chapter's whole second half. Position is stock too: a bulge under the base seam at the very edge, a limescale lump crusted in the neck of the steam pipe directly above the little control box in its wall niche, a blocked drain channel lining the floor, the tray of the smallest newest cans at the low back end of the bench, and a pallet of bought-in cans from three other plants with several already swelled, sitting at the boundary where the roller track meets the bench. The plant's own gas line is the tap the foreman turns down when too many are swelling, the vent needle pushed through a lid to let one down slowly is the relief, and the pair of round sight glasses on the front of each retort, one of which has crept inward and no longer looks straight out, is the eye that turns in when the pressure has been up for weeks.
המקוםA small seaside canning works at the end of the day shift: two upright retorts standing open against the wall with their round pressure gauges and a paper chart recorder between them, a long grading bench fed by a roller track and heaped with cooled cans, and pallets stacked by the loading door. A steam pipe runs along the wall above a little control box set in its own niche, and a drain channel runs the length of the floor.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is grading the day's cans — taking one off the bench, pressing both ends with the thumbs, tapping it with the little steel rod, listening, and putting it into one of the marked bins.
מבנה מרכזיThe long grading bench with its roller track from the retorts, running from the lower-left corner of the floor up to the loading door at the upper right.

121. C. PAWSEY & SON BOAT REPAIRSמשחק צליל

פרקCerebral palsy
משחק המיליםPawsey is a real surname over a real family yard and it says palsy; the initial in front of it is the one every such board carries, and the two together read without a clinical word being painted anywhere. The trade was chosen because its central operation is this chapter's whole management in one piece of everyday work: a plank is heated until it yields, bent round the frames, cramped home and left clamped until it cools, and it holds that shape for the life of the boat — while the one unclamped too early springs straight back. Stretching, serial casting and bracing are one job here and nobody calls them anything. The chapter's hardest point is the yard's own standing fact, said in the yard's own words: the line was laid off wrong on the loft floor once, before a single timber was cut, and every frame taken from it carries it; the fault happened at the start, it is finished, it never gets worse — and yet every season the hull is asked to carry more, so the same old set costs more and more shores go on. The five ways a hull is carried through the winter here are the mobility grades as ordinary yard practice, and they describe support and not worth: afloat on her own, afloat with a fender, held on a trot line, up in a cradle, up in a full frame of shores, with the yard board saying which hull is in which because it decides who lifts what tomorrow. Three planks at the bench are the three pictures side by side and they are timber, not people — one so stiff it will not take the bend and has snapped, one so soft it takes any shape and holds none, one that came out of the box with a wave in it and will not lie true. The shores are counted rather than lettered: two under one side, four under a whole hull, one corner packed up on wedges. The halyard of signal flags with its code card is a boat saying exactly what it needs across water it cannot shout over; the generator that trips so the lights go for ten seconds and come back is the yard's own interruption; and the damp streak chalked round in the planking either side of the keelson is what the yard finds in every hull that went in the water before her time.
המקוםA wooden boat repair yard at the top of the tide: one hull up on the slipway in her cradle with timber shores down both sides, a steam box at the shed door with a sand timer hanging beside it, and a run of numbered sash cramps along the wall. The mould loft floor at the back still carries the chalked full-size lines that every frame in the yard was taken off.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is fitting a timber — taking a plank out of the steam box, bending it round the frames, cramping it home, and leaving it clamped to cool.
מבנה מרכזיThe hull up on the slipway in her cradle, propped along both sides by a row of timber shores, running from the lower-left corner of the yard up to the shed doors at the upper right.

122. WILL, ANGEL & PRADER IMPRINTERSמשחק צליל

פרקNeurogenetic syndromes: Williams, Prader-Willi, Angelman, 22q11
משחק המילים"WILL, ANGEL & PRADER" phonetically encodes Williams, Angelman, and Prader-Willi syndromes, while "IMPRINTERS" captures genomic imprinting, the chromosome 15 epigenetic mechanism shared by the latter two.
המקוםAn ordinary commercial die-stamping and relief printing workshop on a busy weekday morning. Thick steel dies and brass embossing plates are arranged on heavy wooden workbenches under overhead shaded lamps. Two press operators in canvas smocks ink engraved metal blocks and guide sheets of heavy rag paper into the press bed.
מה כולם עושיםinking and pressing embossed metal dies onto heavy paper
מבנה מרכזיThe heavy cast-iron screw press bed - a massive four-poster iron stamping bed with a central overhead fly-wheel and twin lead-screw columns - running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the shop floor, dividing the space into the raw sheet-metal racks, the press apron, the ink mixing bench, and the proof hanging lines.

123. ASH LEIGH BATHSמשחק צליל

פרקNeurocutaneous: Tuberous Sclerosis, Neurofibromatosis
משחק המיליםAsh Leigh is an ordinary English place name over an ordinary municipal bathhouse and it says ash leaf — the pale leaf-shaped patch that is the earliest thing on the skin in this chapter and the one you need a lamp in a dim room to find. A Turkish baths is the one mundane venue in which every square inch of skin on eighteen people is wet, lit and being gone over by hand, so a nerve-and-skin chapter needs nothing invented. The rough mitt in every attendant's hand is shagreen, which is a leather word before it is a dermatological one and is exactly what the patch is named for. The pale patches show under the blue glow of the insect lamp by the door, in the one room that is already dim. The freckles nobody normally sees are in the armpits, and an armpit is the only thing on show when you lie face down on the slab. The tea tray through the arch carries milky coffee glasses, six of them set out at once on the one tray, which is the counting threshold without a number being written. The knobbly grey pumice stones stacked at every basin are the potato-like lumps the first disease is named for, and the string of small brown beads looped over a tap sits at eye height. The numbered alcove plates carry the chromosomes for free: alcove 17 is where the six glasses go, and alcove 22 is where a bather has clamped a copper bowl over each ear against the noise of the dome. The whole building runs off one regulator wheel on the boiler-house door, and turning that wheel down is the treatment the growths answer to. The mirror by the cooling-room arch has been wiped clear in the middle only, the edges left steamed opaque, which is what the anticonvulsant does to the fields.
המקוםA municipal Turkish baths on a slow weekday afternoon: a domed marble hall with a heated slab down the middle, scrubbing alcoves with brass taps and copper bowls ranged round the walls under numbered arch plates, wooden clogs in pairs on the rack by the door, and a cooling room with tea glasses through the arch.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is being scrubbed down — lying face down on the hot slab waiting a turn, sluicing water from a copper bowl over the shoulders in an alcove, being gone over arm by arm with a rough mitt, and going through to the cool room for tea.
מבנה מרכזיThe heated marble slab — the long raised platform running down the middle of the domed hall with the numbered alcove arches ranged behind it — cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing it into the clog rack and doorway, the wet floor, the slab itself, and the arch through to the cooling room.

124. MY GRAIN & FEEDמשחק צליל

פרקHeadache + Migraine
משחק המילים"MY GRAIN" spoken aloud is *migraine*, inside a name that reads exactly like a real farm-supply business. Everything the chapter needs is native stock: blazing sodium work-lamps (photophobia), a klaxon (phonophobia) under a placard "LIGHTS FLASH BEFORE HORN" (aura precedes pain by 20–60 min), a loading-dock sign "ONE SIDE ONLY" (unilateral), a pallet-strapping machine cinching a steel band tight (tension-type: bilateral, band-like), and — free from the venue's own vocabulary — the linked bins ARE a cluster, so cluster headache gets its oxygen cylinder and its ringed-week calendar in the same corner. The red mast pennant lettered "WORST EVER" is the thunderclap red flag; the haulage trailer's route board "TRIPTON — 1B/1D" is the triptans at 5-HT1B/1D.
המקוםA country grain elevator and feed mill at the edge of town, mid-morning: trucks queued at the weighbridge, a cluster of linked steel bins, grain dust hanging in the light.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the morning intake shift — tipping, weighing, augering and sacking grain.
מבנה מרכזיThe inclined auger conveyor running lower-left to upper-right from the intake pit up to the silo head, with the bin cluster ranged behind it.

125. CUSHION & FLOCKמשחק צליל

פרקMetabolic disorders with psychiatric presentation
משחק המיליםCUSHION and Cushing are a near-homophone and Cushion & Flock is a perfectly ordinary name for an upholstery firm, so the flagship of the chapter is on the fascia and the diagnosis is nowhere. This is a furniture trade, not a garment trade — chair frames, webbing, tacks and horsehair, with no fitting mirror and no claim tickets — and it supplies every mimic on the list as an ordinary piece of work rather than as a metaphor, which is what a chapter of six endocrine impostors needs. Cushing's is the over-stuffed piece on the middle trestle: a fat pad packed into the small of the back while the legs stay spindly, a hump of flock built up at the top of the shoulder, and split side seams showing the purple lining through — striae, central padding and wasted limbs all on one object. Porphyria is the bolt of purple cloth standing against the wall, porphyrin being the purple pigment the disease is named for. Addison's is the leather wing chair gone bronze in the sun and darkest in every crease and fold, with pale worn patches beside it. Thyroid disease is one matched pair of otherwise identical chairs at the end of the bench: one strung so tight the springs hum and two back buttons have popped out proud, one so slack and so thickly padded that it has swollen shut and sits cold — over-drive against under-drive on a pair, which is how the pair is examined. B12 is an ordinary painted bin label on the numbered racking above a bin of pale worn velvet. Everything a metabolic chapter needs is stuffing, tension or dye, and this is the shop where all three are the day's work.
המקוםAn upholstery workshop on a working weekday: a long run of trestles down the middle carrying stripped chair frames in every state of undress, bolts of cloth standing on end along one wall, a webbing stretcher and a tack hammer at every place, a wall of shallow numbered drawers of buttons and studs at the back, and a horsehair and flock bin under the window.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is stripping and re-covering a chair — pulling old tacks out with a ripping chisel, stretching webbing across a bare frame, building the stuffing up by the handful, tacking the calico down and tapping in the last of the studs.
מבנה מרכזיThe long run of trestles down the middle of the shop, chair frames standing on them in every state of undress and the bolts of cloth leaning along the wall behind, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and dividing it into the delivery corner, the working floor, the trestle run, and the button-and-stud drawers at the back.

126. PAVILION DANCE ROOMSראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקAutoimmune: NMDA-receptor encephalitis, lupus, PANDAS
משחק המיליםP-A-N-D-A-S stands as an ordered subsequence through PAvilioN DAnce roomS, which is an utterly ordinary name for a town dance hall, so the acronym rides the fascia and no diagnosis is printed — and the venue is at the same time the plain-English picture inside the older name for the same post-streptococcal illness, St Vitus' dance. The hall's own furniture carries the rest. The queue stands out on a cold pavement with scarves wound round their throats and the cloakroom counter keeps a tin of throat lozenges beside the numbered tickets, which is the sore throat that starts it; the junior medal class breaking up in the small room off the landing has one child counting the turns aloud in threes and touching the barre before each one, which is the abrupt-onset obsessive business the chapter turns on. The receptor chapter needs a door with a policy and a hall has one: nobody gets in unless a member signs them into the book, so two things are required at once before the door opens. The autoimmune half is the same door working against its own: the committee turning away members whose cards are in order. Lupus is on the props rather than in the name — the card wired to the bandstand rail reading NO WOLF WHISTLING plants the Latin, the stack of round beer mats with raised rims on the bar shelf is discoid without a metaphor, the powder-room mirror has rouge worked across both cheeks and over the bridge of the nose, and the member who has moved her chair out of the spotlight and under the balcony is photosensitivity. The lost-property box behind the cloakroom counter holds hair combs and a set of dentures — teeth and hair in one container, which is the growth that has to be hunted for the moment the trouble starts in the head — and the standing instruction chalked over the counter is to look in the box before anything else. The running order on the easel, dances numbered in fixed sequence, is the stereotyped march from odd behaviour to fits to the still, hot end of it.
המקוםA town dance hall on a Saturday night: a sprung maple floor with tables round three sides, a horseshoe balcony over them, a bandstand at the far end with the running order propped on an easel beside it, a ticket kiosk and cloakroom counter in the entrance, and the heavy iron side door onto the alley with its neon sign above.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is dancing the dance that has just been called — the same steps taken badly and well all over the floor, with the queue on the pavement outside shuffling up to the door to get in for the next one.
מבנה מרכזיThe horseshoe balcony front — a long panelled parapet with a brass rail and the hall's lettered valance hung along it — running from the lower left of the frame up to the top right corner and dividing the picture into the entrance stair and pavement queue, the tables round the floor, the sprung floor itself, and the bandstand under the far end.

127. F. X. TASKER & SON CABLESראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקNeurodegenerative basics (FXTAS, HD pediatric, etc.)
משחק המיליםF. X. TAS reads straight off an ordinary family firm's initials and surname, which is the expreSS tRIps device on the most anonymous fascia in the trade directory, and the & SON painted on the same board is paternal transmission before a single prop has been drawn. The cable trade then supplies the chapter without inventing anything. A white sheath over a copper core is myelin with no metaphor, so the bin of old flex whose insulation has gone to powder with the bare conductor showing through is a leukodystrophy, and the shelf of it that has crumbled to nothing but fragments is the end state. Repeat counts get carriers whose real job is to bear digits: every drum cheek is stencilled with a length and a batch, and every drum label gives cores, gauge and twists per metre, so the short runs go out, the drums in the fifty-five-to-two-hundred band stand held back on pre-order, and the one over-long drum is banded shut and never opened. The test book on the bench is anticipation as ordinary paperwork — the same flex, batch after batch, year against year, each one failing at a lower reading and after fewer hours, with the last entries in the son's handwriting. The workup is the shop's own routine: a megger reading taken across the insulation, then the fault locator run down the length to say how far in the break sits. Copper is the accumulation, and it accumulates where it should not — a green ring standing right round the rim of a stripped conductor, the scrap bin heaped with it, the stripping machine that pulls the copper out of old cable, and the zinc pot beside it for what comes after. The bobbin at the head of the cradle whose cage judders so the lay comes off uneven is the tremor in a carrier who was only ever supposed to pass it on, and the top row of drum tickets on the gantry racking has not been touched all week because nobody looks up.
המקוםA cable and flex works on an ordinary shift: a stranding cradle of rotating bobbins at the top of the shop feeding the laying-up head, the extruder laying white insulation on the cores as they run away down the floor to a take-up drum, a copper-rod store and a wire-drawing bench down one side, a test bay with a megger and a fault-locator trolley at the back, and the loading door open onto the yard.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is making up cable — feeding copper wire onto the stranding cradle, watching the lay come off the head, minding the extruder as the white sheathing goes on, winding off onto numbered drums, and chalking the length on the drum cheek before it is rolled away.
מבנה מרכזיThe stranding machine and its run-out — the long cradle of rotating bobbins feeding the laying-up head, with the finished cable running away down the length of the shop to the take-up drum — crossing the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing it into the copper store, the machine floor, the run-out, and the test bay behind.

128. SPINDLE COURT FLATSמשחק צליל

פרקSleep medicine intensive
משחק המילים"SPINDLE COURT FLATS" encodes sleep architecture through sleep spindles, the hallmark EEG waveform of Stage N2 sleep.
המקוםAn ordinary four-storey deck-access council estate on an overcast Tuesday morning. Concrete walkways with painted wooden spindle balustrades run along the front of each tier under open skies. Two caretakers in high-visibility vests wash the concrete landings with stiff brooms and buckets.
מה כולם עושיםsweeping and washing the exterior concrete deck walkways
מבנה מרכזיThe continuous concrete deck walkway and turned timber spindle balustrade - three open tiers linked by external concrete stairs - running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the housing block, dividing the frame into the ground-floor courtyard, the lower sleeping deck, the middle spindle-railed gallery, and the open sky above the roofline.

129. PED'S BREAKDOWN RECOVERYמשחק צליל

פרקPediatric psychiatric emergencies
משחק המילים"PED'S BREAKDOWN RECOVERY" encodes pediatric psychiatric emergencies through "PED'S" (peds / pediatrics) and "BREAKDOWN RECOVERY" (acute psychiatric crisis / nervous breakdown management and stabilization).
המקוםAn ordinary roadside vehicle recovery depot on an overcast afternoon. Heavy yellow flatbed tow trucks and recovery vans sit on an asphalt apron beside a corrugated iron workshop. Two recovery mechanics in grease-stained overalls inspect hydraulic winches and secure heavy steel chains to the tilt-bed runners.
מה כולם עושיםinspecting winches and securing tow chains on recovery flatbeds
מבנה מרכזיThe heavy steel flatbed tilt-tray ramp - a massive diamond-plate hydraulic slide bed raised at a thirty-degree angle - cutting the frame diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, dividing the yard into the incoming tow bay, the winch cable track, the operator's hydraulic control levers, and the secure vehicle storage compound behind.

130. LEE AYSON BIOMEDICALמשחק צליל

פרקConsultation-liaison: pediatrics, oncology, chronic illness
משחק המיליםThe firm's name 'LEE AYSON' is a phonetic pun on 'liaison' (/liːˈeɪzən/), encoding the consultation-liaison medical service.
המקוםA specialist medical equipment service workshop where returned hospital devices are inspected, repaired, and recalibrated. Fluorescent strip lights illuminate long rows of anti-static workbenches stacked with diagnostic instruments and lead-shielded storage bins. Technicians in grey anti-static coats work methodically through clipboards of cross-departmental service requests.
מה כולם עושיםTesting and calibrating returned hospital monitoring equipment against manufacturer specification sheets.
מבנה מרכזיA heavy slate-topped electronic calibration bench with an integrated overhead instrument rack cutting diagonally across the workshop floor.

131. THEO REES OPHTHALMICמשחק צליל

פרקPsychotherapy theories overview
משחק המיליםThe trade name 'THEO REES' is a phonetic pun on 'theories' (/ˈθiːəriz/), representing the theoretical schools of psychotherapy.
המקוםAn optical surfacing laboratory where prescription spectacle lenses are ground, polished, and checked for power tolerances. Coolant mist settles over rows of fining spindles, alloy blockers, and tray racks loaded with blank lens discs. Technicians in brown laboratory smocks verify focal centers and surface curvatures under overhead inspection lamps.
מה כולם עושיםVerifying lens powers and optical centers against paper prescription dockets using focimeters.
מבנה מרכזיA cast-iron optical surfacing and fining bench with dual polishing spindles cutting diagonally across the workshop.

132. CEMENT BLOCK TESTINGראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקCBT: theory + practice
משחק המיליםC, B and T head the three words of an utterly ordinary trade name — a works that makes cement blocks and tests them — and the three letters are picked out on the fascia the way the corpus picks out expreSS tRIps. The works was chosen because its trade is the method: nobody here argues about whether a block is strong, they put it in the press and wind the load on until it tells them, which is collaborative empiricism and the behavioural experiment in one machine, and the banner over the press says as much in the works' own words. A block is only as good as what is under it, so the demonstration slab's foundation course laid to a string line carries core beliefs under automatic thoughts, and the mix docket says what actually went in. The reject pallet holds a dozen blocks each deformed in one named way — one bowed, one twisted, one split clean in two, one short-measured — which is the distortion list as a contrast set rather than a list of words. Three mould boxes stamped in order sit on the bench and are the model everybody teaches first. The press dial is scaled nought to a hundred and its real job is bearing that scale; the loading rig that adds one step weight at a time up a numbered rack is graded exposure with nothing invented; the chalked order of working by the door is the session agenda; and the half-blocks in the take-one-home bin by the gate are the homework.
המקוםA concrete block works and its little testing house on a weekday morning: the mixer and block machine at one end, a long run of curing racks loaded with grey blocks, and a glazed room where samples go into the compression press one at a time. A demonstration slab lies outside the door with its foundation course laid to a string line.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is testing the day's batch — carrying a sample block down from the racks, setting it square in the press, winding the load on until it goes, and writing the reading on the card.
מבנה מרכזיThe run of curing racks stacked with blocks and the output conveyor feeding it, stepping away from the lower-left corner of the yard up to the upper right, with the compression press standing at its near end.

133. DURHAM BOX & TUBEראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקDBT: theory + practice
משחק המיליםThe initial letters of the business name 'DURHAM BOX & TUBE' form the acronym 'DBT' (Dialectical Behavior Therapy).
המקוםA packaging manufacturing plant where corrugated cardboard sheets are cut, creased, folded, and glued into shipping cartons. Overhead dust extractors hum above conveyor tables loaded with kraft board blanks and steel cutting formes. Operators in ear defenders and navy overalls feed sheets into the folding guides and inspect carton squareness.
מה כולם עושיםInspecting flat-packed corrugated cartons for glue-line alignment and folding score depth.
מבנה מרכזיA motorized corrugated board rotary die-cutter and scoring line running diagonally across the plant floor.

134. ISLAND PARK TARGET ARCHERYראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקIPT-A: Interpersonal psychotherapy for adolescents
משחק המיליםI-P-T-A are the initials of Island Park Target Archery, in order, on a sign that reads like any real municipal range. The venue pays a second time by pure structure: the concentric-ring target face IS IPT-A's closeness circle — the adolescent at the bullseye, family in the inner ring, friends further out, everyone else in the white. All four IPT problem areas are native range furniture (an unclaimed bow stand = grief, two archers on one lane = role dispute, moving up a shooting line = role transition, the lone shooter in the end lane = interpersonal deficits).
המקוםThe outdoor archery range of an ordinary summer camp on a lake shore — mown grass, straw butts on trestles, a roped shooting line, a shade canopy of folding chairs, teenagers in camp T-shirts.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is shooting the range — nocking, drawing, loosing on the whistle, then walking downrange together to pull arrows and score.
מבנה מרכזיThe roped shooting line with the receding row of straw target butts on their trestles, running lower-left to upper-right and splitting the frame into behind-the-line / on-the-line / downrange / the target faces themselves.

135. OUSE AMATEUR ROWING SOCIETYראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקMotivational interviewing
משחק המיליםO-A-R-S stand in order as the word-initials of a completely genuine river-club name — the expreSS tRIps device — and OARS is the method's own four-skill acronym, so the fascia is the club and the syllabus at once. The trade then hands over the model without a single invented image. The cox is the whole spirit of the method made ordinary: he sits facing the crew, holds no oar, cannot move a heavy hull an inch himself, and gets it off the raft entirely by asking and calling — partnership rather than expertise, and the client does every stroke of the pulling. A double scull, two people pulling one boat and neither able to move it alone, is that partnership again. The stages of change are the numbered landing stages along the bank: they are come up in order, a boat may lie at one for as long as it likes, and a boat that stops pulling drifts back down past the stages it has already passed, which is relapse drawn as ordinary river behaviour instead of as a wheel diagram. Rolling with resistance is the club's first coaching point, painted on the river-rules board: you do not fight the stream, you lean the boat and let the water carry it round, and the crew shoving against the current sits still in the middle of the frame going nowhere. Four blades to a bay in the rack outside the door are the four skills; four boats going out in order behind the launch are the four processes.
המקוםA river rowing club on an ordinary Saturday outing: the boathouse doors folded back on tiered racks of hulls, a timber landing raft running out from the doors into the stream, a worn concrete slipway beside it, a rack of blades stood on their handles against the wall, and a run of numbered landing stages spaced along the bank upstream.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is getting a boat onto the water and pulling away from the raft — carrying a hull down on shoulders, setting the blades into the gates, holding a boat steady while a crew steps in, pushing off, sitting to the oars and pulling.
מבנה מרכזיThe timber landing raft and its ramp — a long staging running out from the boathouse doors across the shallows into the stream — cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing it into the boathouse, the hard, the raft and the open water.

136. FIVE STEPS LIDOמבנה מרחבי

פרקLevels of care: inpatient, partial hospitalization, residential, systems of care
משחק המיליםFIVE STEPS is the local name of the bathing place, taken from the five broad steps down into the water, and those steps are the continuum of care laid in stone: you go down one at a time, you cannot skip one, and you come out the way you went in. The tank does the rest by being built the way lidos are actually built — five depths in order, each painted on the wall, each roped off from the next, and nobody crossing a rope without the badge for it, which is the admission and step-down criteria drawn as ordinary Saturday poolside business rather than as a ladder diagram. The badge board by the office pins the distance badges in their fixed order, so the ladder is posted twice. The deep end beyond the last rope is watched from two raised chairs under the never-swim-alone rule; the half-day ticket on the fare board puts a whole crowd in at ten and out at one, home for the afternoon, which is partial hospitalisation printed on a price list; the season cubicles along the terrace with names chalked on their doors are residential; and the paddling pool and the sun terrace, where nobody is watched at all, are the least restrictive setting sitting in the same frame as the deepest one. The chalked timetable sharing one tank between the school lessons, the club night, the public swim and the council's quiet session, with one attendant keeping it, is systems of care: he owns no swimmer and decides only who goes in, in what order, and how long. Restraint is ordinary here, brief and bounded — the reach pole off the rail, two guards, over the moment the swimmer has the rail — and the swimmer sent back over the rope into the shallow zone is readmission.
המקוםA municipal open-air pool on a warm Saturday: one long tank built in stepped depths with the boards painted along the wall, rope lines on floats dividing it into zones, and five broad stone steps down into the water at the shallow corner. A terrace of numbered changing cubicles runs behind, with the ticket window and turnstile at the gate end and a paddling pool beyond the rail.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is swimming their own length of the tank — going down the steps a step at a time, working out from the shallow zone, hanging on the rope line, and being turned back or waved on at each rope.
מבנה מרכזיThe long poolside wall and coping with its painted depth boards stepping 3FT · 5FT · 6FT · 9FT along it, running from the lower-left corner of the terrace up to the diving stage at the upper right and dividing the frame into terrace and cubicles, paddling pool and learner tank, the roped main water, and the deep end beyond the last rope.

137. IVY END PITCHESראשי תיבות בשלט

פרקSchool-based interventions and consultation
משחק המיליםI, E and P head the three words of a completely ordinary municipal ground name — grounds really are named for the corner of the parish they stand in — so the education plan every child psychiatrist is examined on becomes the largest lettering in the frame with no medical word on it, and the changing block's own street number, 504, carries the other plan on an enamel plate without a prop being invented. The ground was chosen because tiered support is what youth coaching already does and can be seen doing: the whole squad in one colour of bib working the same grid, a small group pulled aside to a second grid in a second colour, one child working one-to-one at the far goal in a third — all three tiers visible at once, in one frame, at the same session, doing the same drill. Accommodation is this trade's own habit too: a smaller ball, a lower goal and a longer run at it for the child who needs one, with the adaptation card pinned to the kit bag. The registration table under the awning issuing a pass that lets a child play out of his age band is the eligibility and placement meeting; the welfare officer's sealed envelope of forms, opened to the coach only as far as it says what he must actually do, is confidentiality against need-to-know; the conduct board on the rail and the line the parents must stand behind are the behaviour code; the visiting coach signing the clipboard at the gate, who may advise the club and nothing more, is the consultant arriving from outside the system; and the scout at the rail writing one name down is early identification and referral.
המקוםA municipal playing field on a Sunday-morning youth training session: two pitches marked out on one field, portable goals, and a touchline rail hung with sponsor hoardings and a painted conduct board, parents standing behind it. A low brick changing block sits at the top corner with the number 504 on an enamel plate beside its door.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working the same passing drill in their own grid — the main squad through the coach's big grid of cones, a handful pulled aside into a second grid in a second colour of bib, one pair at the far goal with a coach and a smaller ball.
מבנה מרכזיThe touchline rail with its run of sponsor hoardings, carrying from the lower-left corner of the field up to the changing block at the upper right, a portable goal standing at its far end.

138. MINUCHIN & SONS BUILDERSתמונה מילולית

פרקFamily therapy + Parent management training
משחק המיליםStructural family therapy is a structure: the site board reads '& SONS', which is what a family firm is actually called, and Minuchin is the man whose whole model is boundaries, subsystems and hierarchy. The building itself carries the theory without invention — a stud partition you can see straight through is an enmeshed boundary, a blockwork wall with no doorway is a disengaged one, the scaffold levels are the generational hierarchy (parents must be on the upper deck), and the surveyor's tripod is Bowen triangulation. Parent management training rides on the site's own behaviour system: a numbered brass-token board at the tool crib, a 'days without an incident' tally, and a TIME OUT klaxon.
המקוםA residential building site on a suburban plot — a house going up, scaffold on two sides, a cement mixer turning, a tea urn on a trestle, the firm's board wired to the hoarding.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is working an ordinary house-building shift — measuring, framing, carrying, nailing, signalling from the scaffold.
מבנה מרכזיThe half-built load-bearing party wall with the scaffold run beside it, cutting lower-left to upper-right across the plot and splitting the frame into street / ground floor rooms / scaffold level / roof line.

139. M. KLEIN MARIONETTESמשחק צליל

פרקPsychodynamic: Anna Freud, Klein, Kohut, Mentalization
משחק המיליםThe sign 'M. KLEIN' directly puns on psychoanalyst Melanie Klein, with 'klein' also being German for small, matching the miniature figures crafted in the workshop.
המקוםA traditional puppet-making workshop where jointed wooden figures are carved, painted, and strung for theatrical productions. Wood shavings litter the plank floor beneath racks of chisels, drying glues, and articulated limbs hanging from ceiling joists. Craftsmen in leather aprons assemble wooden pivot joints and adjust balance strings at long timber benches.
מה כולם עושיםAssembling and stringing wooden marionette joints at long timber workbenches.
מבנה מרכזיA heavy dual-sided timber assembly bench with overhead stringing gantry and hanging control bars cutting diagonally across the workshop floor.

140. CONSTANCE ROAD TOY LIBRARYמבנה מרחבי

פרקObject relations: Winnicott, Mahler, Kernberg
משחק המיליםA lending library for toys is the only ordinary premises whose whole trade is what this chapter teaches — an object leaves its owner, survives being taken away, and comes back, with a card standing in for it in the drawer the entire time it is absent — and the branch is named for its street the way every municipal branch is, CONSTANCE ROAD holding object constancy inside an unremarkable English street name instead of spending the lettering on the theory.
המקוםA municipal toy library in a converted shop unit on a wet Saturday: a long issue counter with a date-stamp block and a printed parts-checking mat, tall shelving bays of numbered toys in net bags running back into the room, and a card-index cabinet on the end wall. A returns trolley with two triage trays stands at the counter end, and a low play corner sits behind a half-gate with a repair bench beyond it.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is borrowing and returning — counting a returned toy's pieces off against its card, stamping a date, lifting a net bag down off the shelf, carrying one back to the low shelf and straight out again.
מבנה מרכזיThe issue-and-returns counter with its parts-checking mat and the loaded returns trolley at its end, running from the lower left of the frame to the upper right and splitting the room into play corner, counter, shelving bays and repair bench.

141. BION BELLHANGERS — RING OF EIGHTמבנה מרחבי

פרקLater theorists: Erikson, Bion, Ogden, Lacan, Spitz, Stern, relational
משחק המיליםA bell is an ordinary industrial container whose entire job is to take a raw meaningless blow from the clapper held inside it and hand it back as a note, which is container-contained and alpha-function performed as a trade rather than described as a metaphor, and the firm's board advertises what it hangs — a ring of eight, the bellhanger's own name for a fixed graded sequence rung strictly in order with no bell skipped, which is the epigenetic ladder standing bolted up in the middle of the shed.
המקוםA bellhanging works on a fitting-out day: the trial frame standing down the middle of the shed with eight graded bells bolted into it, wheels and headstocks laid out on the boards beneath. A vertical tuning lathe at one end holds a bell mouth-up under the cutter, a lettering and inspection bench runs along the window wall, and the ropes drop through numbered floor holes into the pit below.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is fitting out and proving the ring — bolting a bell to its headstock, chalking a soundbow, striking a bell with a fork and laying a flat palm on the metal to feel it, hauling a rope down through its floor hole.
מבנה מרכזיThe trial bellframe — the timber and iron A-frame carrying all eight bells in size order — cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing the shed into lathe end, frame, lettering bench and the rope pit below.

142. RAY MOTE COMMUNICATIONSמשחק צליל

פרקTelemental health for children and adolescents
משחק המיליםThe name 'RAY MOTE' is a phonetic pun on 'remote' (/rɪˈmoʊt/), encoding remote telemedicine delivery in telemental health.
המקוםA technical workshop dedicated to assembling, testing, and calibrating commercial teleconferencing and remote audiovisual links. Banks of diagnostic video displays and acoustic monitors line the walls above ESD-safe soldering and patch benches. Technicians in antistatic wristbands test interactive screen latency and calibrate juvenile headsets.
מה כולם עושיםTesting video displays, audio headsets, and link latency against remote diagnostic standards.
מבנה מרכזיA tall 19-inch steel equipment rack and multi-monitor test console cutting diagonally across the room.

143. GOLD STANDARD ASSAYתמונה מילולית

פרקEvidence-based practice in child psychiatry
משחק המיליםEvery idiom this chapter speaks in is already an assay-office noun — the gold standard, the acid test, the weight of evidence, grades of fineness, appraisal, and an assay itself being a trial in the oldest sense of the word — so the board says GOLD STANDARD ASSAY exactly as a hallmarking office's board says it, and the room then hands the chapter its facts as ordinary trade furniture rather than as theory.
המקוםAn assay office on a busy trade morning: a long testing bench down the middle with a rack of numbered acid bottles and a row of beam balances, a black touchstone slab at the near end and a hallmark punch press at the far end. A brass-grilled trade counter takes numbered trays in from the jewellers, and a fineness chart hangs on the end wall above the half-open reject drawer.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is having metal tested and marked — handing in a numbered tray at the grille, scratching a piece down the touchstone, laying a drop of acid on the streak, weighing against the case of certified weights, and taking the stamp at the press.
מבנה מרכזיThe testing bench — the long run of acid racks, beam balances and touchstone slab, ending at the hallmark punch press — cutting the frame from the lower left to the upper right and dividing the office into public counter, bench, press and the sealed sample store behind.

144. THE LAST ROUNDתמונה מילולית

פרקIntegration + practice questions + weak-spot review
משחק המיליםThe chapter is practice questions and a weak-spot review, and a pub quiz is the one boring public place where strangers answer questions in rounds and then get their own marked sheet back. THE LAST ROUND is a completely plausible pub name and carries both meanings at once — the final round of questions and the last chapter of the course. The scoreboard column chalked 'MISSED' is the weak-spot review, the swapped-and-marked answer sheets are the retrieval drill, and the tie-breaker bell is the one question that decides it.
המקוםThe back room of an ordinary pub on quiz night — long bar, chalk scoreboard wall, teams crowded round small tables with answer sheets, the quizmaster on a low stage with a microphone.
מה כולם עושיםEveryone is playing the pub quiz — listening to the question, conferring in a huddle, writing an answer, swapping sheets to mark.
מבנה מרכזיThe long mahogany bar counter with the chalk scoreboard wall behind it, running lower-left to upper-right and splitting the frame into team tables / bar / quizmaster's stage / the scoreboard.

כללים וסמלים שפרשו

מה למדנו על מה עובד ומה לא

Code substitutes these into the element table; it does not suggest them to a model. SCENE_TOKEN entries are props INSIDE the chapter's venue, never the venue itself. ONE MEANING PER TOKEN, and the rule covers TOKENS ONLY. A token that stands for a fact in one chapter may not stand for a different fact in another — the owner spotted the same pneumatic hose reel carrying two meanings across plates (2026-09-23), and a glyph that means two things teaches neither. Ordinary scenery is not covered: a window, a bench, a crate may appear in every chapter, because they carry no meaning to collide. A token's MEANING is fixed; its costume follows the venue. psychosis_state is antennae on the head, and the headgear they sprout from is whatever that scene already puts on the person.

DSM_anxietyפרש

הוחלף בanxiety_state
למהa frightened rabbit is an invented metaphor with no corpus precedent; draw a person who is visibly anxious

DSM_depressiveפרש

הוחלף בdepression_state
למהa grey rain cloud is invented; the corpus uses the happy/sad theatre masks, identically, on five pages

epi_prevalenceפרש

למהa peg character holding a giant % sign is a data-visualisation convention layered on the scene; prevalence is a painted numeral on a diegetic carrier

epi_comorbidityפרש

למהconjoined twins encode the RELATION abstractly; import the co-occurring entity's own glyph into the scene instead, as the corpus parks the TCA tricycle in the SSRI office
